title: Senior Project Manager D365
description:
• Lead a major Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations transformation
  • Own delivery, governance, adoption and commercial discipline
  • Join a global manufacturing and engineering group with a program already in motion.

NEPEAN is seeking a hands-on Senior Project Manager to lead the continued rollout of our Dynamics 365 transformation program across a diverse group of manufacturing and engineering businesses. This is a delivery leadership role where you will drive execution, adoption and commercial control across a complex, multi-entity program already underway.

About NEPEAN and the role

NEPEAN is a global manufacturing and engineering group part way through a multi-year rollout of Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, with CRM components across selected business units. Phase 1 is live, Phase 2 is scoped and approved, and several go-lives are ahead of us across Australian and international entities.

You would be joining a program already in motion, not starting one from scratch. You would inherit an established project team, an implementation partner, and a delivery roadmap, and your job is to drive it to completion with pace and control. This is a delivery leadership role rather than a status-reporting one. You will be embedded in the program, close to the business, and accountable for execution, adoption and commercial discipline.

You will work alongside our project team, our implementation partner and our business leaders across a diverse group of manufacturing and engineering businesses. Carving out time for transformation in busy operational units is one of the real challenges of this program, so the ability to engage time-poor teams and sustain momentum matters as much as technical delivery.

What you will own
  • End-to-end delivery. Own the D365 roadmap across multiple regions and legal entities, managing the full lifecycle from design and build through testing, data migration, cutover and hypercare.
  • Governance and cadence. Establish and run the program roadmap, milestones, dependencies, RAID and executive reporting, and own the steering committee rhythm.
  • Change and adoption. Partner with the change function to lead stakeholder engagement, communications and training, and build engagement models that work for operational teams who are hard to pull away from the floor.
  • Business partnering. Work directly with business leaders to challenge legacy ways of working, drive standardisation, and act as a trusted advisor to executives and business owners.
  • Vendor and commercial management. Manage vendor contracts and SOWs, change requests, budget tracking and resource planning. Hold delivery partners accountable on quality, timeline realism and cost.
  • Delivery discipline. Use Azure DevOps to manage the delivery backlog, test cycles, releases and UAT coverage, and enforce structured delivery across sprints and environments.
What we are looking for
  • 8+ years in enterprise program or project management, with proven delivery of large-scale, multi-entity, multi-country D365 or comparable ERP programs.
  • Strong exposure to Finance, Supply Chain and CRM, and experience working with global system integrators.
  • A genuine understanding of the ERP implementation lifecycle and of D365 FinOps, enough to challenge a vendor on substance rather than take their word for it.
  • Working knowledge of Azure DevOps and agile or hybrid delivery models.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management across C-suite, business leaders and technical teams, with the ability to influence without authority.
  • Strong commercial acumen around change control and budget management.
The kind of person who will fit here

A hands-on operator, not a status-only PM. Comfortable with ambiguity, complexity and a fast-moving environment. Decisive, good at conflict resolution, and able to build trust quickly with people who are sceptical of transformation. A manufacturing, engineering or project-based business background is a real advantage, as is experience of global rollouts, CRM implementations, data migration and cutover. Microsoft PM or D365 certifications are welcome.

What success looks like
  • The business actively adopts D365, and leadership trusts the program.
  • A strong, predictable delivery rhythm is established across the remaining go-lives.
  • Vendors are held accountable and the program stays within its commercial envelope.
  • The program delivers real business value, not just a sequence of system go-lives.
Ready to apply?

If you are a commercially minded, delivery-focused Senior Project Manager ready to lead a major D365 transformation, we would like to hear from you. Apply now with your resume and a brief cover note outlining your relevant ERP or D365 delivery experience.

Corporate Travel Consultant (Bechtel Team)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid).This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management. You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts

  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability

  • 401k program with partial match

  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

title: Project Engineering Supervisor
description:
This is a full time, onsite role at our Bethlehem, PA facility.


Company Background:

ABEC is a leading supplier to the biopharmaceutical manufacturing industry. ABEC’s unique value is based on combining long experience, with the ability to engineer, design, manufacture, commission, qualify, and service the entire bioprocess to reduce overall cost, shorten time to market, and maximize productivity. ABEC’s products include process and equipment engineering/consulting services, comprehensive site services, bioreactors and fermenters, filtration and chromatography systems, prep and hold systems, and cleaning/sterilization systems.


Position Summary:

As the Project Engineering Supervisor, you will lead and direct the Engineering and Design activities for ABEC in order to drive innovation and deliver leading edge products. The Project Engineering Supervisor is an experienced craftsperson who exhibits the principles and practices of ABEC’s leadership. This Manager has personal responsibility for coaching, career development, and technical excellence of direct reports, takes responsibility for eliminating impediments, and actively evolves other departments to meet customer’s needs.


Responsibilities:

· Assists in the hiring, training, evaluation of team members; including managing conflict resolution, administering of performance reviews and documenting disciplinary or performance issues through the use of a performance improvement plan

· Coordinates and directs the work of team members; establishing engineer priorities and schedules based on date-driven customer-focused project requirements, as well as, performing tasks related to Project Engineering.

· Ensures the engineering related tasks are completed on time and on budget, while adhering to the established specifications, standards and procedures.

· Acts as a liaison between team members and the rest of the organization

· Coordinating engineering efforts with the mechanical and electrical teams and project managers, as well as, supporting the resolution of manufacturing issues related to the engineering department.

· Oversee, monitor, and coordinate engineering team member activities, giving importance to individual member's and overall team's achievement of established goals.

· Ensures engineering department goals are aligned with and representative of the overall company's directive, relying on extensive experience to provide leadership and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.

· Assists in controlling departmental costs; recommending means to reduce costs and improve efficiency and product quality.

· Assist in the verification of the accuracy and organization of engineering documents and files.

· Assists in the development and maintenance of standard engineering and design practices, internal guidelines and procedures.

· Participate in design reviews and product development meetings.

· Provide status reporting of engineering activities against the project budget or schedule, as well as established departmental metrics.

· Assists in the development of any engineering related labor estimates for proposals.

· Travel to customer job sites and/or worldwide manufacturing facilities as required.

· Execute other duties as required.


Qualifications:

· BS in an Engineering field (Mechanical, Biological, Chemical or equivalent experience).

· 3 years post graduate Engineering experience in related industry and direct experience in a lead Engineer role coordinating and directing the work of other Engineers.

· 5 years post graduate Engineering experience working in a BioPharm or Piping systems market and / or direct experience supporting the manufacture and testing of custom equipment, machinery and components driven by customer specifications preferred.

· 5 years direct work experience in an Engineering leadership role, coordinating and directing the work of others.

· 2 years’ experience in support of automation and control systems engineering related to bioprocesses preferred.

Goodwill Kentucky is looking for a high energy, positive attitude, team-minded Team Leader to join our team! This position is essential for the success of our retail store operation. The ideal candidate will support our core values of Dignity, Service, Hope, and Partnership with a focus on great customer service. If you are looking for an opportunity that allows you to reach new goals while helping others in your community, the Team Leader opportunity is for you!

Our retail operation is an important part of who we are and what we do. It fuels our good work across the Kentucky Bluegrass, generating revenue for programs and services while providing job opportunities to many of who face limited options. Every role within our retail operations helps us further our mission of empowering people to increase the dignity and independence that comes with earning a paycheck and achieving self-sufficiency.

Pay: $13.50 / hour

Job Type: Full-Time

Hours of Operation:

Monday-Sunday: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Essential Duties and Tasks:

  • Assists in providing direction and modeling of job duties to other Production Clerks.
  • Displays great customer service by greeting donors and customers; offers assistance.
  • Sorts material as required and stocks material in stores.
  • Rotates stock as needed.
  • Operates cash register.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED, preferred.
  • Must have basic math skills, ability to make change, complete paperwork in a timely manner.
  • May serve as a coach in one-on-one training with a Production Clerk(s).
  • Must have reliable transportation to and from work.

Physical Demands:

  • This job may have physical requirements that considered light to medium work. Light to medium work involves sitting for short periods of time; frequent bending, squatting, kneeling, stooping; good finger dexterity and feeling; frequent repetitive motions; talking, hearing, and visual acuity, frequently lifting/pushing/pulling 10-20 pounds, and occasionally pushing/pulling 20-50 pounds.
  • Must have the ability to perform material handling with few restrictions, works with minimal supervision.
  • Must have the ability to work a rotating schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Travel to other locations beyond the assigned work location is not required.

Benefits:

  • 403(b) Plan
  • Company 403(b) Matching Contributions
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Medical, Prescription, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Generous Vacation Time & 8 Paid Holidays
  • Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Life, Dependent Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Voluntary Term Life Insurance
  • Free career coaching, including financial training and digital literacy
  • Flexible schedule
  • Access to our Goodwill Cars to Work program
  • Mission-centric career

When we say mission-centric career, what do we mean? When you work at Goodwill, you work to help fund employment programs for Kentuckians who have disabilities or other challenges to entering the workforce. You get paid, but you also help your neighbors in need!

Have a background challenge? That’s OK, too! Goodwill is a proud second-chance employer.

title: Training Curriculum Development Cadre Lead
description:
The Leidos Digital Modernization Sector has a current job opportunity for a highly qualified Training Curriculum Development & Training Cadre Lead to support network operations management, cybersecurity training, and workforce readiness initiatives at DISA Headquarters, Fort Meade, MD.

This position serves as the people leader and operational lead for a cadre of training professionals responsible for developing, coordinating, and delivering cybersecurity training, workforce development, readiness, and exercise support. The Training Cadre Lead will provide day-to-day leadership, establish priorities, manage workload and performance, mentor team members, and ensure the cadre consistently delivers high-quality training solutions aligned with DISA mission requirements.

The successful candidate will combine strong people leadership and program management skills with experience in training, curriculum development, workforce readiness, and cybersecurity operations. This individual will serve as the primary interface between the training cadre, Leidos program leadership, government stakeholders, subject matter experts, and operational organizations.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative and accountable leader who can develop people, build a high-performing team, manage competing priorities, and translate customer requirements into effective training and readiness solutions.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a cadre of training professionals supporting cybersecurity training, workforce readiness, curriculum development, and exercises.
  • Manage team priorities, workloads, performance, and deliverables to ensure timely, high-quality support to customer requirements.
  • Coach and develop employees through regular feedback, cross-training, professional development, and certification opportunities.
  • Serve as the primary interface between the training cadre, Leidos leadership, government stakeholders, subject matter experts, and operational organizations.
  • Lead the planning, execution, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity training and workforce readiness programs.
  • Oversee development and maintenance of curricula, instructional materials, training schedules, certification tracking, records, and readiness metrics.
  • Coordinate training cadre support for cybersecurity exercises, including scenario development, MSELs, execution, After Action Reports, and lessons learned.
  • Analyze training effectiveness, workforce readiness, and stakeholder feedback to identify gaps and recommend improvements.
  • Provide leadership with timely updates on team performance, program outcomes, risks, resource needs, and recommended actions.
  • Foster an accountable, collaborative, and mission-focused culture that promotes employee engagement, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

Basic Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance
  • Current DOD 8140 Cyber Workforce Developer and Manager Certification (i.e., Sec +)
  • Bachelor’s degree and 8 - 12 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 6 - 10 years of prior relevant experience
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience supporting training, workforce development, readiness programs, or instructional design.
  • Experience developing and delivering training materials, curriculum, and instructional content.
  • Experience coordinating training programs, schedules, and participant records.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Experience preparing reports, assessments, and recommendations for leadership.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and training management tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD), Federal Government, or cybersecurity training programs.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity workforce development frameworks and certification programs.
  • Experience supporting cyber exercises, tabletop exercises, readiness programs, or operational training events.
  • Familiarity with Joint Training Information Management System (JTIMS).
  • Familiarity with Joint Lessons Learned Information System (JLLIS).
  • Experience developing After Action Reports (AARs), lessons learned analyses, and corrective action plans.
  • Knowledge of workforce readiness reporting and training metrics.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

August 29, 2026

Pay Range $107,900.00 - $195,050.00

Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
About Arena:

Arena is a Series A company backed by top-tier investors such as CRV, Redpoint and Craft Ventures. Arena offers a unique work environment and the chance to collaborate with diverse teammates across multiple countries, with a culture of ownership (autonomy, growth, and responsibility).

We are a startup created in Silicon Valley with a mission to build communities for creators, publishers and brands with the power of AI. Companies using Arena include Disney, Reuters, Fox, Red Bull and NFL. We have +2,000 customers in 150 countries and with +50M users having conversations on Arena per month and engaging with our Agent AI.

Sometimes you're stuck in a job that doesn't make sense. Refactoring code from ages ago, the stack is miles away from what it's supposed to be. If you love a good challenge, enjoy solving meaningful problems, and want to be a part of one of the fastest-growing AI startups in the Silicon Valley — then Arena is the company you're looking for.

The challenges:

  • Real-time messaging infrastructure supporting 100,000 concurrent users per customer application;
  • High performance systems with API responses in the 10ms range;
  • Highly scalable architecture using auto-scaling policies, distributed systems and container orchestration;
  • High availability infrastructure powering homepages of some of the most visited websites and apps on the internet;
  • Managing distributed databases for our Data Platform storing every user engagement;
  • Building infrastructure that enables product teams to ship fast with reliability and observability.

Our Stack:

  • AWS;
  • DigitalOcean;
  • Terraform;
  • Docker;
  • GitHub & GitHub Actions;
  • Node;
  • React;
  • TypeScript;
  • Vercel;
  • Datadog;
  • CloudWatch;
  • Kong API Gateway;
  • Cloudflare;
  • Varnish.

Work Experience:

  • 3–5 years of relevant DevOps / Infrastructure / SRE experience.

Must-Have Experience:

  • AWS infrastructure experience with:
    • ECS (Fargate);
    • Lambda;
    • RDS (PostgreSQL);
    • DocumentDB (MongoDB compatible);
    • S3;
    • CloudFront;
    • API Gateway;
    • WAF;
    • SES;
    • IAM;
    • VPC networking.
  • Infrastructure as Code using Terraform;
  • CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (or similar);
  • Containerization using Docker and container orchestration with ECS;
  • Strong networking fundamentals: load balancers, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, CDNs;
  • Monitoring and observability using Datadog, CloudWatch, Prometheus or similar;
  • Database operations with MongoDB/DocumentDB and PostgreSQL;
  • Fluent written and spoken English.

Nice-to-Have Experience:

  • Kong API Gateway or other gateway technologies (NGINX, Envoy);
  • DigitalOcean infrastructure;
  • Varnish cache configuration and CDN optimization;
  • FinOps and cloud cost optimization;
  • Cloudflare DNS/CDN management;
  • Serverless frameworks for Lambda deployments;
  • OpenVPN configuration and administration;
  • Experience with high-scale systems (1M+ concurrent connections).

Example Projects You’ll Be Working on:

  • Build fully redundant production environment with automated switchover capabilities;
  • Build fully automated CI/CD pipeline;
  • Build fully automated production scaling system;
  • Build fully automated monitoring and early-warning systems;
  • Implement SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliance;
  • Monitor and maintain systems security and data privacy.

We also have some sweet perks like:

🔥 Be a part of the team in Silicon Valley and join a global team

💪 A team of exceptional engineers leading the cutting-edge AI Agents.

💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

⛱️ 4 weeks of paid time-off

📖 Learning and Development budget

🚀 Key moment to join Arena in terms of growth and opportunities

💻 Ability to put your stamp on real-world AI applications that serve millions of users.

📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

🌍 Multiple nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Arena

title: Director, Actuary - ALM
description:
The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary:

As Director and Actuary on our ALM team, you will lead the organization's JFSA Economic Capital program, transforming economic capital from a regulatory requirement into a strategic business management capability. This role oversees economic capital governance, reporting, and stakeholder engagement while partnering across the enterprise and with our parent company, Meiji Yasuda to integrate risk and value insights into business strategy, performance management, capital allocation, and growth decisions. Through strong leadership, collaboration, and innovation, the Director drives informed decision-making, enhances organizational understanding of risk, and advances the effective use of economic capital to create long-term value.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Oversee the production, aggregation, validation, interpretation, and reporting of economic capital results under the JFSA (Japanese regulator) framework for both our parent company, Meiji Yasuda, and senior management for Pillar 1 (prescribed economic capital results) and Pillar 2 (results that we believe are more reflective of our business)
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of economic capital professionals, setting priorities, building technical and business expertise, delegating analytical ownership, and ensuring the delivery of timely, accurate, and high-quality analysis and reporting.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with Meiji Yasuda on economic capital methodologies, assumptions, results, reporting requirements, emerging issues, and strategic opportunities to enhance the use of economic capital across the organization.
  • Partner with Product Lines, Actuarial Modeling, Finance, ALM, Investments, Enterprise Risk Management, and Governance teams to understand and interpret model results, ensure alignment, support strategic decision-making, and maintain governance standards for economic capital methodologies, controls, and processes.
  • Build economic capital and JFSA acumen across the organization by educating stakeholders and their teams, facilitating collaborative discussions, and fostering a shared understanding of JFSA results, related metrics, and underlying measurements. Promote consistent use of economic capital information across the enterprise to support informed decision-making and a common understanding of risk, performance, and growth trade-offs.
  • Communicate economic capital results, insights, and emerging risks through an ongoing two-way dialogue with senior management, auditors, regulators, Meiji Yasuda, and other stakeholders, enabling effective interpretation of results, strengthening organizational understanding of JFSA results and complementary metrics, and supporting informed, risk-aware business decisions.
  • Research industry best practices and emerging trends in economic capital, regulatory capital frameworks, risk-adjusted performance measurement, capital allocation, and value-based management, identifying opportunities to enhance the organization's ability to balance performance, growth, and risk through the effective use of JFSA results and related measures.
  • Lead the identification and implementation of economic capital use cases, partnering with stakeholders across the business to integrate economic capital into business management, strategic planning, pricing, performance measurement, capital allocation, and resource allocation decisions. Champion a holistic framework of JFSA results and complementary metrics that provide a comprehensive view of risk and value creation, support enterprise-wide consistency, and drive sustainable strategic growth.

Skills and Background You’ll Need:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience in: Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Business or a related field is preferred.
  • ASA designation required/FSA designation strongly preferred.

Experience:

  • Eight or more years of actuarial experience with increasing levels of responsibility.
  • Prior experience and solid understanding of economic capital regulations and economic capital governance, reporting applicability and impact to business strategy, performance management, capital allocation, and growth decisions.
  • Proven experience in the overall management and technical oversight of senior actuarial individual contributors and/or teams of actuarial staff and driving actuarial team performance to defined business objectives.
  • Experience with JFSA (a plus)
  • Solid technology skills utilizing Excel (required), Power BI (a plus), Dataiku (a plus).

Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate:

Winning Together: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build strong relationships within the team and across the organization. Works collaboratively across the organization to accomplish common business goals. Effectively collaborates and communicates with a wide range of non-technical stakeholders and is able to translate complex ideas into easily understandable concepts.

Developing People: Provides coaching, mentoring and development opportunities for individual team members and fosters a team culture focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. Cultivates professionalism by encouraging collaboration with colleagues, ownership of results, and implementation of innovative technical solutions.

Engaging Hearts & Minds: Empowers teams to form partnerships and motivates them to succeed through collaboration and cohesion.

Driving Success: Champions a result-oriented culture that views challenges as an opportunity to achieve greater growth by creating a compelling vision, implementing strategy-aligned goals, and executing with a sense of urgency. Uses market data and knowledge of business model to develop new strategies, connect goals to enterprise vision, and identify criteria to measure success.

Improvement Mindset: Thinks innovatively, brings ideas to life, and seeks continuous improvement. Approaches business challenges from a broad corporate perspective. Anticipates and removes barriers to accomplish business objectives. Constantly pursue exceptional results that take us “next level.”

Why Join The Standard?

We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect:

  • A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions

  • An annual incentive bonus plan

  • Generous paid time off including 11 holidays, 2 wellness days, and 8 volunteer hours annually — PTO increases with tenure

  • A supportive, responsive management approach and opportunities for career growth and advancement

  • Paid parental leave and adoption/surrogacy assistance

  • An employee giving program that double matches your donations to eligible nonprofits and schools

In addition to the competitive salary range below, our employee-focused benefits support work-life balance. Learn more about working at The Standard.

  • Eligibility to participate in an incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program and plan. Any award depends on a variety of factors including individual and organizational performance.

The actual compensation for this role will be based on a combination of education and experience, knowledge and skills, position budget, internal equity, and market data.

Salary Range:

$147,750.00 - $236,000.00

Positions will be posted for at least 5 days from original posting date.

Standard Insurance Company, The Standard Life Insurance Company of New York, Standard Retirement Services, Inc., StanCorp Mortgage Investors, LLC, StanCorp Investment Advisers, Inc., and American Heritage Life Insurance Company and American Heritage Service Company, marketed as The Standard, are Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability or veteran status or any other condition protected by federal, state or local law. Except where precluded by state or federal law, The Standard will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. The Standard offers a drug- and alcohol-free work environment where possession, manufacture, transfer, offer, use of or being impaired by an illegal substance while on The Standard's property, or in other cases which the company believes might affect operations, safety or reputation of the company is prohibited. The Standard requires a criminal background investigation and employment, education and licensing verification as a condition of employment. After any conditional offer of employment is made, the background check will include an individualized assessment based on the applicant’s specific record and the duties and requirements of the specific job. Applicants will be provided an opportunity to explain and correct background information. All employees of The Standard must be bondable.

title: Junior Quality Control Assistant
description:
Är du noggrann, strukturerad och riktigt vass på Excel och digitala arbetssätt? Vill du arbeta med kvalitet i en reglerad verksamhet där detaljer, dokumentation och spårbarhet är avgörande?

Vi söker nu en Junior Quality Control Assistant till en kvalitetsavdelning inom livsmedelsindustrin. Rollen passar dig som är i början av din karriär och vill utvecklas inom Quality Control, GMP och kvalitetssäkring. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – viktigast är att du har huvudet på skaft, är snabblärd och tycker om att skapa ordning i en komplex miljö.

Om rollen

Du arbetar nära QC, QA, produktion och laboratoriepersonal för att säkerställa att tillverkade batcher uppfyller fastställda specifikationer och kvalitetskrav innan de frisläpps.

Arbetet har ett tydligt fokus på granskning, dokumentation och administration. Du behöver därför vara bekväm med att hantera stora mängder information och kontrollera att varje detalj är korrekt.

Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:

- Granska batchprotokoll och tillhörande kvalitetsdokumentation

- Kontrollera att samtliga analys- och kontrollresultat är godkända

- Medverka vid slutkontroll och frisläppning av batcher

- Utfärda Certificate of Analysis (CoA) och Certificate of Compliance (CoC)

- Säkerställa att dokumentationen är komplett, korrekt och spårbar

- Skanna, digitalisera och arkivera batchprotokoll

- Ta fram etikettmastrar och skriva ut batchunderlag till produktionen

- Stoppa frisläppning och rapportera vidare om något avviker

- Vid behov genomföra och dokumentera enklare kvalitetskontroller

- Bidra till att verksamheten följer GMP, ISO 22000, HACCP och interna kvalitetsrutiner

Vi söker dig som

- Är mycket noggrann, strukturerad och kvalitetsmedveten

- Har god datorvana och är trygg i Excel och andra digitala system

- Har lätt för att förstå och följa instruktioner, processer och regelverk

- Kan hantera flera informationsflöden utan att tappa detaljer

- Kommunicerar väl på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt

- Är ansvarstagande, nyfiken och vågar reagera när något inte stämmer

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från en reglerad verksamhet, exempelvis livsmedel, läkemedel, medicinteknik, laboratorieverksamhet eller tillverkande industri. Kunskap om GMP, ISO 9001, ISO 22000, HACCP, kemisk analys eller kemikaliehantering är också meriterande.

Du kan exempelvis vara nyutexaminerad inom kemi, biomedicin, livsmedel, processteknik eller kvalitet – alternativt ha skaffat dig motsvarande kunskaper genom praktisk erfarenhet.

För att lyckas i rollen

Du behöver inte vara en senior QC-specialist. Däremot behöver du vara en person som ser detaljer, arbetar metodiskt och förstår vikten av att dokumentationen blir helt rätt. Du trivs i en händelserik miljö, lär dig snabbt och tar ansvar för att driva dina uppgifter hela vägen i mål.


Mejla CV och en kort presentation till info@ndpconsult.se. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande.

title: Mortgage Loan Processor II
description:
GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF POSITION

The Mortgage Loan Processor II processes mortgage loans from application to closing. This position complies with all legal and regulatory guidelines related to the mortgage loan industry. The Mortgage Loan Processor II improves customer service by processing all loans in a timely manner.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Answer incoming phone calls and answer customer questions regarding mortgage loans in general or specific to a borrower's loan in process.

2. Process FHA, VA, Conventional, Bond and RD loans after application, which includes, but not limited to, processing various types of verifications, pulling credit report, ordering appraisals, ordering title work, running loans through an automated system, pulling flood certificates, getting loan files ready and submitting them to underwriting, following up with underwriting and clearing all underwriting conditions.

3. Correspond with customers, real estate agents, appraisers, and title companies as needed to obtain information necessary to getting the mortgage loan ready to close.

4. Prepare month end reports to various banks and regulatory agencies.

5. Work directly with the Mortgage Loan Officer to ensure the utmost in customer service.

6. Refer customers to other bank personnel as needed.

7. Perform research on Bankway, Fortis, Image Center and Dimension.

8. Perform daily duties on all bank systems and Mortgage operating systems such as DO, DU, LP, Encompass and Doc magic.

9. Identify Cross Selling opportunities.

10. Review fields for completeness, qualification and Compliance.

11. Communicate deficiencies to the loan officer and customer.

12. Advise loan officer of any changes needed in the file to obtain loan approval. .

13. Communicate with realtor and customer of status as they change.

14. Communicate with Underwriter once file is submitted for approval process.

15. Clear underwriting conditions.

16. Complete required BSA/AML training and other compliance training as assigned.

17. The ability to work in a constant state of alertness and in a safe manner.

18. Perform any other related duties as required or assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty mentioned satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Knowledge of a specialized field (however acquired), such as basic accounting, computer, etc. Equivalent of four years in high school, plus night, trade extension, or correspondence school specialized training, equal to two years of college, plus 3 years related experience and/or training, and 12 to 18 months related management experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

COMMUNICATION SKILLS

Ability to read and understand documents such as policy manuals, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals; Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

CRITICAL THINKING SKILLS

Ability to utilize common sense understanding in order to carry out written, oral or diagrammed instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving several known variables in situations of a routine nature.

REQUIRED CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Not indicated.

PREFERRED CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Not indicated.

SOFTWARE SKILLS REQUIRED

Intermediate: 10-Key, Accounting, Alphanumeric Data Entry, Word Processing/Typing

Basic: Contact Management, Database, Spreadsheet

WORKING CONDITIONS

Somewhat disagreeable working conditions. Continuously exposed to one or two elements such as noise, intermittent standing, walking; and occasional pushing, carrying, or lifting.

ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS

The following work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES

The following physical activities described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions and expectations.

Semi-repetitive, low physical. Semi-repetitive type work which requires periods of concentration for varied time cycles as prescribed by the tasks.

While performing the functions of this job, the employee is continuously required to talk or hear; regularly required to sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms; frequently required to stand, walk; and occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- High school diploma or its equivalent

  • 3+ years of mortgage loan processing experience required
    - 3+ years hands on experience processing Conventional, FHA, VA, RD, and Bond loans preferred
    - 1 year experience with Encompass Anywhere preferred
    - 5+ years experience using personal computers
    - Experience using Microsoft Office Products
    - Proficient telephone and customer service skills

- Ability to sit for long periods

  • Ability to lift 15 lbs

- Ability to multi-task

title: ADMIN ASSISTANT, DIAGNOSTIC HEALTH SCREENING-1
description:
GENERAL DESCRIPTION

Responsible for providing quality and professional patient reception, appointment coordination, health screening support and administrative services within the Health Screening Unit. The position serves as a key contact point for patients, medical officers, consultants and other hospital departments to ensure smooth patient flow, accurate record management, effective communication and compliance with hospital policies and procedures.

JOB DESCRIPTION

1. Patient Reception & Registration Support

  • Greet and receive patients and appointment cards for repeat patients.

  • Assist patients to obtain queue numbers.

  • Key in patient’s MRN in KCIS for repeat patients and investigations, if any.

  • Assess patient’s condition and record patient’s vital signs when required.

description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Physical Verification Engineer, you will be a key technical contributor within the Heterogeneous Integration Group (HIG), responsible for defining, executing, and driving sign-off quality physical verification flows for next‑generation HBM logic die and memory‑centric SoCs. You will work across physical design, design rule development, EDA tool teams, foundry interfaces, and product engineering teams to deliver industry‑leading, tape-out-ready silicon under aggressive schedule, quality, and reliability constraints. This role combines full-chip physical verification ownership — including DRC, LVS, ERC, and DFM — with deep collaboration across implementation and silicon bring‑up, ensuring design integrity from layout through first silicon.

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Implement physical verification sign‑off for full‑chip and hierarchical designs, including Design Rule Check (DRC), Layout Versus Schematic (LVS), Electrical Rule Check (ERC), Physical Electrical Rule Check (PERC), antenna checking, and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).

  • Implement and debug foundry‑qualified rule decks, manage waivers, and drive clean closure while ensuring compliance with advanced‑node foundry requirements.

  • Perform reliability verification across multiple power domains, including electrostatic discharge (ESD), latch‑up, electromigration, floating nets, and connectivity checks.

  • Run density, metal fill, and chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) checks to ensure yield‑aware manufacturability at 3 nanometer and below.

  • Perform parasitic resistance‑capacitance (RC) extraction and support correlation of physical verification results with post‑silicon measurements.

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize physical verification flows, automation, and regression infrastructure using Python, Tcl, Perl, or similar scripting languages.

  • Drive adoption of machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI)‑based physical verification and power‑performance‑area (PPA) optimization tools.

  • Partner with physical design, custom layout, computer‑aided design (CAD), register‑transfer level (RTL), product engineering, EDA, and foundry teams, including direct collaborate with TSMC, from design kick‑off through tape‑out readiness and sign‑off decision gates.

  • Demonstrating AI to develop AI assisted development workflows.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Experience with full‑chip or block‑level physical verification for advanced‑node system‑on‑chip, memory, or heterogeneous integration designs.

  • Experience in physical verification methodologies, including DRC, LVS, ERC, PERC, DFM, antenna, and reliability sign‑off.

  • Experience using industry physical verification tools such as Calibre, IC Validator (ICV), Pegasus, or similar, including rule deck development or customization.

  • Working knowledge of full RTL‑to‑GDS implementation flows, including place‑and‑route, extraction, and their impact on physical verification outcomes.

  • Ability to drive verification closure by maintaining strong communication with multi-functional teams in a global engineering environment.

  • Proficiency with demonstrating AI and AI-enabled development workflows.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), DRAM, or memory‑centric system‑on‑chip physical verification, including multi‑die, chiplet, or 2.5D/3D integration.

  • Background in GPU, CPU, or high‑performance accelerator physical implementation at advanced process nodes with aggressive sign‑off and tape‑out schedules.

  • Familiarity with foundry develop rule documents, front‑end‑of‑line (FEOL) and back‑end‑of‑line (BEOL) rules, and advanced develop for manufacturability guidelines.

  • Exposure to post‑silicon failure analysis, yield learning, or layout‑based debug with correlation between physical verification results and silicon behavior.

  • Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 2 or more years of relevant industry experience.

title: AI Engineer, Evals & Agent Quality
description:
About Town

Town () is AI that starts from who you are. We build a persistent model of your identity, your voice, your judgment, your relationships, and your priorities, and use it to do real work on your behalf across every tool where you operate: email, calendar, documents, Slack, and more. Town doesn't wait for you to prompt it. It observes, learns, and acts. The more you use it, the more it becomes an extension of you.

Town was founded by Jean-Denis Greze (CEO), former CTO of Plaid, and Tony Vincent (CPO), former Director of Applied AI Product at Google. We're a small, talent-dense team backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Forerunner Ventures, First Round Capital, and Conviction, with more than $73M raised to date.

About the role

Town is building the most personalized, most capable AI assistant for everyone — one that knows you deeply, works across every tool you use, and gets sharper over time. Building the best assistant means proving it's the best: every model, prompt, and system change has to be measurably better, on every surface it touches.

That's what you'll own. You'll build the evals and quality systems that turn assistant performance into numbers the whole team can trust, measuring and improving the full multi-step trajectory the assistant takes to do real work. You'll build the model routing that puts the right model in the right place balancing cost, quality, and speed.

This is a foundational, 0→1 build with ownership to match: the eval framework, the golden datasets and labeling loop, model routing, and online measurement, and you set the bar for what "best" means at Town.

What you'll do

  • Build a generalized eval system that measures assistant quality across every surface it touches — and, crucially, across multi-step agent trajectories.

  • Stand up golden datasets and the labeling loop that keeps them up to date and constantly checking to validate improvements and avoid regressions.

  • Build model routing and online evaluation tooling to help us learn and route to the best models.

  • Make every prompt and system change measurable, so the team can move fast without breaking what works.

  • Partner with engineers across the product to instrument quality and close the loop from signal to fix.

You might thrive here if you...

  • Have built or owned LLM eval systems, or offline/online quality measurement at scale.

  • Think rigorously about measurement. Maybe that came from an MLE or applied-ML background, maybe not, the instinct for how to measure "better" matters more than the exact pedigree.

  • Know the eval landscape hands-on, off-the-shelf tooling and eval frameworks, and have opinions on what to reach for when.

  • Are comfortable reasoning about model routing and the tradeoffs between models.

  • Ship the fixes, not just the dashboards and metrics.

  • Are a senior or staff engineer comfortable in greenfield, where the system doesn't exist yet.

Location

San Francisco, CA. Five days a week in person at our Financial District office.

title: AI Engineer - Workflows
description:
About Build

AI for the Built World: Build has created the agentic AI stack for institutional real estate, automating complex development and acquisitions workflows 90% faster than humans to accelerate the world's most important built projects - digital infrastructure, energy, industrial - from concept to completion.

Our mission is to accelerate and amplify the world's most important built projects - inventing a better way to build through a collaboration between human experts and agentic AI. We envision a future where the world's buildings are driven from concept to completion, autonomously. Without delays, cost, and complexity. Enabling people to deliver a magnitude more deals. To make decisions, build relationships and create.

To start, we're partnering with the world's biggest built world institutions from $T alternative assets investors, prolific developers and even governments to push the frontier of what's possible. We're backed by c-suite from Blackstone and OpenAI alongside the world's best venture capital firms.

Join us in shaping the future of the Built World and exponentially accelerate your career in the process. We welcome you to do your life's work here.

About the role

Build's outputs are only as good as the operations that produce them. Every deliverable we ship is composed from modular operations and capabilities, and the quality of those modules is the quality of the company.

This role owns them: building new operations, improving the ones that underperform, and maintaining the library that everything else composes from. The bar is not 'plausible' or 'mostly right'.

You are accountable for a senior professional at a Tier 1 institution acting on Build's output without question.

You can expect to:

  • Build and own the modular operations that compose Build's workflows

  • Find where outputs fall short of the bar, and fix the underlying capability

  • Build the evaluation harness that proves whether a change made things better

  • Work with domain experts to encode what 'correct' actually means

  • Reduce the human review a workflow needs without lowering the standard

  • Keep the capability library composable as it grows

  • Spend as much time on failure analysis as on building

  • Own quality end-to-end, from prompt to delivered artifact

The individual we're looking for has built evaluations rather than just run them, and is comfortable that the bar here is set by someone else's expertise rather than their own.

How to win at Build

Growing Build requires a radically different approach to company building. As a company we're focused on one outcome: winning. That means we move fast, work with intensity, and demand excellence from ourselves. We operate with intensity but create an environment that allows for a lot of fun together. The result is that we're one of the fastest shipping teams in vertical AI, partnering with the best to automate the world around us.

Performance and teamwork are the core of Build's operation. We look for those who are able to do both, who often exhibit a particular ability for;

  • Velocity: You are relentless in asking the right questions to set direction. Once you find the right direction you go all-in.

  • Excellence: You obsess with being the best. For you, excellence is a non-negotiable standard rather than an aspiration.

  • Long time horizons: You choose to be in something for the long run, because that's where most of the returns are realized.

  • Ownership: You take full ownership of the outcomes. You're meticulous in your pursuits and believe you can actively shape your environment rather than adapt to it.

  • Customers: You have a passion for the built world and those who shape it. You probably have a quirky hobby or story that relates to your love for building.

  • Integrity: You chose to do the right thing even when it isn't easy.

  • Trust: You only work with people you can trust because it's the only way to do truly extraordinary things.

  • Yield: You have a burning need to see a result on every action you take and you're always looking for routes to do more with less.

What we offer

  • Radical autonomy, real ownership: High standards. Minimal bureaucracy. You own problems end-to-end, choose how the work gets done, and are accountable for exceptional outcomes. Ownership is matched with meaningful, generous equity.

  • An accelerated founder's track: Build is for builders. If you want to learn what it actually takes to create a generational company - Product judgment, execution speed, and accountability - there is no faster path than building from zero when everything is for grabs.

  • Elite teammates, uncompromising bar: You work with people who think clearly, execute relentlessly, and take full ownership. The team you build becomes the company you build. Growth here is not just professional; it reshapes how you operate and in return how Build operates.

  • Perpetual adventure: We attract the strongest of the strange. Extraordinary experiences are part of the culture - from the food we eat together to the space we occupy. Intensity is intentional.

  • Shape the built world: We are rebuilding how the physical world gets made. Our software doesn't live in the abstract - it turns into real projects breaking ground because we exist. We work with the largest institutions, push the frontier of AI, and watch our decisions translate directly into the world around us.

  • Program development: Contributing to the development of the Bachelor's program in Intelligent Systems and Applied Computing, and assisting in recruiting students
  • Masterclasses and expert seminars: Conducting live sessions on computer systems, networks, cloud computing, embedded systems and IT security in English
  • Student supervision and examination formats: Providing academic guidance, mentoring, and support for project and research work; designing and evaluating portfolio assessments, exams, and bachelor's theses
  • Applied research: Conducting practice-oriented research and transfer projects in the areas of distributed systems, cloud and edge computing, and cybersecurity – in cooperation with industry and research institutions
  • Funding and cooperation: Initiating research collaborations and acquiring third-party funding to strengthen applied research at our university
  • Publications and presentations: Publishing research findings in academic journals and at relevant conferences, as well as representing the university at specialist presentations and industry events
  • Transfer: Willingness to participate in research-related product developments, founding/start-up ventures, and patent applications
  • University development: Contributing to the university's academic self-governance, helping to further develop the range of study programs, and participating in international collaboration

recruitment and qualification requirements

The recruitment requirements for professors are governed by § 25 of the Lower Saxony Higher Education Act (NHG):
  • A completed university degree
  • Pedagogical-didactic aptitude confirmed through practical experience
  • Special aptitude for in-depth independent scholarly work, generally evidenced by an above-average doctorate in the fields of computer science, computer engineering, IT security or related fields
  • Special achievements in the application or development of scientific findings and methods over at least five years of professional practice, of which at least three years must have been carried out outside the higher education sector – preferably in systems engineering, cloud/infrastructure, embedded systems, or cybersecurity roles in industry

in addition, we assume

  • The ability and willingness to conduct teaching, research, and transfer activities in English.
  • Willingness to develop and further build higher education teaching competencies – particularly in (generative) AI-supported teaching.

in addition, we value

  • Innovative spirit in teaching: Motivation to develop and apply new didactic formats in systems, infrastructure and security education
  • Interdisciplinary openness: Readiness to collaborate with colleagues in applied computing and AI, digital business transformation, and immersive design
  • Practice and transfer orientation: Proven experience in industry or research projects related to systems, infrastructure, and cybersecurity
  • International perspective: Experience in international contexts or motivation to integrate international systems and security projects into teaching and research.
  • Commitment to institutional development: Willingness to actively shape the foundation and growth of a new university
  • Research profile: A visible research focus in distributed systems, cloud/edge computing, or cybersecurity
  • Knowledge and technology transfer: Understanding research as a bridge between science, industry, and society

what we offer

  • The opportunity to shape the development of a new university and its programmes right from its foundation.
  • A professorship with a clear focus on teaching, quality assurance, and applied research.
  • Interdisciplinary collaboration with colleagues in applied computing and AI, digital business transformation, and immersive design.
  • Modern digital infrastructure and an innovative environment without outdated structures.
  • Collaboration with the Center for Higher Education Teaching (Kompetenzzentrum Lehre) at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg on the development of higher education teaching competencies.
  • Fully remote from Germany or abroad (German working hours) or hybrid from Hanover, Munich or Leipzig
  • Flexible working hours with core working hours – medical appointments, childcare, and other important commitments are no problem
  • Fixed salary + performance-based bonus + €100 per month (for full-time employees) towards a company pension plan after 6 months + 15% employer contribution to your own payments + attractive employee discounts
  • 1 additional day of paid leave per year for volunteering
  • Annual health budget of €600 (for full-time employees) after 6 months + access to more than 13,000 fitness and wellness facilities through EGYM Wellpass
  • Regular team events and shared experiences
  • Plenty of autonomy, varied responsibilities, and a culture that encourages new ideas and innovation

application documents and further information

  • Please submit your application, together with the required documents, in English via our online portal. You can access the online portal through the "Auf diese Stelle bewerben" button. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications submitted by post or email.
  • The following application documents are expected; mandatory documents are marked with *:
    • *Cover letter
    • *CV (including an overview of previous employment since your first university degree, providing information on subject-related and application-oriented professional experience relevant to the advertised professorship; supporting documents such as employment references are welcome)
    • *Final certificate from the last general education school attended
    • *Certificates and/or diplomas for academic degrees (e.g., diploma, bachelor's, master's, doctorate)
    • *List of teaching activities
    • *Evidence of pedagogical-didactic aptitude (e.g., certificates for higher education teaching training, evaluation results of courses taught, teaching-related awards or scholarships)
    • *List of research activities
    • *List of publications and, where applicable, presentations
    • If applicable, list of third-party funding acquisitions
    • If applicable, list of international experience and cooperations
  • Application documents must be submitted as scans. Please use the upload fields provided in the online portal. For your cover letter, use the "Anschreiben" upload; for your CV, use the "Lebenslauf" upload; and for your employment references, use the "Arbeitszeugnis" upload. For all other documents, please use the "Andere" upload.
  • The recognition of foreign educational qualifications requires proof of equivalence. Initial points of contact can be found via the portal www.anerkennung-in-deutschland.de or
  • Equal opportunity and diversity are actively promoted and practiced at VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung). This position is explicitly open to people of all genders (m/f/d). Applications from female scientists are expressly welcomed.
  • Application costs will not be reimbursed.
In the further course of the appointment procedure, candidates may be asked, upon request, to give a teaching session, outline a research project, and complete at least one interview.

By submitting your application documents, you consent to them being forwarded to the Appointment Committee. Within the appointment procedure, certain persons/committee members have the right to inspect the documents. These include members of the Presidential Board, the Senate, the University Council, and the Appointment Committee, as well as the sponsoring institution (velpTEC GmbH). Furthermore, the Officer for Equality and Diversity, where applicable the Officer for (Severe) Disability, and the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture have the right to inspect the application documents. Application documents submitted to VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung) are handled in accordance with data protection requirements and are used and stored exclusively for the purposes of the appointment procedure. They will not be passed on to third parties. Upon conclusion of the appointment procedure, the application documents will be destroyed in compliance with the relevant data protection requirements. For any data protection questions, the data protection officers of velpTEC GmbH () are happy to assist you.

your contacts

description:
Thank you for your interest in joining Solventum. Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. At Solventum, people are at the heart of every innovation we pursue. Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. While we continue updating the Solventum Careers Page and applicant materials, some documents may still reflect legacy branding. Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: applies to any personal information you submit. As it was with 3M, at Solventum all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Job Description:

Acute Wound Healing Specialist

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

Solventum enables clinicians to not just treat wounds, but to advance healing. To support that, you will serve as a consultative wound healing expert and primary contact for hospital wound care decision makers. You’ll educate clinicians, drive adoption of Solventum solutions, expand therapy utilization, and coordinate patient transition of care.

As an Acute Wound Healing Specialist, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

  • Routinely consulting with clinicians on safe and effective use of Solventum products

  • Routinely attending procedures and placements in the hospital care setting

  • Delivering sustainable business growth based on sales targets through account and territory management

  • Identifying and solving customer financial & clinical priorities

  • Educating clinicians on the safe and effective use of Solventum products, including inservicing

  • Building and maintaining relationships with key clinical and economic stakeholders

  • Use clinical and economic evidence to advocate for and grow therapy adoption, including advanced solutions and new product introductions

  • Persuading key stakeholders to advocate for proposed solutions and products

  • Providing customer support and service

  • Demonstrating proficiency upon successful completion of sales training program

  • Leveraging company software for planning, pipeline management, and utilization tracking.

  • Representing Solventum at conferences, trade shows, and symposiums

Driving Requirements:

This position requires the use of a personal vehicle for company business and participation in Solventum’s Fixed and Variable Reimbursement (FAVR) program. As a condition of employment, candidates must successfully complete a pre-hire motor vehicle record (MVR) review and maintain ongoing eligibility, including compliance with Solventum’s driver policy, insurance requirements, and annual policy sign-off. Ongoing monitoring of motor vehicle history will be conducted.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher AND 2 years of sales and/or clinical experience

OR

  • High School Diploma/GED from AND 4 years of sales and/or clinical experience

AND

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

  • Experience with Microsoft Office applications (i.e. Excel, Power Point, Outlook)

  • Current, valid Driver’s License.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Proven track record of sales quota & target attainment

  • Prior wound care or medical device sales experience

  • Demonstrated expertise in establishing strong customer relationships with key influencers (i.e. surgeons)

  • Proven experience in territory management & business planning

  • Strong understanding of clinical value drivers across care areas

  • Customer focused selling and closing

  • Experience navigating complex selling cycles

  • Completion of a formal sales training program

  • Experience using a CRM (i.e. Salesforce)

  • Experience navigating new product introductions and the value analysis process

  • Outstanding data and analytical skills

Additional Requirements

In this role, you may be required to enter healthcare or other third-party facilities. Those facilities may, in turn, require you to possess certain licenses, vaccinations, and/or other credentials or qualifications (collectively “prerequisites to entry”) for regulatory, safety, or other business reasons. All information will be kept in accordance with applicable law and Solventum policies. In order to respond to the prerequisites to entry, Solventum may share your information with the providers of medical screens, vaccinations, or verifications as well as the healthcare or other third-party facilities requiring the prerequisites to entry.

Work location: Remote in sale territory

Travel: Field-based role with up to 20% overnight travel anticipated (may vary based on territory)

Relocation Assistance: May be authorized

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

Supporting Your Well-being

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental & Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.).
