title: Director of Engineering - DTC Platform Engineering
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy.

Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.

YOUR MISSION

The Director of Engineering - DTC Platform Engineering leads the organisation responsible for the shared engineering platforms, cloud foundations, integration capabilities, quality and performance engineering services, and developer tooling that enable DTC product teams to build and deliver secure, scalable and reliable software. This is a foundational leadership role: every product team, every consumer-facing capability, and every commerce transaction depends on the platforms, pipelines, and practices this organisation owns and operates.

You will lead a cross-functional organisation spanning DevOps & CI/CD, Application Security, Test Automation, Enterprise Integrations, Performance Engineering, and Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure. You will work with the SRE & Operations team to define observability standards, SLO enablement, resilience requirements and production-readiness controls. Your remit is to ensure our engineering platform accelerates product delivery velocity without sacrificing quality or resilience - and that our cloud infrastructure is secure, cost-efficient, and built to scale. This role is a key engineering partner to all three product engineering organisations: Consumer Experience, Consumer Intelligence & Engagement, and Core Commerce Platform.

Key Responsibilities & Scope of Ownership:

• DevOps & CI/CD - build, test, and deployment pipelines, developer tooling, GitOps workflows and release engineering.

• Performance Engineering - load testing, performance profiling, capacity planning, and Core Web Vitals governance.

• Quality Engineering & Test Automation - Enterprise quality strategy, automated testing frameworks, release quality governance, test platforms, and engineering quality standards.

• Integration Architecture & Platform Services - API management, integration architecture, event-driven platforms, shared services, and platform governance.

• Cloud Architecture - infrastructure design, cloud provisioning, Kubernetes platform, networking, security, and cost optimisation.

• Security & Compliance Engineering - Infrastructure security, secrets management, vulnerability management, data protection and security assurance.

Platform Vision & Engineering Strategy

• Define and execute the multi-year Platform Engineering strategy by establishing the technology vision for cloud infrastructure, developer experience, quality engineering, enterprise integrations and automation across the DTC estate.

• Build a platform that acts as a strategic enabler for product engineering teams: reducing toil, accelerating delivery cycles, and raising the quality and reliability bar across all consumer-facing systems.

• Own the platform engineering roadmap and promote adoption of platform capabilities.

• Drive the adoption of platform engineering as a product discipline - treating internal engineering teams as customers and building self-service infrastructure and tooling accordingly.

DevOps & CI/CD

• Increase adoption of CI/CD capabilities across all product engineering organisations - enabling fast, safe, and automated delivery from code commit to production.

• Govern branching strategies, environment topology (dev, staging, UAT, prod), and deployment runbooks across all product teams.

• GitOps-based deployment workflows, progressive delivery patterns (canary releases, blue-green deployments, feature flags), and trunk-based development practices.

• Drive developer experience (DevEx) improvements - fast build times, reliable pipelines, self-service environment provisioning, and clear developer documentation.

• Establish release governance processes that balance deployment speed with change risk management, particularly for high-impact commerce events such as sale periods and product launches.

Quality Engineering & Test Automation

• Define and execute Quality Engineering strategy across all DTC platforms, embedding quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

• Define and evolve shared test automation frameworks covering functional, regression, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.

• Establish quality standards, metrics, and governance to improve release confidence and reduce production defects.

• Enable engineering teams through reusable testing capabilities, tooling, and quality engineering best practices.

Performance Engineering

• Define and execute the Performance Engineering strategy, ensuring applications and platforms meet scalability, reliability, and user experience objectives.

• Establish performance standards, capacity planning practices, and non-functional requirements across all product domains.

• Lead performance optimization initiatives across applications, APIs, databases, infrastructure, and consumer experiences.

• Govern performance KPIs, Core Web Vitals, and platform readiness for major business events and traffic peaks.

Security & Compliance Engineering

• Own the security engineering strategy across cloud infrastructure, platform services, and software delivery pipelines.

• Drive DevSecOps adoption through automated security controls, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement.

• Implement and govern platform controls for identity, secrets management, cloud security posture and compliance automation in collaboration with the central infrastructure team.

• Partner with enterprise security teams to ensure adherence to security compliance requirements.

• Foster a culture of secure-by-design engineering across all product and platform teams.

Integration Architecture & Engineering

• Own the integration platform vision & strategy, capability roadmap, priorities & adoption across the DTC ecosystem.

• Lead adoption of API-first and event-driven platform capabilities that accelerate delivery and reduce integration complexity.

• Establish reusable integration frameworks, shared services, and platform governance to drive consistency and operational excellence.

• Partner with Product Engineering, Data, and Architecture teams to ensure integration capabilities support current and future business needs.

AI Engineering Platforms & Automation

• Define and evolve the strategy for AI-enabled engineering platforms, capabilities and practices across the DTC engineering organisation.

• Establish reusable platform capabilities, standards and guardrails that enable teams to safely adopt AI technologies and accelerate delivery.

• Drive the adoption of AI-assisted and automated engineering practices across the software development lifecycle, improving developer productivity, quality and operational efficiency.

• Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platform capabilities and engineering practices, translating them into scalable and practical solutions that create business and engineering value.

• Ensure AI-enabled capabilities are implemented with appropriate controls for security, compliance, observability, cost management and responsible use.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

• Lead, mentor, and grow a multi-disciplinary team of DevOps engineers, QA automation engineers, performance engineers, cloud architects, security engineers.

• Operate as a trusted platform partner to the Consumer Experience, Consumer Intelligence & Engagement, and Core Commerce Platform engineering directors - understanding their needs and proactively improving the platform beneath them.

• Build strong relationships with Security, Finance (FinOps), and Infrastructure procurement stakeholders.

• Represent platform engineering in architecture review boards, incident reviews, and engineering leadership forums.

YOUR TALENT

  • 15+ years of engineering experience, with at least 5 years in a senior engineering leadership role owning platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering organisations.
  • Proven ability to define platform architecture strategy, technology standards, infrastructure modernisation roadmaps, and engineering guardrails that support scalability, resilience, and security.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, self-service engineering capabilities, and software delivery practices that improve developer productivity, reliability, governance, and time-to-market.
  • Experience in Cloud Native Infrastructure - Kubernetes, compute & runtime services, Cloud CDN, IAM, VPC, and monitoring & observability tooling. GCP experience preferred.
  • Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines at scale - GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, ArgoCD, Spinnaker, or equivalent.
  • Experience in Kubernetes platform engineering - cluster operations, Helm, service mesh, and workload autoscaling.
  • Demonstrable test automation leadership - experience defining quality engineering strategy and building shared test automation frameworks (Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, RestAssured, k6, or equivalent).
  • Performance engineering expertise - load testing tools (k6, Gatling, JMeter), APM platforms (Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace), and front-end performance profiling.
  • Infrastructure-as-code proficiency - Terraform, Pulumi, or equivalent; GitOps workflows with ArgoCD or Flux.
  • Understanding of modern security engineering practices, including secrets management, application security (SAST/DAST), cloud security posture management, vulnerability management, data protection, and secure software delivery.
  • Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Leadership Expectations:

At PUMA, Directors are expected to operate as enterprise leaders who shape strategy, build capability, and create an environment where teams can deliver exceptional outcomes at speed and scale. Successful leaders combine commercial acumen, technical excellence, and people leadership while embodying the mindset and behaviours that define PUMA's culture.

Strategic Thinking & Vision

  • Translate ambitious business goals into clear, executable technology strategies and roadmaps.
  • Demonstrate the courage to challenge conventional thinking and advocate for innovative solutions that create long-term value.
  • Operate effectively in ambiguity, providing clarity, direction, and confidence for teams and stakeholders.
  • Balance immediate business priorities with long-term scalability, sustainability, and consumer impact.

Ownership & Accountability

  • Take end-to-end ownership of outcomes, driving execution with determination and a relentless focus on results.
  • Set high standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of accountability.
  • Navigate setbacks and changing priorities with resilience, maintaining momentum through complexity and uncertainty.
  • Make difficult decisions when required and stand behind them with conviction and integrity.

People & Team Leadership

  • Build, develop, and retain diverse, high-performing teams capable of delivering at scale.
  • Foster an environment of trust, inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect where individuals can thrive.
  • Create opportunities for learning, growth, and continuous development while empowering teams with autonomy and accountability.
  • Celebrate successes, recognise contributions, and cultivate a culture where high performance and enjoyment go hand in hand.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong partnerships across Product, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and Business teams to achieve shared outcomes.
  • Influence effectively across all levels of the organisation through credibility, transparency, and strong communication.
  • Demonstrate confidence in decision-making while remaining open to challenge, feedback, and diverse perspectives.
  • Lead with a team-first mindset, breaking down silos and enabling collaboration across functions and geographies.

Innovation & Continuous Learning

  • Champion modern engineering practices, AI-native ways of working, and a culture of experimentation.
  • Encourage curiosity, learning, and thoughtful risk-taking to unlock new opportunities for consumers and the business.
  • Create space for innovation while maintaining a disciplined approach to execution and delivery.
  • Continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, operational maturity, and consumer experience.

Commercial & Consumer Mindset

  • Understand the connection between technology decisions, consumer experience, and business performance.
  • Make decisions that balance innovation, speed, quality, and commercial impact.
  • Maintain a strong consumer-first perspective, ensuring technology investments create meaningful value for consumers.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment and confidence when translating business priorities into engineering outcomes.

Building PUMA's Future

  • Act as a visible culture builder and role model as PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organisation.
  • Embrace the opportunity to build teams, capabilities, and ways of working from the ground up.
  • Lead with energy, optimism, and purpose, inspiring others to contribute to a shared vision and ambitious goals.
  • Foster an environment where bold thinking, determination, collaboration, and enjoyment are all essential ingredients of success.

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex,

gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at

PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.

At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal

opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience.To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.

PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000

employees worldwide.

title: Network & Systems Administrator
description:
Are you a tech-savvy problem solver who likes owning IT end-to-end and helping real people every day? We're seeking a Network & Systems Administrator to be the technical backbone of IT support across Freelancer's global offices.

This is a hands-on, on-site Sydney role. Senior escalation support is the daily core; monitoring, backups, Google Workspace, office networks and self-scoped improvement projects are the ownership layer. You'll be the senior point of the support function — handling the escalations the rest of the team can't — while keeping our existing infrastructure healthy and finding smarter ways to run it. You'll have genuine autonomy: you spot the problems, scope the fix, and deliver it yourself. You'll need to be resourceful — we favour practical, cost-effective fixes, open-source tooling, scripting and clear documentation over throwing a budget at every problem.

You'll work alongside our Systems Engineering team and get visibility into the mature platform side of the business, while owning the office IT/support function long term.

Working with us, you can change lives every single day. Everything we do contributes to improving the lives of our users on a global scale. Our mission is to provide one billion jobs. Not many companies actually make a difference like Freelancer does in providing opportunities and income to people all around the world.

Key Responsibilities:

- Own end-to-end IT support across our offices — the full L1–L3 gamut, primarily as the escalation point for the harder technical issues other staff can't resolve. This is the core of the role and it's customer-facing.

- Support Sydney HQ and our remote global offices across Manila, London, Vancouver and San Francisco, coordinating with remote hands where needed.

- Run monitoring and alerting on our existing stack — respond to incidents, investigate alerts, and keep services healthy and available across multi-site, multi-timezone offices.

- Own backups and recovery — make sure backups run, are verifiable, and can actually be restored (Synology NAS, image-level VM backups, offsite/cloud copies).

- Administer Google Workspace across multiple domains — users, groups, Shared Drives, licensing, security settings, onboarding/offboarding and access requests (GAM and the admin console).

- Administer and maintain office network infrastructure — OPNsense/pfSense firewalls (incl. HA/CARP), IPsec VPNs, VLANs and UniFi wireless — for high availability across sites.

- Identify problems and gaps yourself, scope them, and deliver the solutions largely on your own — with a strong bias to open-source and resourceful, cost-effective fixes.

- Maintain asset inventory and clear documentation; collaborate with other departments on their technology needs.

What You'll Grow Into

Our Systems Engineering team owns the mature platform side — infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Puppet), Prometheus monitoring, PCI-DSS compliance and more. You won't run that day to day, but you'll work closely with the team that does, get real insight into how it's built and operated, and have the runway to grow into it over time.

What We're Looking For

Technical Skills

- Demonstrated experience in a senior IT support / sysadmin role, comfortable owning escalations on your own

- Comfortable supporting Windows, macOS and Linux

- Solid networking — VLANs, firewalls, IPsec/VPNs, DNS, routing; OPNsense/pfSense and UniFi a strong plus (rule-based/CLI firewalls, not just cloud dashboards)

- Google Workspace administration experience (GAM a plus); other SaaS/cloud (AWS) welcome

- Hands-on experience with backups, virtualization and storage

- Experience running monitoring/alerting and responding to incidents

- Scripting and automation (Python/Bash) to make your own work repeatable — or genuine eagerness to learn

- Solid grasp of cybersecurity principles

- Strong diagnostic and root-cause skills on complex, cross-system issues — able to get to the bottom of things with no vendor and no one above you to escalate to

Soft Skills

- Exceptional English communication — proficient at writing documentation and explaining difficult technical concepts to non-technical people

- Genuinely enjoys customer-facing support and being the person people come to

- Self-directed, resourceful and well-organized; able to prioritize a busy support queue and longer projects at the same time, without relying on heavy tooling or process

- Strong collaboration skills across departments and time zones

What we bring to the table:

A supportive work environment with meritocratic opportunities for career growth - we promote from within!

Access to continuous learning and professional development.

Weekly Town Halls with the all-important Q&A session with the CEO (you really can ask him anything)!

Friday lunches - We finish each week with a catered lunch. Each time we offer food from a different local restaurant.

Fully stocked kitchens… and yes, we do have beer taps (the bar has a killer view!)

Hack-a-thons - Get hacking and programming in this quarterly company-wide contest where teams create solutions to existing problems and win prizes. The 2-day event is filled with games, events, shows, food and more.

Fun events (we once built a soccer stadium in the office with two tonnes of turf…).

Our location at Grosvenor Place - Home of Freelancer HQ, this iconic building has harbour views, weekly complimentary classes/events, etc.

Just when you thought it couldn't get any better:

Change lives every day - Everything we do as part of our jobs contribute to improving the lives of our users on a global scale. Our mission is to provide one billion jobs. Not many companies actually make a difference like Freelancer does in providing opportunity and income to people all around the world.

Fast-track your career - We boast a meritocratic culture, renowned for hiring into senior roles from within and producing many business and product leaders in the technology industry.

If you're passionate about technology and enjoy helping people, we'd love to hear from you! Join us as a Network & Systems Administrator and be an essential part of our team, driving better solutions and experiences for our users.

title: Manufacturing Supervisor
description:
2 shifts available!Days: 6:30am-7:00pmorNights: 6:30pm-7:00am


Job description

Revere Copper Products is a 100% employee-owned company with more than one million square feet of manufacturing space in Rome, NY, and an exciting expansion underway in Mebane, NC. We serve a diverse range of industries including architectural, electrical, telecommunications, HVAC, industrial equipment, and emerging markets.


As we continue to grow, we are seeking leaders who are energized by building teams, developing talent, driving accountability, and creating operational excellence in a rapidly evolving manufacturing environment.


Position Summary

We are looking for a highly engaged, hands-on Operations Supervisor to lead manufacturing operations in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment. This role is ideal for a leader who is comfortable navigating change, building processes, developing people, and driving results while maintaining a strong presence on the production floor.


The successful candidate will be a visible leader who spends the majority of their time supporting employees where the work happens, coaching performance, removing barriers, and ensuring safe, efficient, high-quality production. This individual must be able to balance strong employee relationships with clear accountability and performance expectations.


Experience in metals manufacturing, rolling mills, metal processing, or similar industrial manufacturing environments is strongly preferred.


Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing manufacturing team in a rapidly growing operation.
  • Establish a culture of accountability, engagement, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain a consistent presence on the plant floor, providing real-time coaching, support, and direction.
  • Develop strong working relationships with employees while setting and reinforcing clear performance expectations.
  • Address performance issues promptly and professionally while recognizing and reinforcing positive performance.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, training, and development efforts to meet growing business demands.
  • Lead through change and effectively communicate evolving processes, priorities, and operational requirements.
  • Create an environment where employees feel respected, heard, and empowered to contribute.

Safety Leadership

  • Champion a proactive safety culture through daily employee engagement and hazard awareness.
  • Lead safety discussions, investigations, corrective actions, and follow-up activities.
  • Ensure compliance with all company safety policies and procedures.
  • Hold employees accountable for maintaining a safe work environment.

Production & Operations

  • Lead daily production activities to achieve safety, quality, productivity, and delivery objectives.
  • Ensure production schedules and operational priorities are executed effectively.
  • Drive operational discipline and consistency across shifts.
  • Identify and remove obstacles that impact productivity and employee performance.
  • Support startup activities, process improvements, and operational growth initiatives.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure adherence to quality standards, operating procedures, and process controls.
  • Train and coach employees on standardized work methods and best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives designed to improve safety, quality, cost, and efficiency.
  • Utilize data and employee feedback to identify opportunities for process improvement.

Equipment Reliability

  • Partner with Maintenance and Reliability teams to ensure equipment availability and performance.
  • Support preventive maintenance initiatives and reinforce operator ownership of equipment care.
  • Escalate equipment concerns and drive timely resolution of operational issues.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of manufacturing leadership experience in a supervisory, team lead, or production management role.
  • Experience leading hourly production employees in a manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated success building strong teams while maintaining accountability for performance and results.
  • Strong coaching, communication, conflict resolution, and employee development skills.
  • Proven ability to lead in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and evolving processes.
  • Ability to make sound decisions and drive execution under pressure.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and manufacturing reporting systems.

Preferred

  • Metals manufacturing, copper processing, steel, aluminum, rolling mill, or other heavy industrial manufacturing experience.
  • Experience supporting startup, expansion, or high-growth manufacturing operations.
  • Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing, or Behavioral Management experience.
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, or related field.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • Visible and approachable leader who prefers being on the production floor rather than behind a desk.
  • Builds trust while holding employees accountable.
  • Thrives in an environment of rapid growth and constant change.
  • Strong sense of urgency and ownership.
  • Comfortable developing inexperienced employees and building strong teams.
  • Focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Leads by example and creates a culture of safety, respect, and results.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and move throughout the manufacturing facility for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with varying temperatures, noise levels, and industrial conditions.
  • Ability to work additional hours as business needs require.

Work Schedule

This position follows a 2-2-3 rotating 12-hour shift schedule, providing employees with every other weekend off.

Schedule Rotation:

  • Week 1: Work 2 days, Off 2 days, Work 3 days
  • Week 2: Off 2 days, Work 2 days, Off 3 days
  • 12-hour shifts
  • 36 hours worked one week, 48 hours worked the next
  • Average of 42 hours per week
  • Every other weekend is a 3-day weekend

Benefits

  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

Why Join Revere?

This is an opportunity to join a growing operation at a pivotal time. We are looking for leaders who want to build teams, shape culture, improve processes, and make a lasting impact in a manufacturing environment experiencing significant growth and transformation. If you're a hands-on manufacturing leader who enjoys developing people and driving results, we'd like to hear from This is not a desk job. Successful candidates will spend the majority of their time on the manufacturing floor engaging with employees, solving problems, developing talent, and driving performance.

Location

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Our process is designed to move fast:

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Vill du arbeta vaken natt som personlig assistent i Trollhättan?
description:
Kille på 30 år med medfödda flerfunktionshinder söker personlig assistent för vakna nätter.

Du som söker behöver vara ansvarsfull, lyhörd, empatisk och ha lätt för att ta till dig information och att samarbeta. Du måste behärska svenska väl i tal och skrift då viktig muntlig och skriftlig information förekommer. Vi ser gärna att du har någon tidigare erfarenhet av flerfunktionshinder och epilepsi men det är framför allt personlig lämplighet som avgör. Vill du göra verklig skillnad för en kille med stora behov kan du vara den som vi söker!

Du börjar jobba på en timanställning som senare kan komma att övergå till en visstidsanställning så länge assistansuppdraget varar med en tjänstgöringsgrad på 60 % om samarbetet går bra. Ett stort plus är om du kan hoppa in extra vid behov. Passen ligger mestadels kl. 21-08 men även kl. 18-07 förekommer. Var tredje helg ingår.

Låter detta som något för dig? Skicka då in en ansökan med personligt brev, referenser och motivera gärna varför du tror att just du skulle passa bra till den här tjänsten.

GIL samordnar personlig assistans sedan 1989. För oss handlar personlig assistans om att skapa förutsättningar för att en person med funktionsnedsättning ska kunna leva det liv hen själv vill leva. I många uppdrag är den assistansberättigade själv arbetsledare, medan andra har utsett en ställföreträdande arbetsledare. Uppdrag och roller ser olika ut beroende på verksamhet och funktion.

GIL:s kontor ger stöd inom bland annat arbetsledning, administration, ekonomi, HR och utbildning. Tillsammans bidrar vi till att vardagen fungerar för både assistansberättigade och medarbetare inom kooperativet.

För att få och behålla trygga och engagerade medarbetare satsar GIL på utbildning och gemensamma aktiviteter.

title: Athletic Strategy Consultant (Men's Golf)
description:
Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Role

Crimson Education is currently growing our Global Athletics team and we are looking for a sport-specific Athletic Strategy Consultant (Men's Golf) who has a passion for coaching, mentoring and supporting the next generation of collegiate student-athletes heading to the US. This role will be a contract or part-time job to begin with and fully remote. The work hours and number of clients can be determined by your schedule. There is potential for this role to grow into a full-time position in the future.

What are the main responsibilities for this role?

  • Work closely with student-athletes within your sport who are aiming to play collegiate athletics in the US, developing meaningful mentoring relationships.

  • Consistently meet with each student-athlete through video chat. The expected meeting cadence will be per 2-4 weeks in active recruitment months, and per 3-6 weeks in their earlier years.

  • Maintain consistent communication with student-athletes via our tech platform and through email.

  • Hold student-athletes accountable for organisational and developmental tools, such as training logs and competition reflections.

  • Research and discuss the best camps/showcases/opportunities for the student-athlete to attend in order to increase their exposure to relevant US college coaches.

  • Help student-athletes maximize their talent using your knowledge and resources to further develop them as athletes.

  • Work with student-athletes to develop a clear, personalized and intentional plan for their US College Athletic recruitment, giving realistic expectations on US school lists.

  • Help student-athletes navigate and stay proactive throughout their recruiting journey.

  • Advocate for student-athletes with US college coaches when appropriate.

  • Update parents on progress of the student-athletes when relevant.

What skills and experience are required?

  • Experience playing and/or coaching at a top US-based university

  • Knowledge of US College and University options (i.e., NCAA D1, D2, D3)

  • Knowledge of SAT/ACT, Academic Requirements, and NCAA Eligibility

  • Detailed understanding of the US College Recruiting process

  • Exceptional emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills

  • Strong strategic planning and communication skills

  • Excellent verbal communication

  • A passion for mentoring teenagers

Why work for Crimson?

  • Rapidly growing start up, with a flexible working environment where you will be empowered to structure how you work

  • Limitless development and exposure - our internal promotions/role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year

  • $1000 individual training budget per year, we love to ‘Level Up’ (it’s one of our core values)!

  • Psychologist on staff

  • Insightful fireside chats and workshops to help support our high-performing and ambitious team

  • Radical Candor is a feedback approach we live by

  • We’re a global player with 28 markets (and growing) across the globe. Most roles have the option to work from one of our many offices or remotely!

If you're passionate about growing in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to work with cutting-edge technology, then we'd love to hear from you!

title: Associate Director of Data and Modeling
description:
(ID: 2026-3404)

Axle Informatics is a bioscience and information technology company committed to accelerating biomedical discovery through data science, software engineering, scientific computing, and research technology. We work alongside scientists and federal health partners to solve complex technical problems, create durable research infrastructure, and make advanced computational methods more accessible to the people who can use them to advance science.

We believe the best technical organizations combine curiosity with discipline. They make room for experimentation, but they also finish what they start. They build systems that others can understand and sustain. They share knowledge, invest in people, and measure success by what their work enables the research community to accomplish.

If building that kind of organization, and helping it solve some of the most difficult data and computational challenges in biomedical research, excites you as much as it excites us, we would love to talk.

Benefits We Offer:

  • 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for Employees
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • 401K match up to 5%
  • Educational Benefits for Career Growth
  • Employee Referral Bonus
  • Flexible Spending Accounts:
    • Healthcare (FSA)
    • Parking Reimbursement Account (PRK)
    • Dependent Care Assistant Program (DCAP)
    • Transportation Reimbursement Account (TRN)

Position Overview

Axle Informatics is excited to open the search for an Associate Director of Data and Modeling to help shape the next generation of data-intensive biomedical research. This role will lead teams working across data engineering, artificial intelligence and machine learning, scientific computing, and modeling and simulation to build capabilities that make complex research data more useful, reproducible, and actionable.

The goals this position fills are ambitious; turn difficult scientific and technical problems into durable systems, create the conditions for highly technical teams to do their best work, and ensure that promising ideas become reliable capabilities that researchers can trust.

This is not a role for someone who has only advised technical teams from a distance. The Associate Director must bring the judgment that comes from having personally designed, built, deployed, and operated complex data, software, AI/ML, or scientific computing systems. You will be expected to engage deeply enough to recognize weak assumptions, ask the questions that change a design, help teams resolve difficult technical tradeoffs, and know when an experimental approach is ready to become part of a production environment.

At the same time, the role is larger than any single architecture, model, or platform. You will build and lead multidisciplinary teams, establish shared technical standards, develop emerging leaders, strengthen the operating systems that make delivery predictable, and create reusable approaches that can serve multiple research programs. You will work closely with scientists, engineers, program leaders, security and privacy teams, and federal health partners to connect technical excellence with meaningful scientific outcomes.

Our vision is a future where data, models, simulations, workflows, and analytical tools can be used together with less friction and greater confidence. We value scientific rigor, technical craftsmanship, reproducibility, openness, and service to the research community. If those values energize you, we would love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities: Summary

  • Technical Strategy and Stewardship: Set the technical direction for data platforms, AI/ML systems, scientific computing environments, and modeling capabilities. Establish reference architectures and reusable implementation patterns that help teams make sound decisions while preserving room for experimentation. Decide when to build, modernize, adopt, or partner, and make those decisions with long-term sustainability in mind.

  • Production Data Platforms: Guide the design and operation of data systems that can ingest, transform, harmonize, and serve large, heterogeneous scientific and health datasets. Build repeatable approaches for data quality, validation, terminology translation, lineage, versioning, documentation, and change control so that data products remain understandable and trustworthy as programs evolve.

  • AI/ML and Emerging Methods: Lead the development of AI/ML capabilities where they can create measurable scientific or operational value, including predictive modeling, computer vision, natural language processing, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic workflows. Require thoughtful evaluation, traceability, privacy safeguards, human review where appropriate, and monitoring that continues after deployment.

  • Modeling, Simulation, and Scientific Computing: Build a sustainable modeling and simulation practice that supports both specialized scientific work and reusable organizational capability. Establish standards for reproducible workflows, versioned inputs and environments, compute strategy, and scientific validation. Partner effectively with domain experts when the deepest subject matter expertise resides outside your own discipline.

  • From Research to Reliable Systems: Help teams cross the difficult gap between promising prototypes and dependable production capabilities. Strengthen engineering practices around testing, CI/CD, containerization, observability, release management, incident response, documentation, and technical debt. Preserve the creativity of research environments while introducing the discipline required for systems that others depend on.

  • Technical Organization Leadership: Build and lead multidisciplinary teams spanning software engineering, data engineering, machine learning engineering, data science, and computational science. Create clear roles, strong technical leadership paths, and expectations that reward both rigor and collaboration. Develop managers and technical leads who can make good decisions without creating single points of failure.

  • Program Execution and Quality: Create an operating cadence that makes complex technical delivery visible and predictable. Establish clear priorities, risk checkpoints, release criteria, ownership, and measures of progress. Help teams sequence work thoughtfully, address technical debt without losing momentum, and communicate tradeoffs before they become surprises.

  • Governance, Security, and Responsible Use: Work with security, privacy, governance, and scientific stakeholders to ensure that data and AI capabilities are appropriate for sensitive and highly governed environments. Promote practical controls for access, auditability, intended use, model review, data minimization, privacy, and responsible AI without allowing governance to become disconnected from how systems are actually built and used.

  • Open Science and Community Engagement: Encourage technical publication, conference participation, open-source contribution, and active engagement with the broader research software community. Support continued stewardship of reusable scientific platforms and tools, including Polus, and look for opportunities where open collaboration can increase impact beyond a single project or client.

  • Technical Growth and Partnership: Contribute to selected federal growth and proposal efforts as a senior technical leader. Shape credible solution architectures, technical approaches, staffing models, and implementation strategies. Help Axle pursue work that matches its technical strengths and can be executed with the same standards expected of its active programs.

Required Qualifications

  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning engineering, computational science, data science, or a closely related technical discipline.

  • Five or more years of leadership experience building and guiding multidisciplinary technical teams, including responsibility for hiring, technical direction, delivery, and staff development.

  • Demonstrated experience personally designing, building, deploying, and operating production-grade data, AI/ML, software, or scientific computing systems.

  • Strong technical judgment across modern data and AI architectures, distributed processing, containerized environments, CI/CD, MLOps or LLMOps, observability, and production operations.

  • Demonstrated success moving analytical or AI/ML work from research and prototyping into reliable production use, including evaluation, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and ongoing operational ownership.

  • Experience building or leading large and complex data pipelines with attention to interoperability, data quality, lineage, reproducibility, and repeatable transformation.

  • Experience leading modeling, simulation, scientific computing, or computational research work directly or in close partnership with scientific subject matter experts.

  • Ability to review technical designs, identify risk, challenge assumptions, resolve difficult engineering problems, and distinguish promising emerging methods from approaches that are not yet ready for production use.

  • Experience delivering technical systems in research-intensive, regulated, or high-governance environments involving sensitive data, security controls, privacy requirements, or formal technical oversight.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to move comfortably between detailed technical discussion and clear explanation for scientists, program leaders, executives, and government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in computer science, bioinformatics, computational biology, data science, engineering, applied mathematics, physics, or another quantitative discipline.

  • Prior experience as a software engineer, data engineer, machine learning engineer, computational scientist, or equivalent hands-on technical practitioner before moving into broader leadership.

  • Experience leading organizations of approximately 20 or more engineers, scientists, and technical specialists, including managers or senior technical leads.

  • Experience with biomedical or health data platforms and standards such as OMOP, FHIR, PCORnet, CDISC, or related clinical terminology systems.

  • Experience with high-performance computing, large-scale scientific workflows, workflow orchestration, containerized research environments, or petabyte-scale scientific data.

  • Experience deploying Generative AI capabilities with evaluation, retrieval, traceability, privacy controls, human review, monitoring, and appropriate safeguards.

  • Experience applying AI/ML to scientific imaging, genomics, proteomics, real-world data, clinical data, or other high-dimensional biomedical datasets.

  • Track record of technical publications, conference presentations, open-source contributions, patents, or other recognized technical leadership.

  • Experience working with NIH or other federal health and biomedical research organizations.

  • Experience serving as a technical or solution lead for federal proposals, capture efforts, or strategic partnerships.

title: Product Specialist
description:
LGG INDUSTRIAL

Our philosophy is that the success of our business is directly dependent upon the health and safety of our associates. We focus on maintaining a safe work environment and strive to achieve zero injuries through our safety-first culture. For more information, please visit


ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

Role Profile

Position: Product Specialist

Job Location: Remote – Must be based in the Eastern US Region (any state East of the Mississippi)

Job Type: Full-Time

Status: Exempt


Summary of the Role

The Product Specialist expands relationships with existing customers by directing and supporting collaborative sales efforts to grow one or more assigned product lines in one or more assigned end markets. The Product Specialist will assist Account or Strategic Account managers with closes on qualified customer opportunities, while actively collaborating with these team members. The Product Specialist works on the technical development of products, identifies business opportunities for products, and maintains awareness of competing products and market activity.


Reporting to the Director, Strategic Accounts, the Product Specialist is responsible for achieving sales targets in the assigned product lines and/or end markets, and for supporting the product-line success of an assigned team of Branches.


The Product Specialist provides product technical support for customers, Account Managers, and Branches. Advanced product knowledge and good problem-solving skills are required for this position. The Product Specialist may be requested to engage in activities such as classroom training, on-site training, product application, or to participate in company events such as product launches.


Responsibilities

  • Must maintain 100% commitment to safety policies and procedures
  • Supports the success and sales of the product business unit, of assigned geography or Branches and associated Account Managers, and Strategic Account customers.
  • Meets assigned targets for profitable sales growth in assigned product lines.
  • Provides product training and professional development to area account managers and inside sales representatives in order to enhance their product knowledge.
  • Lead demand-generating activities in the assigned market for the assigned product specialty.
  • Establish productive, professional relationships with key associates in assigned territory and customer accounts.
  • Coordinate the customer involvement of other company associates when needed, including support resources, purchasing, and management.
  • Recommends the application and function of products by reviewing product specifications and requirements and evaluating new product ideas.
  • Assesses market competition by comparing the company's product to competitors' products.
  • Assesses market activity by calling on customers with account managers and evaluating sales call results.
  • Provides product or end market training to improve product knowledge and grow sales.
  • Maintains professional and technical knowledge through continuing education; reviewing professional publications; and participating in industry groups.
  • Perform other duties as trained and qualified for.

Skills and Abilities

  • Research and analyze market conditions
  • Identify key competitors and customer trends
  • Articulate end market requirements and opportunities
  • Identify opportunities for product innovation and product enhancements
  • Support sales and marketing with the necessary product knowledge and technical expertise
  • Conduct product presentations
  • Develop sales tools and sales training material
  • Provide input for marketing collateral development
  • Implement sales plan in conjunction with all functions
  • Drive ongoing improvement in sales and profitability
  • Manage and communicate with cross functional teams
  • Manage product-related support, feedback and inquiries from customers
  • Coordinate market research to track customer feedback

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4-year College degree from an accredited institution or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 6 years of sales experience in a business-to-business, large/strategic customer segment; or a record of achievement in the Account Manager position
  • Product certification or equivalent technical credential
  • Reliable transportation is a must
  • Ability to travel 60%+ as required, including overnight travel
  • Ability to work nights and weekends, as required
  • Background checks and drug screening may be required (by Company, Customer or DOT requirements in working on-site and operating equipment as required or permitted by law)

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

This role includes a mix of office and field environments. A minimum of 60% of your work week will be spent in the field visiting customer sites, which may include warehouses, industrial facilities, or construction environments. Customer site visits may involve exposure to varying environmental conditions such as noise, temperature changes, or dust. The office environment may require using standard office equipment (such as computers, phones, and printers). Reasonable accommodations are available to support individuals with disabilities in performing the essential functions of this role.

  • Ability to work in a stationary position for extended periods of time.
  • Frequent operation of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other standard office equipment.
  • Ability to travel to customer locations and job sites as needed, which may involve driving or other modes of transportation.
  • Ability to move freely throughout the job site, including on occasional uneven surfaces, for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to ascend and descend ladders or stairs, as required.
  • Ability to comprehend and follow instructions and safety procedures.
  • Ability to read, write and communicate in English
  • Ability to comprehend documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, inventory sheets, and procedure manuals.
  • Occasional exposure to warehouse or shop floor environments, which may include noise, dust, and varying temperatures.
  • May involve occasional handling of products, samples, or materials when assisting with customer orders.
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), such as gloves, safety glasses, steel-toed footwear, hearing protection, or hard hats, depending on task or site conditions.

Total Rewards

  • Competitive compensation plan, with a bonus potential
  • Health Benefits: medical, dental, vision, short term and long-term disability – available 1st of month following the date of hire
  • 401k with company match
  • Paid vacation, holidays and sick time

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is our policy to employ qualified persons without regard for veteran or disability status.

Individuals are considered for employment, promotion, or training solely on their ability to perform the essential functions of the position.


Qualified Candidates Only. Although we appreciate your interest, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.


We will be accepting applications for this role through August 31, 2026.

title: AI Systems, Zoho & Automation Specialist - 2026
description:
AI Systems, Zoho & Automation Specialist

Remote · Part-time contract · Approximately 15–25 hours/week initially

Location: Remote within Latin America. Candidates based in Panama are preferred, but strong candidates elsewhere in Latin America are encouraged to apply.

Philip James Realty Corp. and The Panama Link are building an unusually broad technology and data ecosystem for a real-estate brokerage: AI-assisted knowledge retrieval, CRM and website automations, WhatsApp lead handling, property and public-registry data products, listing workflows, reporting, content production, and internal decision-support tools.

We are looking for a hands-on AI systems, Zoho, and automation specialist who can turn these projects into reliable, connected workflows. This is neither a pure prompt-engineering role nor a pure Zoho-administrator role. You should be comfortable designing AI-enabled systems, improving Zoho workflows, writing or reviewing code, integrating APIs, handling imperfect business data, and documenting systems so other people can operate them.

What you will do

  • Design and ship AI-enabled workflows using LLMs, RAG, agents, tool calling, and MCP where they are genuinely useful.
  • Connect websites, CRM, WhatsApp/Kapso, Zoho applications, data stores, documents, and external APIs.
  • Build or improve Python/TypeScript services, scripts, webhooks, and automations with logging, retries, idempotency, permissions, and safe human-approval steps.
  • Improve Zoho CRM and related Zoho One workflows using Deluge, Creator, Flow, Recruit, Books, Analytics, WorkDrive, or other relevant applications.
  • Evaluate AI outputs and retrieval quality instead of judging systems only from successful demos.
  • Identify high-value automation opportunities across sales, lead management, property data, reporting, marketing, and internal operations.
  • Work alongside existing team members without disrupting live operations.
  • Produce concise documentation, implementation notes, and clear asynchronous status updates.

Required experience

  • Strong hands-on experience building software, automation, data, or AI systems that real users depend on.
  • Practical experience with RAG, LLM agents, MCP/tool calling, vector search, AI evaluations, or production model integrations.
  • Working hands-on experience with Zoho CRM and at least one of Deluge, Creator, Flow, Recruit, Books, Analytics, WorkDrive, or another Zoho One application. Exceptional AI engineers with less Zoho experience may still qualify if they demonstrate a credible, safe learning plan.
  • Proficiency in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript and confidence with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, and SQL.
  • Strong written and spoken English. You must be able to explain technical issues clearly to a non-technical decision-maker and document systems for the team.
  • Ability to explain failures, limitations, monitoring, costs, and security—not only successful output.
  • Willingness to show and explain work you personally built. Private projects may be demonstrated by screen share.

Preferred, not mandatory

  • Broader Zoho One experience, especially Creator, Recruit, Books, Analytics, WorkDrive, Flow, Canvas, or Deluge.
  • WhatsApp/Kapso, n8n, Vercel, Cloudflare, FastAPI, Next.js, or similar platforms.
  • Real estate, PropTech, CRM operations, document automation, or data-quality work.
  • Spanish is helpful but of minor importance.

What success looks like in the first 90 days

  • Understand the current systems and team ownership without disrupting production.
  • Select one high-value workflow and ship a reliable improvement with tests/evaluations, logs, documentation, and a human-review path.
  • Integrate that workflow with the relevant Zoho or other operating system.
  • Identify the next two automation opportunities based on business value, risk, and effort.

How to apply

Complete the screening assessment and provide one concrete example of a system you personally built. We value precise, honest answers more than broad claims of expertise.

title: Program Associate, IDEA Fiscal Systems and Accountability
description:
About WestEd

As a community of over 1,400 researchers, practitioners, consultants, and administrative professionals from all backgrounds and life experiences, we are committed to making a qualitative difference in the lives of youth, children, and adults. We conduct and apply research, develop evidence-based solutions, and provide consulting services across the country in both rural and urban communities to improve equitable outcomes for individuals from infancy through adulthood. Serving as trusted partners in the areas of education, health, and justice, our teams enhance capacity within communities and school districts to prioritize impact — asking the right questions, customizing methodologies, developing relevant tools, and implementing best practices specific to a diverse range of stakeholder needs.

WestEd supports individual initiative, excellence, and hard work of all individuals in our hiring and work practices. WestEd complies with all applicable federal and state anti-discrimination laws, as well as OFCCP requirements. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, or status as a protected veteran.

SPECIAL NOTICE REGARDING THE WORK LOCATION OF THIS POSITION—Although WestEd provides the option of working at one of its facilities for employees, many roles allow employees to choose to work remotely for their own convenience. The decision to allow remote work at the employee's convenience is based on the requirements of the position or project in question.

Brief Description:

WestEd’s Center for Education Systems, more specifically the Federal Fiscal Accountability team, partners with federal, state, and local agencies to strengthen the systems used to administer federal education programs and manage public resources effectively. The team supports clients in implementing the fiscal and programmatic provisions ofthe Education Department General Administrative Regulations (EDGAR), Uniform Grant Guidance, the Elementary and Secondary Education Act (ESEA), the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA), and other federal programs serving children, students, and families from infancy through adulthood.

We help educational agencies design and improve fiscal accountability systems, policies and procedures, resource allocation approaches, monitoring practices, and implementation strategies. Our work strengthens compliance, builds organizational capacity, promotes the effective coordination and use of federal, state, and local resources, and expands access to high-quality programs and services for eligible children, students, and families.

Drawing on expertise in federal education policy, fiscal management, accountability, and inclusive teaching and learning, we support clients in developing systems and resource allocation approaches that prioritize improved experiences and outcomes for students. We serve federal, state, and local clients through national technical assistance centers, including the National Center for Systemic Improvement (NCSI) and the Center for IDEA Fiscal Reporting (CIFR), Regional Comprehensive Centers as well as through state and local-level projects across the country. Our services include systems coaching, technical assistance, resource development and dissemination, policy analysis, evaluation, and applied research.

The Opportunity

We are seeking to add a detail-oriented professional to our team with knowledge of the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA) and experience administering or supporting special education or early intervention programs. The ideal candidate will understand special education fiscal accountability and funding systems and bring an interest in deepening their expertise in federal fiscal requirements. We are particularly interested in candidates with experience implementing and administering IDEA Part C to support our current and emerging project portfolio.

As a Program Associate, you will support Senior Program Associates, Program Managers, and Project leads in providing technical assistance and other services to state agencies, local educational agencies, and other IDEA partners. The position will contribute to resource development, policy analysis, applied research, and state- and local-level projects, including support through CIFR related to IDEA Part B and/or Part C fiscal requirements and reporting. Preference will be given to candidates with IDEA Part C fiscal experience. We value a commitment to high-quality work, clear communication, responsive technical assistance, and collaboration across fiscal, policy, research, and programmatic areas.

Core Focus Areas and Responsibilities

Technical Assistance, Training, and Resource Development (70-80%)

  • Support technical assistance and consultation to states that aims to increase client capacity to meet IDEA program and fiscal requirements and improve outcomes for students with disabilities.
  • Assist in developing and preparing materials for technical assistance and other content-specific projects.
  • Contribute to the development and dissemination of resources, tools, and templates.
  • Write clearly for various audiences, including contributing to project resources and reports describing and summarizing our work.
  • Partner with teammates to review and summarize client materials including policy, background research, and other information.

Project and Task Coordination (20-30%)

  • Support events and meetings by organizing calendars, meeting materials, and meeting notes.
  • Document, communicate expectations for, and track task completion by team members.
  • Contribute to team meetings for project staff within existing infrastructures.
  • Provide project coordination and support for specified tasks and streams of work within larger projects.

This position will require some travel up to 40% for on-site provision of technical assistance and meetings.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, public administration, education administration, special education, early childhood education, or related fields.
  • Knowledge of federal fiscal accountability requirements and state and local finance systems, particularly as they relate to special education and early intervention programs.
  • Experience administering or supporting special education, early intervention, federal education, or other publicly funded programs.
  • Understanding of IDEA Part C systems, including the roles of state lead agencies, participating public agencies, early intervention service providers, and families familiarity with IDEA Part C fiscal requirements, such as payor of last resort, interagency financial responsibility, systems of payments, public and private insurance, reimbursement procedures, and fiscal monitoring.
  • Ability to review, analyze, and summarize policies, procedures, budgets, fiscal documents, monitoring materials, and other complex information.
  • Resourcefulness, careful attention to detail, and strong organizational skills including demonstrated use of organizational tools (e.g., Box, Salesforce, Outlook Calendar) and experience in successful project management.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills including proofreading andproviding constructive feedback.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage in active listening and summarize conversations, decision, and action items for internal teams and client partners.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, including the ability to prioritize work on multiple projects.
  • High level of self-motivation and ability to work independently while seeking guidance when appropriate.
  • Strong interpersonal skills including the ability to work collaboratively in a team and with client partners.

Other degrees, skills, abilities, and experiences of interest

  • Experience developing and implementing state procedures for meeting federal fiscal requirements including monitoring local educational agency (LEA) and local agency (LA) compliance.
  • Experience developing and providing technical assistance and professional development.
  • Group facilitation skills including experience facilitating professional learning networks and communities of practice.
  • Eagerness to contribute to developing new strategies for quality assurance and project coordination.
  • Knowledge of improvement science, implementation science, and other frameworks for continuous improvement.
  • Understanding and application of adult learning theory in professional development and facilitation.

*Note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Successful candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.

title: Director, Customer Partner Incentive, Financial Services
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Are you ready to take on an exciting challenge as an Account Management Partner with Kyndryl? We're looking for a dynamic individual like you, who can revolutionize relationship management, drive account growth, and boost profitability. In this role, you'll have the power to create, maintain, and develop deep customer connections, bringing the very best of Kyndryl to the table and building trusted relationships with top-level executives.

But this position is about more than just maintaining the status quo. As an Account Management Partner, you'll be at the forefront of driving proactive account growth. You'll focus on not only selling new offerings but also minimizing erosion in renewals, ensuring that our largest accounts continue to flourish and thrive.

You won't just be a cog in the machine; you'll be a strategic mastermind responsible for developing and executing cutting-edge account strategies. Your expertise will lead to the successful growth and retention of Kyndryl's most valuable accounts. With your sharp eye for identifying and qualifying new opportunities, you'll build relationships with key decision-makers and deliver tailor-made solutions that cater to the unique needs of each customer.

Collaboration is key, and as an Account Management Partner, you'll work closely with other sales team members to ensure a seamless account management process. Together, you'll execute every aspect flawlessly, from the initial prospecting stage to closing deals and beyond.

Not only will you lead one or more Portfolio or Strategic accounts, but you'll also be the driving force behind generating new opportunities and expanding existing work into larger scopes and new capabilities. By building a strong go-to-market pipeline with our partners, you'll join forces to pursue and conquer new deals, taking Kyndryl to unprecedented heights.

You're not just an expert in our industry—you're an expert in the industry. With your deep knowledge of external best practices, you understand how they can impact our customers. By staying ahead of the curve, you'll continuously provide innovative solutions that position Kyndryl as a leader in the market.

As an owner of the account P&L, you'll take charge of customer satisfaction, ensuring that our clients are not only happy but also successful. Integrity is at the core of everything you do, and you'll go above and beyond to ensure account compliance and maintain a stellar reputation.

If you're ready to embark on an exhilarating journey with Kyndryl, where your skills, expertise, and creativity will shape the future of account management – then we can't wait to meet you. Join our team and let's make remarkable things happen together.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Must be in a commutable distance to Cincinnati, Ohio

  • Minimim of 5+ years' experience running account P&L

  • Deep knowledge of business and technology trends and industry best practices

  • Minimum of 7+ years of experience managing sales process end-to-end

  • Proven experience with revenue growth, cost, profitability, trends, and risks

  • Open minded and empathetic approach in relationships with customers


Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree

  • Sales experience in technical solutions

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

  • A dynamic and inclusive work environment.

  • The chance to work with a leading global IT services company.

Compensation:

The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is $159,240 to $286,560 based on a full-time schedule. Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job-related skills and experience. For part-time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement.

There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations:

California: $175,080 to $343,920

Colorado: $159,240 to $286,560

New York City: $191,040 to $343,920

Conn./NJ: $159,240 to 343,920

Washington: $175,080 to $315,240

Washington DC: $175,080 to $315,240

This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.


Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

Get Referred!
