title: Full Stack Developer (AI-Native)
description:
About JMAC Lending:

At JMAC Lending, we pride ourselves on over 25 years of dedicated service. Our mission is to provide exceptional support and innovative solutions that empower our partners to thrive. We’re not just about meeting today’s market demands; we aim to be the preferred lender that clients turn to again and again. Our talented team boasts impressive credentials, continuously enhancing their skills through ongoing education, ensuring a perfect blend of knowledge and experience. Built on a foundation of the highest ethical standards, we are committed to delivering competitive product pricing with efficiency and precision for wholesale and correspondent lending.

The Opportunity:

This position will build and maintain the applications behind JMAC Lending’s modern application platform, including the broker portal, internal workflow tools, dashboards, and AI-powered features, on a current TypeScript stack. Reporting to the IT Manager on a small applications team, this position owns assigned problems end to end: front-end and back-end development, integrations with our loan origination system and third-party platforms, workflow automation, and ongoing support of what it ships. JMAC works AI-natively, and this position is expected to use AI coding assistants well while retaining full responsibility for understanding, debugging, and defending everything delivered, regardless of who or what wrote the first draft.

This is a Full-Time/Remote opportunity with varying working hours from 8-5pm PT Monday-Friday offering competitive pay ranging from $90,000-130,000 annually and is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Key Responsibilities:

Application Development

  • Build and maintain internal and partner-facing applications, including the broker portal, dashboards, and workflow tools.
  • Develop front end in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, owning interaction and visual quality: layout, states, empty and error cases, responsiveness, and accessibility.
  • Develop back-end services and APIs on Azure Functions and Node.js/TypeScript, with Python or C#/.NET for specific services; work in Postgres through an ORM, writing queries and evolving schemas.
  • Build AI-powered features with real-time streaming responses and keep them correct as prompts, models, and knowledge bases change.
  • Help build the tooling layer that allows AI assistants and agents to securely operate internal systems and data.
  • Implement role-based access control, audit logging, and input validation so sensitive workflows remain secure and compliant.
  • Write tested, reviewed code and follow the team’s version control, CI/CD, and code review practices.

Automations & Integrations

  • Design and maintain integrations between internal systems, the loan origination system, and third-party platforms including e-sign and email.
  • Build workflow automations using Azure Logic Apps, Power Automate, and low-code tools; monitor and optimize existing automations.
  • Keep integrations within the mortgage industry’s data governance, security, and compliance requirements.

Support & Ticket Resolution

  • Support the applications and automations owned by this position and the team: triage tickets, fix bugs, monitor application health, and coordinate releases. This is a regular part of the week; you support what you ship.

Problem Ownership

  • Own assigned problems end to end: understand how the work actually gets done, propose the solution, and stay accountable for whether the shipped result improved the outcome.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

  • Treat documentation as part of finishing: update architecture notes, API references, and diagrams in the same change that ships the code. Log a changelog entry per change and a release note when users can see it.

Requirements

  • 3+ years building and shipping web applications, or equivalent demonstrable project experience; what has been built is weighted over exact years. Works independently once the problem is understood.
  • Work that can be walked through: a portfolio, GitHub, or work samples — or, where the best work is proprietary, an architecture walkthrough of a system built but not shareable.
  • Ability to explain how something built works and why the choices were made, not only that it runs.
  • Fluency with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) paired with full ownership of the result: able to understand, debug, and defend the code regardless of who wrote the first draft. AI-assisted work in a portfolio is expected, not a caveat.
  • Comfort working where a feature’s intended behavior is defined by test cases and real-world feedback rather than a fixed specification document. No prior LLM-evaluation experience required; curiosity about the domain matters more.
  • Strong fundamentals in HTML, CSS, and TypeScript/JavaScript, with hands-on React; Next.js and Tailwind CSS a strong plus.
  • Back-end API experience in at least one of Node.js, C#, or Python, plus working SQL and relational schema design; Postgres ideal.
  • Git and pull-request workflows, with clear written and spoken communication across technical and business teams.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States.
  • Company systems and borrower data may be accessed only from JMAC-provided, centrally managed equipment.
  • Preferred, not required: Next.js App Router, an ORM such as Prisma, or Supabase.
  • Preferred, not required: Azure (Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, Blob Storage) or Vercel.
  • Preferred, not required: automated testing (Vitest or Jest) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Preferred, not required: exposure to evaluating LLM or retrieval systems, including golden sets, regression suites, and refusal and hallucination testing.
  • Preferred, not required: Python, especially PDF or document processing, or C#/.NET.
  • Preferred, not required: experience building real-time or streaming UIs using server-sent events, WebSockets, or similar.
  • Preferred, not required: background in mortgage, fintech, or another regulated industry, or eagerness to learn the domain.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Health Care Plan (including Medical, Dental, and Vision)
  • Life Insurance options (Basic, Voluntary, and AD&D)
  • Generous Paid Time Off for Vacation and Holidays
  • Retirement Savings Plan (401k)
  • Short Term and Long Term Disability coverage
  • Support for Family Leave
  • Access to Wellness Resources

JMAC Lending, Inc. is an Equal Employment Employer. We are committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regards to age, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin.

As such this job description is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, efforts, requirements or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed as assigned.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Rust
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Anduril, our Software Engineers specialize in solving complex, real-world problems through cutting-edge algorithms and intelligent software integrations. Operating in small, innovative teams, we push the boundaries of what's possible to deliver advanced technologies with mission-critical applications. Our commitment doesn't end with academic research or proof-of-concept experiments; we measure our success by the real-world impact of our deployed solutions. Inspired by Arthur C. Clarke's vision — "Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic" — we aim to achieve groundbreaking results in target tracking, state estimation, and situational awareness. We are currently seeking highly talented technologists to join our mission and redefine the future of defense technology.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Define and influence the direction of a small team, leveraging your subject-matter expertise in target tracking and state estimation.
  • Architect, maintain, and evolve complex software systems, refactoring existing codebases to improve performance, maintainability, and scalability.
  • Prototype and deploy state-of-the-art algorithms for tracking, multi-sensor data fusion, and state estimation in agile, iterative development environments.
  • Develop high-performance Rust software for real-time systems, ranging from tactical implementations to simulation environments and decision support tools.
  • Design and implement robust filters, estimators, and probabilistic reasoning systems that enable actionable insights from noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete sensor data.
  • Apply software design patterns and architectural best practices to manage technical debt and guide the evolution of production systems over time.
  • Analyze system performance using high-fidelity simulations, innovative modeling tools, and rigorous statistical techniques to validate the benefits of our technology.
  • Drive customer success by customizing algorithms and software for mission-critical use cases, including real-time tracking and sensor fusion.
  • Integrate tracking and estimation technologies into the broader software development lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and optimization.
  • Translate technical progress into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders, including colleagues and end-users.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8 + years of professional software engineering experience &a Bachelor's degree in mathematics, physics, engineering, or other technical field (advanced degree strongly preferred)
  • Demonstrated experience managing and evolving software architecture in production environments, including refactoring legacy systems and managing technical debt.
  • At least 2+ years working on a single codebase or product, maintaining and expanding it as requirements evolved.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns , architectural principles, and best practices for building maintainable, scalable systems (beyond basic syntax proficiency).
  • Proficiency in algorithm design, software development, and statistical modeling; experience with Rust, C/C++, Python, and Matlab is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of applied mathematics, including linear algebra, optimization, probability, and stochastic processes.
  • Knowledge of signal processing techniques for interpreting diverse sensor data (e.g., radar, lidar, EO/IR).
  • Familiarity with big data pipelines, NoSQL databases, and the efficient handling of large-scale sensor data.
  • Ability to engineer robust systems for estimation theory, adaptive filtering, controls, and complex signal environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across development lifecycles, from prototyping to optimizing production systems.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience refactoring and modernizing Rust codebases in production environments.
  • Track record of architectural decision-making and technical leadership on long-lived projects.
  • Contributions to open-source Rust projects or the broader Rust ecosystem.
  • Experience with concurrent and parallel programming patterns in Rust.
  • Experience in state estimation, including Bayesian filtering, sensor fusion, and recursive estimation techniques.
  • Background in machine learning as applied to target tracking and recognition, including clustering, classification, and anomaly detection techniques.
  • Strong knowledge of target tracking techniques, such as Kalman filters, particle filters, and multi-target tracking algorithms (e.g., JPDA, MHT, or PHD filters).

We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non‑technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non‑technical coursework, etc.). $220,000 - $292,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiringprocess or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in aconfidential file.

title: Office of the CEO
description:
About Build

AI for the Built World: Build has created the agentic AI stack for institutional real estate, automating complex development and acquisitions workflows 90% faster than humans to accelerate the world's most important built projects - digital infrastructure, energy, industrial - from concept to completion.

Our mission is to accelerate and amplify the world's most important built projects - inventing a better way to build through a collaboration between human experts and agentic AI. We envision a future where the world's buildings are driven from concept to completion, autonomously. Without delays, cost, and complexity. Enabling people to deliver a magnitude more deals. To make decisions, build relationships and create.

To start, we're partnering with the world's biggest built world institutions from $T alternative assets investors, prolific developers and even governments to push the frontier of what's possible. We're backed by c-suite from Blackstone and OpenAI alongside the world's best venture capital firms.

Join us in shaping the future of the Built World and exponentially accelerate your career in the process. We welcome you to do your life's work here.

About the role

This role absorbs the operational load from Build's leadership. You job is to intercept everything that lands on an executive's plate (logistics, coordination, or the operational machinery underneath) and consumes time.

What you will do

• Run the day-to-day operations of the office across London and New York
• Manage scheduling, logistics, and travel without supervision
• Handle inbound communications and route or resolve what does not need the principal's attention
• Keep the team informed of executive priorities and ensure nothing gets lost in translation between leadership and the people executing
• Coordinate across the team on time-sensitive operational tasks so executives are not pulled in
• Prepare briefings, context, and materials for meetings that matter
• Handle commercial, financial and personal information with complete discretion
• Manage the systems that make the operation self-running rather than constantly managed

Who we are looking for

Someone who has operated inside a busy, senior environment and understands that the job is keeping things moving without being asked. You are calm under pressure, good with people at every level of an organisation, and comfortable holding a lot of context without making it visible.

Based in New York and/or London as required.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer


Vacancy Information

  • Location: London, UK
  • Salary: Competitive
  • Working Pattern: Hybrid, 3 days per week in the office
  • Contract Type: Permanent
  • Working Hours: Monday to Friday


At TTC, we are Enriching lives by connecting people and places.

For over 100 years, we’ve been bringing the world closer together by crafting journeys that create lasting memories, lifelong friendships and meaningful cultural connections. Across more than 70 countries and our award-winning brands, we design and deliver travel experiences that go beyond sightseeing - they change perspectives.

Behind every unforgettable journey is a passionate team making it happen. That’s where you come in.


Our Values

Five shared commitments shape how we work, and how we will work with you:

  • Value Every Voice. We put people first.
  • Act with Integrity. We do what is right.
  • Explore Beyond Boundaries. We are driven by curiosity.
  • Own the Outcome. We take responsibility for our decisions.
  • Succeed Together. We have each other's backs.


The Role


We’re building TTC’s Data & AI capability, and this role sits at the heart of it. You’ll design and deliver data products that power analytics, data science, AI and commercial decision-making across a global business, using customer, booking, digital, marketing, commercial and operational data. Working in a modern Snowflake ecosystem, you’ll partner with engineers, analysts, data scientists, Product and Architecture to solve complex business problems and create trusted, reusable data. With the platform still evolving, you’ll help shape standards, patterns and architecture, mentor others, and influence how the team works—while remaining hands-on with the technology from day one onward globally.


What Will You Do?

  • Build scalable, production-grade pipelines and reusable data products that teams across the business genuinely rely on.
  • Model our most important customer and commercial entities so the business works from one trusted version of the truth.
  • Engineer solutions in Snowflake, SQL, Python and modern transformation tooling such as dbt.
  • Raise the bar on testing, data quality, observability, version control and CI/CD, and make good practice the default.
  • Tune workloads for performance, resilience, scalability and sensible cloud cost.
  • Lead technically through design reviews, code reviews and hands-on mentoring.
  • Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Product and Architecture to unlock advanced analytics and AI use cases.
  • Define the reusable engineering patterns that lift the technical maturity of the whole platform.


About You

Essential

  • Substantial data engineering experience in a sophisticated, production-scale environment.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in SQL and Python.
  • Strong Snowflake experience, or equivalent depth in another modern cloud data platform.
  • A proven track record designing ELT and ETL pipelines and analytical data models.
  • Practical experience with dbt, orchestration frameworks, Git and CI/CD.
  • A genuine commitment to data quality, testing and observability.
  • Sound engineering judgement, knowing when to build for the long term and when to ship.
  • The credibility to lead technically, influence design decisions and lift standards around you.

Desirable

  • Experience with complex customer, transactional or behavioural datasets.
  • Experience in an agile, product-led delivery environment.
  • Exposure to data products that support data science or AI use cases.
  • A track record of mentoring engineers or shaping engineering standards.
  • Curiosity about travel, hospitality or global consumer businesses.


Apply Now

If you want to build the data foundations behind how millions of people see the world, we would like to hear from you. Apply today, and tell us what you would want to build first.

title: Treaty Developer
description:
You desire impactful work.

You’reRGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies, we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

A Brief Overview

Develop, design and produce reinsurance treaties of the highest complexity which include advanced reinsurance concepts. Ensure the treaties accurately reflect the reinsurance agreement provisions negotiated between RGA Re and its clients. Evaluate client prepared documents and initiate necessary recommendations for change. Perform Peer Reviews for documents prepared by other associates for quality and accuracy.

What you will do

  • Research, design and/or create the most complex treaties (whether client prepared or RGA drafted) which include advanced reinsurance concepts and capture all the details of a reinsurance transaction in one document. Developer must be familiar with actuarial pricing concepts, reinsurance business models, administration details, underwriting specifics and general legal mandates. Developer must understand how profitability for the business is affected by treaty language. Ensure the documents accurately reflect the agreement reached between RGA Re and clients. Identify and escalate treaty language outside guideline parameters to the appropriate Subject Matter Expert for assessment which includes obtaining and documenting approvals. Work very closely with SMEs in other departments such as Actuarial, Legal, Administration, and Underwriting.

  • Following established department procedures, conduct Peer Reviews for documents prepared by other associates for quality and accuracy, adherence to RGA business guidelines and legal protocols.

  • Ensure treaties comply with State and Federal insurance regulations as communicated from Legal counsel and corporate contract standards. Identify differences and escalate to Legal counsel.

  • Maintain relationships with clients and other RGA Re associates to facilitate effective resolution of treaty issues. Advise clients of recommended revisions to treaty documents and continuously monitor status to ensure they are executed.

  • Own and drive resolution on meetings with internal associates in other areas of RGA, orchestrate client calls and occasionally meet with visiting clients in person. Continuous communication with clients via phone and e-mail.

  • Work with various computer systems to produce boilerplate treaty documents, produce reports and/or input data.

  • Assist department associates with questions and occasionally provide training.

  • Analyze methods, procedures or processes and recommend enhancements and/or improvements. Implement approved recommendations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) Paralegal Degree or equivalent related experience in insurance, reinsurance or law related positions required

  • 5+ Years legal, commercial contract or document drafting experience required

  • Advanced Microsoft Word skills; Basic Microsoft Excel skills; Intermediate Microsoft Outlook skills required

  • Advanced written and oral communication skills. Ability to share and impart knowledge required

  • Advanced critical thinking skills. Complex analytical and problem solving skills; Advanced investigative skills required

  • Must be flexible and adaptive to change. Takes initiative and is accountable required

  • Ability to comprehend, interpret and compose highly complex treaty language, and to apply it appropriately required

  • Ability to multi-task and meet tight deadlines. Highly organized and attentive to detail. Basic goal setting skills required

  • Change initiation skills required

  • Value judgment abilities required

  • Ability to balance detail with departmental goals/objectives required

  • Ability to work independently and within a team. Ability to work well within a team environment and participate in department projects required

  • Advanced interpersonal skills. Advanced persuasion skills when working with internal and external customers to resolve issues/problems. required

  • Basic SQL Query Skills preferred

  • Progress toward FLMI, ARA or other relevant professional accreditation Preferred

What you can expect from RGA:

  • Gain valuable knowledge from and experience with diverse, caring colleagues around the world.

  • Enjoy a respectful, welcoming environment that fosters individuality and encourages pioneering thought.

  • Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential.

We’re excited to get to know you and connect your unique skills with our global opportunities. To create a modern and seamless experience, we use artificial intelligence (AI) in parts of our preliminary screening process. This technology helps us personalize job recommendations, automate interview scheduling, evaluate candidates based solely on experience—without considering name, gender, or other personal details—and provide real-time answers through our chatbot. AI is used only during early screening and never makes hiring decisions. Your RGA recruiter will work closely with you every step of the way to ensure the process feels personal, thoughtful, and focused on you.

$66,740.00 - $94,800.00 Annual

description:

Solirius Reply, part of the Reply Group, is a technology consultancy and digital transformation partner that helps organisations solve complex challenges through strategy, design, engineering, and delivery.

We operate as a collaborative and inclusive organisation that empowers our people to take ownership, innovate, and develop their expertise. As an equal opportunities employer, we are committed to encouraging equality, diversity, and social mobility, while creating opportunities for our teams to work on meaningful projects that deliver lasting impact.


About You:

You are a motivated and adaptable professional with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for using technology to solve real-world problems. You enjoy working in collaborative, agile teams and take pride in delivering high-quality solutions that make a tangible impact. With strong communication skills and a consultative approach, you’re comfortable engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and translating them into effective outcomes.


The Role:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our team here at Solirius. You will be working as part of a team, developing and delivering exciting projects with a fantastic team of technology experts.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and systems that enable data analysis and machine learning. You will also collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure data quality and reliability.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop Data Engineering solutions for our clients/projects
  • Design and build data models, schemas to support business requirements
  • Develop and maintain data ingestion and processing systems using various tools and technologies, such as SQL, NoSQL, ETL, Luigi, Airflow, Argo, etc.
  • Implement data storage solutions using different types of databases, such as relational, non-relational, or cloud-based.
  • Working collaboratively with the client and cross-functional teams to identify and address data-related issues and opportunities.
  • Stay updated with the latest trends and developments in the data engineering field, such as modern data stack, big data technologies, cloud computing, etc
  • Assist with defining the processes needed to achieve operational excellence
  • Ensure data quality across all projects/clients
  • Define and manage SLA’s for data sets and processes throughout production
  • Lead on the design, build and launch of new data models and pipelines


Key Skills/Experience:

  • Experience in operating as part of data engineering teams and independently.
  • Line/Team management experience, leadership experience
  • Experience of working with cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS, GCP is beneficial)
  • SQL and relational databases (e.g. MS SQL/Azure SQL, PostgreSQL)
  • You have framework experience within either Flask, Tornado or Django, Docker
  • Experience working with ETL pipelines is desirable e.g. Luigi, Airflow or Argo
  • Experience with big data technologies, such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, etc.
  • Data acquisition and development of data sets and improving data quality
  • Preparing data for predictive and prescriptive modelling
  • Hands on coding experience, such as Python
  • Reporting tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Qlik)
  • GDPR and Government Service Standard (desirable)
  • Passionate, motivated and enthusiastic about developing technology solutions.
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment
  • Data architecture experience.
  • Active Security Clearance


What we offer

  • Competitive Salary
  • Bonus Scheme
  • Private Healthcare Insurance
  • 25 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays
  • Up to 10 days allocated for development training per year
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Paid Fertility Leave (5 Days)
  • Statutory & Contributory Pension
  • EAP with Help@Hand
  • Gym Membership Benefits
  • Cycle to Work and Electric Vehicle schemes
  • Flexible Working

title: Director, Product Pricing and Monetization
description:
About HighLevel:HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People:
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact:
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the role :

    HighLevel is hiring a Director of Product Pricing & Monetization to lead our company-wide approach to pricing, packaging, monetization, and customer research.

    This person will help HighLevel answer four critical questions:

    • Who are our most important customer segments, and what outcomes are they trying to achieve?

    • Which products, capabilities, and services do those customers value most?

    • How should we package and price our offerings to align customer value with sustainable company growth?

    • How do we create a continuous customer-learning system that improves product, go-to-market, and strategic decisions?

    You will sit at the intersection of Product, Finance, Data, Growth, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Operations. You will combine customer research, behavioral data, market intelligence, financial analysis, and experimentation to shape HighLevel’s commercial strategy.

    This is not an advisory-only role. You will be expected to develop recommendations, build alignment, support implementation, measure results, and improve decisions based on what we learn.

    The role reports to the Chief of Staff and will have significant exposure to HighLevel’s executive leadership team.

What you will own

    Pricing and packaging strategy

  • Develop a clear, company-wide pricing and packaging strategy across subscription plans, product bundles, add-ons, usage-based capabilities, services, and new product launches.

  • Evaluate how HighLevel’s pricing architecture should evolve as the platform expands into new products, customer segments, and monetization models.

  • Identify the most appropriate value metrics for different parts of the platform, including where subscription, usage-based, account-based, feature-based, or hybrid pricing models may be appropriate.

  • Assess opportunities to improve plan differentiation, feature entitlements, upgrade paths, product bundling, and add-on attachment.

  • Build business cases for pricing and packaging changes, including expected impact on acquisition, trial-to-paid conversion, average revenue per customer, expansion, retention, gross margin, and lifetime value.

  • Develop principles and guardrails for discounts, promotions, trials, grandfathering, migrations, and price increases.

  • Partner with Finance and Data teams to model revenue impact, customer impact, adoption scenarios, and potential risks.

  • Create a prioritized monetization roadmap rather than treating pricing as a series of isolated decisions.

    • Customer research and insights

  • Build a continuous customer research program covering prospects, trial users, paying customers, expanded customers, churned customers, agency owners, affiliates, and the businesses operating within agency sub-accounts.

  • Establish a clear segmentation framework based on customer needs, behaviors, maturity, business models, use cases, value realization, and willingness to pay.

  • Lead qualitative and quantitative research, including customer interviews, surveys, concept testing, win/loss analysis, churn research, behavioral analysis, and willingness-to-pay studies.

  • Understand the jobs customers hire HighLevel to perform, the outcomes they value, the alternatives they consider, and the barriers that prevent them from adopting or expanding.

  • Create a centralized customer-insights repository so that research is accessible, reusable, and connected to company decisions.

  • Develop a regular cadence for sharing insights with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership.

  • Translate research into clear implications for product strategy, roadmap prioritization, positioning, onboarding, customer education, and go-to-market execution.

    • Experimentation and implementation

  • Design pricing, packaging, positioning, and offer experiments with clearly defined hypotheses, target segments, success metrics, and decision criteria.

  • Partner with Product, Growth, Engineering, Billing, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to operationalize approved changes.

  • Develop rollout strategies that account for existing customers, new customers, channel partners, affiliates, billing complexity, communications, and customer support.

  • Establish guardrails to ensure that monetization initiatives improve business performance without creating unacceptable deterioration in customer trust, conversion, adoption, or retention.

  • Build post-launch measurement plans and ensure that each major pricing or packaging decision generates reusable learning.

  • Monitor performance across metrics such as trial-to-paid conversion, plan mix, average revenue per customer, add-on attachment, expansion, downgrade rates, churn, net revenue retention, gross margin, and customer lifetime value.

    • Market and competitive intelligence

  • Maintain a structured view of pricing, packaging, positioning, and monetization trends across relevant SaaS, agency technology, CRM, marketing automation, communications, AI, and adjacent software categories.

  • Identify changes in customer expectations, competitive offers, business models, and emerging value metrics.

  • Distinguish between competitive signals that require action and those that should not influence HighLevel’s strategy.

  • Use market intelligence as one input alongside customer value, product strategy, economics, and HighLevel’s long-term differentiation.

    • Decision-making and organizational leadership

  • Establish a cross-functional pricing and monetization operating cadence, including clear decision rights, approval processes, and measurement standards.

  • Bring structure to complex decisions where customer needs, product strategy, technical constraints, and financial outcomes may conflict.

  • Present recommendations to senior leaders in a clear, commercially grounded, and decision-oriented manner.

  • Build alignment across functions while remaining willing to challenge assumptions and surface difficult trade-offs.

  • Initially operate as a hands-on leader and, as the function develops, help define and build the right team across pricing, monetization analytics, and customer insights.

  • Raise the organization’s overall capability in customer research, pricing strategy, experimentation, and value-based decision-making.

What we are looking for

    • 12+ years of experience across SaaS pricing, monetization, product strategy, customer insights, growth strategy, management consulting, corporate strategy, or related roles.

    • Significant direct experience leading pricing and packaging decisions for a B2B SaaS, platform, or technology company.

    • Demonstrated experience translating customer research and data into changes in product, pricing, packaging, or go-to-market strategy.

    • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, including subscription economics, usage-based pricing, expansion revenue, retention, gross margin, and customer lifetime value.

    • Experience working with multi-product or multi-tier offerings and navigating the impact of pricing changes on existing and new customers.

    • Strong quantitative and financial modeling skills, with the ability to develop scenarios, challenge assumptions, and make recommendations with imperfect information.

    • Experience with both qualitative and quantitative research methods, such as customer interviews, segmentation, surveys, willingness-to-pay analysis, concept testing, conjoint analysis, and behavioral data analysis.

    • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer value, growth, simplicity, operational feasibility, and long-term strategy.

    • Excellent executive communication skills, including the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear recommendation and decision.

    • A highly collaborative working style and a record of influencing Product, Finance, Data, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success leaders.

    • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the operating model and analytical foundation may still need to be built.

    • A player-coach mentality: equally comfortable defining strategy, conducting customer interviews, reviewing analyses, building a business case, and supporting execution.

Preferred experience

  • Experience with product-led growth, free trials, self-serve acquisition, or hybrid product-led and sales-assisted models.

  • Experience with agency software, SMB software, CRM, marketing automation, communications, payments, AI products, or vertical SaaS.

  • Experience with ecosystems in which the direct customer serves or resells products to another end customer.

  • Experience with white-label products, reseller models, marketplaces, channel partners, or multi-sided platforms.

  • Experience launching usage-based products or monetizing high-variable-cost capabilities such as communications, payments, infrastructure, or AI.

  • Familiarity with SQL, experimentation platforms, business intelligence tools, or product analytics systems.

  • Experience building a pricing, customer insights, or monetization function from an early stage

What success looks like

    In the first 90 days

    • Develop a clear understanding of HighLevel’s customer segments, current plans, product entitlements, monetization model, customer economics, and decision-making processes.

    • Complete an initial assessment of pricing and packaging opportunities, risks, customer pain points, and analytical gaps.

    • Establish a customer research agenda across trial users, paying customers, expanded customers, churned customers, agencies, affiliates, and sub-accounts.

    • Create an initial pricing and packaging opportunity backlog, distinguishing near-term improvements from longer-term strategic questions.

    • Establish a cross-functional pricing and monetization governance process.

    Within six months

    • Deliver a practical customer segmentation and needs framework that is actively used by Product and go-to-market teams.

    • Establish a repeatable customer research and insight-sharing cadence.

    • Present a prioritized pricing and packaging roadmap supported by customer evidence, behavioral data, competitive context, and financial modeling.

    • Launch or support the launch of the first major pricing, packaging, or monetization initiative.

    • Implement reporting that connects pricing decisions to customer and business outcomes.

    Within the first year

    • Establish a clear and scalable pricing architecture across HighLevel’s core platform, add-ons, and emerging products.

    • Build a trusted customer-insights capability that consistently informs product, go-to-market, and strategic decisions.

    • Create a repeatable process for researching, testing, launching, and evaluating monetization changes.

    • Deliver measurable improvement across one or more key outcomes, such as trial-to-paid conversion, plan mix, average revenue per customer, product attachment, expansion, retention, net revenue retention, or gross margin.

    • Build strong organizational confidence that major pricing and product decisions are grounded in customer value, sound economics, and rigorous learning.

Why this role matters

    HighLevel’s pricing and packaging decisions influence far more than revenue. They shape which customers we attract, how quickly customers understand the platform, which products they adopt, how agencies build businesses on top of HighLevel, and how effectively we can continue investing in customer value.

    This role will help create the customer understanding and commercial discipline required for HighLevel’s next stage of growth.

description:
Position: Associate Director, Discovery DMPK – In Vitro ADME

Salary Range: $120k - $130k

Location: Exton, PA

About Pharmaron

Pharmaron is a global contract research and manufacturing organization (CRO/CDMO) helping pharma and biotech companies bring new therapies to life. With over 25,000 employees worldwide across 28 locations in the US, UK, China, and Singapore, we support drug discovery through to manufacturing with fully integrated high-quality services.

We're proud of the impact we make and just last year, we supported 887 discovery projects, 1,100+ CMC programs, and 1,397 clinical trials across all phases. Our teams are involved in everything from small molecules, ADC's, biologics, and gene therapies and we work with more than 3,300 global customers. To learn more, visit www.pharmaron.com.

What You'll Do

Join Pharmaron as an Associate Director, Discovery DMPK – In Vitro ADME and take a key scientific leadership role in advancing our Discovery DMPK capabilities across U.S. Lab Services.

This position will provide scientific and operational leadership for discovery-stage DMPK programs spanning in vitro ADME, in vivo pharmacokinetics (PK), LC-MS/MS bioanalysis, and data interpretation. You will oversee the scientific quality and execution of studies, mentor and develop scientific teams, and partner directly with biotechnology and pharmaceutical clients to translate discovery objectives into high-quality DMPK solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide scientific and operational leadership for Discovery DMPK programs, including in vitro ADME, in vivo PK, bioanalysis, and associated data interpretation.
  • Lead the design, execution, scientific review, and delivery of high-quality Discovery DMPK studies across Pharmaron U.S. Lab Services.
  • Serve as a senior scientific partner to clients, providing technical guidance and translating discovery objectives into effective DMPK strategies and study designs.
  • Partner with Business Development and DMPK leadership to evaluate opportunities, develop scientific solutions, support proposals, and help secure new business.
  • Strengthen and expand Discovery DMPK capabilities through the evaluation and implementation of new technologies, models, assays, and scientific approaches aligned with evolving industry needs.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop scientists, research associates, and technical staff while fostering scientific excellence, collaboration, accountability, and professional development.
  • Provide senior-level scientific review of proposals, quotes, protocols, data, reports, and related documentation to ensure scientific rigor, accurate interpretation, quality, and timely delivery.
  • Drive operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve processes, productivity, efficiency, quality, and consistency while maintaining state-of-the-art scientific practices.
  • Ensure appropriate departmental policies, procedures, and practices are established and maintained in accordance with applicable regulations and corporate requirements.
  • Support workforce planning and recruitment to ensure appropriate scientific expertise and resources are available to meet current and future business needs.
  • Oversee team performance, resource allocation, departmental objectives, and budgetary requirements to support successful delivery and continued growth of the function.

What We're Looking For

  • PhD or advanced degree in pharmacokinetics, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant laboratory experience within a CRO, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical environment.
  • Deep expertise in the design, conduct, and interpretation of discovery-stage in vitro ADME studies.
  • Strong bioanalytical expertise, including proficiency with LC-MS/MS platforms and experience supporting diverse molecule types.
  • Experience supporting the integration and interpretation of in vitro ADME, bioanalytical, and in vivo PK data within discovery-stage programs.
  • 3+ years of scientific management experience, including staff leadership, coaching, development, and performance management.
  • Experience with financial and operational responsibilities, including budgets, resource planning, and departmental performance.
  • Strong scientific communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex concepts and study results to internal teams and external clients.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a dynamic, client-focused scientific environment.
  • Experience leading or collaborating across multiple sites and building cohesive scientific teams.

Additional Experience That Will Set You Apart

  • Experience developing, implementing, or expanding Discovery DMPK assays, technologies, platforms, or service capabilities.
  • CRO experience with direct biotechnology or pharmaceutical client interaction.
  • Experience partnering with Business Development teams to develop scientific solutions, support proposals, and pursue new business opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify emerging DMPK technologies and translate them into practical scientific capabilities or service offerings.

Why Pharmaron?

Pharmaron is a premier service provider for the life sciences industry. Founded in 2004, Pharmaron has invested in its people and facilities and established a broad spectrum of research, development, and manufacturing service capabilities throughout the entire drug discovery, preclinical, and clinical development process across multiple therapeutic modalities, including small molecules, biologics, and CGT products. With over 25,000 employees and operations in the US, UK, China, and Singapore. Pharmaron has an excellent track record in delivering R&D solutions to its partners in North America, Europe, Japan, and China.

Collaborative Culture: You will thrive in our inclusive and collaborative environment, where teamwork and innovation go hand in hand. Here, your voice matters, and your contributions make a real impact. "Employees Number One" and "Clients Centered" are the core cultural values at Pharmaron. Our culture, which sets Pharmaron apart from other organizations, has evolved from our deep commitment to our employees, partners, and collaborators.

Benefits: As part of our commitment to your well-being, we offer a comprehensive benefits package:

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance with significant employer contributions
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with generous employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Sick Leave & Company Holidays to support work-life balance
  • Employer-funded Health Savings Account (HSA) contributions (for eligible plans), plus Healthcare & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 100% Employer-paid Employee Life Insurance, AD&D, Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP), mental health resources, and wellness programs

How to Apply:

Ready to seize this incredible opportunity? Join us at Pharmaron and be part of a dynamic team driving innovation and excellence in biopharmaceutical research and development. Apply online today!

title: Director of Autonomy
description:
Location: Ottawa Office, On-Site

Reports to: Founder & CEO

Type: Full-Time

The Role

Autonomy that works in a lab is not the problem. Autonomy that holds up in the Arctic — degraded links, no GPS, no cloud, an operator who needs the system to keep making sensible decisions when the mesh drops — is. Our systems are in the field with the CAF now, across the air, the ground, and the water, and they run on one sovereign Canadian stack rather than three disconnected ones.

You set the technical direction for autonomy at Dominion. You own the autonomy roadmap end to end: what we build, in what order, and how it integrates with AuraNet — our C2, mesh, and tasking layer — so that autonomy is a capability every Dominion product inherits rather than something bolted onto each platform. The function sits across hardware and software today and is expected to become its own department as it grows. You are the person who decides what that becomes.

What You'll Do

  • Set the autonomy strategy and roadmap, and turn it into a sequenced technical plan with real milestones — capability by capability, platform by platform.

  • Define how autonomy integrates with AuraNet: tasking, telemetry, mesh, and edge compute, designed for disconnected and bandwidth-constrained operation from the start.

  • Build the autonomy architecture across domains — uncrewed air, ground, and maritime systems working from the same policy and tasking foundation, not per-platform one-offs.

  • Make the call on where deterministic policies belong and where probabilistic ones do, and set the standard for how both are trained, evaluated, and trusted before they reach an operator.

  • Grow the autonomy team — hire, structure, and lead the engineers who take it from a cross-functional effort to a standing function.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with hardware, software, and simulation, and get to the field yourself: trials, integration, and operator feedback, in days not quarters.

What You Bring

  • A senior engineering leader who has personally built and deployed autonomous systems in real-world environments, not only in simulation or research.

  • Autonomy experience across all three domains — robotics, aerospace, and marine. This one is non-negotiable; we are building a stack that has to work on all three.

  • A track record of scaling autonomy capability and the team behind it, from a small group to a function with its own roadmap and headcount.

  • Strong command of reinforcement learning and autonomy policies, including how policies are evaluated, bounded, and made safe for fielded systems.

  • Hands-on experience with both deterministic policies (the system follows predefined rules consistently) and probabilistic ones (the system decides under uncertainty and changing conditions), and clear judgement about which the mission calls for.

  • Based in Ottawa, or ready to relocate — this role is on-site with the team and close to the customer.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with mission autonomy and multi-agent or collaborative tasking, including collaborative autonomy tasking language work.

  • Familiarity with ROS 2 and edge compute on constrained hardware.

  • Simulation-in-the-loop and sim-to-real experience for training and validating autonomy before it flies, drives, or sails.

  • Exposure to defence or dual-use programs, interoperability standards, or work alongside operators.

  • Experience with systems fielded in harsh or Arctic conditions.

No defence background required.

We've hired people who didn't tick every box. If this is the work you want to do, please apply anyway.

Why Join Us

Building something meaningful starts with the right people.

At Dominion Dynamics, you’ll:

  • Shape Canada’s future by building real defence capability for the CAF and our allies.

  • Make decisions that ship in a high-trust environment with short feedback loops and rapid iteration.

  • Move fast, field faster, and work directly with the operator — our systems are in the field with the CAF now.

  • Have an impact from day one with equity, responsibility, and direct access to leadership.

If you’re curious, hands-on, and driven by the opportunity to make a difference, this is where you belong!

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary and company equity*

  • Comprehensive health benefits

  • Additional equity granted based on impact*

We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada.

*Equity awarded to full time employees only.

title: Senior Python Engineer (Hiring Globally)
description:
About the role:

We run a distributed, camera-based video monitoring and AI alerting platform. The estate spans an AWS-hosted fleet of services and workers, a GPU-backed computer-vision inference pipeline, a real-time streaming and presence layer, and thousands of on-premise edge "media boxes" that ingest camera feeds, serve video, and stream events back to the cloud.

Today the bulk of our backend is ~140 Java 8 services and libraries that have grown over many years. We are building their successor: a clean, modern Python monorepo (trella), and we are migrating capabilities over to it service by service.

We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer: a strong programmer first, with real depth in both Python and Java to lead and execute that migration. You will design and build the new Python services, port existing Java functionality across with its behaviour intact, and occasionally maintain and fix the existing Java stack while it remains in production. This is a builder's role at the centre of a major platform modernization.

What you'll work on: The new Python platform (primary)

A greenfield, strongly-opinionated monorepo built for the long term:
  • Python 3.14, managed with uv workspaces (libs/, packages/, svcs/, apps/, scripts/), scaffolded from Copier templates.
  • FastAPI services with Strawberry GraphQL as the primary data API; REST where it's the right fit; Uvicorn ASGI.
  • psycopg3 straight against PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB using the repository pattern - deliberately no ORM - with yoyo migrations.
  • Pydantic / pydantic-settings for models, validation, and config; httpx for outbound HTTP; pendulum for datetimes; structlog + OpenTelemetry for observability.
  • Strict engineering standards, enforced in CI: full type annotations under a strict mypy config, ruff lint + format, and a curated, opinionated set of approved libraries (alternatives are banned at the linter level, on purpose).
  • A strong testing culture: pytest, TestClient, async tests, real test databases.
The legacy Java stack (occasional, ongoing)
  • ~140 Java 8 services and libraries: REST APIs, SQS/SNS workers, Lambda functions built with Gradle and Bazel, running on Jetty 9.4, deployed to Elastic Beanstalk, ECS, and Lambda.
  • Domains include alerts, analytics, API, auth, clips, media, presence, notifications, and partner integrations.
  • You'll read this code to understand behaviour before porting it, keep it healthy with bug fixes and small changes while it's still live, and decommission pieces as their Python replacements land.
The platform around it
  • AWS (us-west-2): EC2/ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS (PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB), ElastiCache (Redis), MSK (Kafka), Kinesis & Kinesis Video Streams, IoT Core, Cognito, SQS/SNS/SES.
  • A GPU-backed computer-vision inference tier producing the alerts that reach parents' phones.
  • Edge appliances (Linux + Docker) in the field, reachable over AWS IoT.

What you'll do:
  • Design and build new Python services in the monorepo (schema, data access, business logic, APIs, and tests) to a high, consistent standard.
  • Migrate functionality from Java to Python: study an existing Java service, capture its real behaviour and edge cases, and re-implement it idiomatically in Python without regressions.
  • Maintain the Java stack as needed: diagnose and fix production issues, make targeted changes, and keep services healthy until they're retired.
  • Set and uphold engineering standards in the new codebase: typing, structure, the libs/svcs separation, the repository pattern, testing, and review quality.
  • Work with data: model schemas in PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, write correct and efficient SQL, and design migrations.
  • Own your work end to end: from design through deploy, observability, and on-call follow-through, and drive it to a durable resolution.

Responsibilities


How we work, and what we expect:
  • Prefer the right fix to a quick patch. Solve the root cause; don't paper over it.
  • Follow-through over activity. We measure outcomes, not hours. Work is driven to a correct, durable resolution on a reasonable timeline, not left half-done.
  • Standards are not optional. The new codebase is opinionated by design; we keep it clean, typed, and tested so it stays fast to work in.
  • Respect what exists before you replace it. Understand the Java behaviour you're porting; migrate deliberately, with tests, and decommission cleanly.

Requirements

  • Strong software engineer first. Excellent fundamentals: data structures, concurrency, API and data modelling, testing, and writing code others can maintain.
  • Senior-level Python in production: idiomatic, fully typed, well-tested. Comfort with async, packaging, and a modern toolchain (type checkers, linters, virtual envs).
  • Solid Java in production: able to confidently read, debug, and modify a large existing Java codebase, and reason about its behaviour well enough to port it.
  • Strong with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) writing SQL directly rather than leaning on an ORM, and designing schemas and migrations.
  • Hands-on AWS experience building and operating real services.
  • Migration / modernization mindset: you can hold "match the old behaviour" and "build it right for the next ten years" in your head at the same time.
  • A bias for follow-through: you find what's actually needed, focus on it, and finish.
  • Excellent English communication.

Nice to have:
  • FastAPI, GraphQL (Strawberry or similar), and async Python at scale.
  • uv, monorepo workflows, and strict typing (mypy) / ruff in CI.
  • TimescaleDB or other time-series data.
  • Gradle and/or Bazel builds; Jetty; AWS Lambda.
  • Messaging and streaming: Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS, Kinesis.
  • Containers (Docker/ECR/ECS), CircleCI, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
  • Auth with Cognito, JWT/OIDC, or Entra; partner-integration work.
  • Computer-vision / ML-adjacent systems, IoT, or edge/on-premise fleets.

Benefits


You will own the migration of a mature, real product from a large legacy Java estate to a clean, modern Python platform, making the architectural calls, setting the standard for everything that follows, and seeing your work reach a camera on a wall, an AI model, and a notification on a parent's phone. You get the satisfaction of greenfield Python without losing the grounding of a system that's already in production.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) | Feeld
description:
GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.

On behalf of Feeld, GT is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join a fast-growing consumer mobile product in the online dating space.

About the Client

Founded in 2014 as a dating app, Feeld gathered millions of users in one place to create a safer and more inclusive space online for everyone open to experiencing people and relationships in a new way. Their mission is to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships and create a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves.

About the Project

You’ll join a consumer mobile product with an engineering and product organization of around 50 people distributed across Europe and the US.

The team works in small, autonomous product squads, each responsible for a specific area of the product and critical user journeys. Because the team operates across multiple regions without a full follow-the-sun model, strong observability, monitoring and reliable incident response are essential.

From a technical perspective, the team is focused on building reliable, observable systems that allow engineers to identify issues early, understand their impact and respond quickly when incidents occur.

  • Technology stack: Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, Cloudflare, CloudWatch, Sentry. React Native is used on the mobile side.

  • Team: Cross-functional product squads of approximately 6–8 people, distributed across Europe, the US and LATAM.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Site Reliability Engineer with a strong backend engineering background in Node.js and TypeScript.

The ideal profile is someone who started in backend/software engineering and has moved into SRE or reliability-focused work, combining a strong understanding of application code with hands-on experience in observability, monitoring and production incident management.

You will be embedded within a product squad and take ownership of the reliability and observability of critical user journeys. An important part of the role is being able to interpret production signals, identify when something is going wrong and begin mitigating incidents independently while bringing in the wider engineering team when needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Own observability for critical product and user journeys within your squad.

  • Define, build and maintain meaningful metrics, dashboards and alerts.

  • Define and maintain SLIs/SLOs for key services and product-level metrics.

  • Improve monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting across the squad’s systems.

  • Act as the first responder for critical P0/P1 production incidents, including out-of-hours incidents.

  • Investigate production signals, identify potential root causes and begin mitigating issues independently.

  • Coordinate with other engineers when broader support or escalation is required.

  • Participate in incident triage, mitigation and postmortems.

  • Identify recurring reliability issues and drive improvements to infrastructure, tooling and incident-response processes.

  • Work closely with backend and product engineers in a distributed, autonomous squad.

Essential knowledge, skills & experience:

  • Strong previous experience as a Backend / Software Engineer, with senior-level hands-on experience in Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Hands-on experience working in an SRE, Production Engineering or similar reliability-focused role.

  • Strong production experience with AWS.

  • Experience with Cloudflare and CloudWatch.

  • Experience with monitoring and observability across metrics, logging, tracing and alerting.

  • Practical experience responding to production incidents, including triage, mitigation and postmortems.

  • Ability to interpret monitoring signals and independently investigate and begin resolving production issues.

  • Understanding of both the application and infrastructure layers rather than infrastructure-only experience.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously within a distributed engineering team.

  • Comfortable participating in out-of-hours incident response as part of the team’s coverage model.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with observability tools such as Sentry.

  • Experience defining SLIs and SLOs for product-level metrics.

  • Experience with React Native or exposure to mobile application environments.

  • Previous experience with consumer mobile products or high-traffic B2C systems.

Interview Steps

  1. GT interview with Recruiter

  2. Technical interview

  3. Final interview

  4. Reference Check

We go beyond usual perks… By working with us, you will get:

  • Health insurance.

  • Wellbeing budget.

  • Sport coverage.

  • Learning budget.

  • 18 business days of paid vacation days per year

  • Paid sick leaves.

  • All public holidays are paid days off.

GT working model:

You will work directly with a client through our Extended Team model. We try to do things differently and put our efforts into integrating you as deeply as possible into the client’s team. You work with the same tools and technologies as they do and are managed directly by the client without any intermediary in between. We help you build relationships and create an environment where you genuinely feel like a member of the client’s team. We also encourage trips to a client and join teambuilding and after-work activities. Our Extended Team model is focused on long-term projects that last over several years.

title: AI Engineer - Platform
description:
About Build

AI for the Built World: Build has created the agentic AI stack for institutional real estate, automating complex development and acquisitions workflows 90% faster than humans to accelerate the world's most important built projects - digital infrastructure, energy, industrial - from concept to completion.

Our mission is to accelerate and amplify the world's most important built projects - inventing a better way to build through a collaboration between human experts and agentic AI. We envision a future where the world's buildings are driven from concept to completion, autonomously. Without delays, cost, and complexity. Enabling people to deliver a magnitude more deals. To make decisions, build relationships and create.

To start, we're partnering with the world's biggest built world institutions from $T alternative assets investors, prolific developers and even governments to push the frontier of what's possible. We're backed by c-suite from Blackstone and OpenAI alongside the world's best venture capital firms.

Join us in shaping the future of the Built World and exponentially accelerate your career in the process. We welcome you to do your life's work here.

About the role

Build is building an autonomous factory for knowledge work. The platform is the factory floor: where experts run work, where workflows are created and managed, where Build is accessed by the outside world, and where the organisation itself runs.

This role owns the experience of that platform. Not the data layer underneath it. The surface that people actually use.

That means the workflow builder that lets domain experts create and configure workflows without engineering. The interfaces through which clients and internal teams drive work output. The gateway that makes Build accessible via email, Slack, and API. The automation that runs the organisation itself. The speed and quality of every surface the team and the world touches.

Build's internal operations are a product too. How the team coordinates, how work is routed, how progress is visible, how feedback loops close. You own that as much as the customer-facing surfaces.

What you will own

• The workflow builder: domain experts should be able to create, edit, and test workflows without engineering involvement
• The platform surfaces that drive work output for the internal delivery team
• The gateways through which Build is accessed externally: email, Slack, API
• Build's internal automation: the organisation running as a product
• The speed, reliability, and quality of everything above

How to win at Build

Growing Build requires a radically different approach to company building. As a company we're focused on one outcome: winning. That means we move fast, work with intensity, and demand excellence from ourselves. We operate with intensity but create an environment that allows for a lot of fun together. The result is that we're one of the fastest shipping teams in vertical AI, partnering with the best to automate the world around us.

Performance and teamwork are the core of Build's operation. We look for those who are able to do both, who often exhibit a particular ability for;

  • Velocity: You are relentless in asking the right questions to set direction. Once you find the right direction you go all-in.

  • Excellence: You obsess with being the best. For you, excellence is a non-negotiable standard rather than an aspiration.

  • Long time horizons: You choose to be in something for the long run, because that's where most of the returns are realized.

  • Ownership: You take full ownership of the outcomes. You're meticulous in your pursuits and believe you can actively shape your environment rather than adapt to it.

  • Customers: You have a passion for the built world and those who shape it. You probably have a quirky hobby or story that relates to your love for building.

  • Integrity: You chose to do the right thing even when it isn't easy.

  • Trust: You only work with people you can trust because it's the only way to do truly extraordinary things.

  • Yield: You have a burning need to see a result on every action you take and you're always looking for routes to do more with less.

What we offer

  • Radical autonomy, real ownership: High standards. Minimal bureaucracy. You own problems end-to-end, choose how the work gets done, and are accountable for exceptional outcomes. Ownership is matched with meaningful, generous equity.

  • An accelerated founder's track: Build is for builders. If you want to learn what it actually takes to create a generational company - Product judgment, execution speed, and accountability - there is no faster path than building from zero when everything is for grabs.

  • Elite teammates, uncompromising bar: You work with people who think clearly, execute relentlessly, and take full ownership. The team you build becomes the company you build. Growth here is not just professional; it reshapes how you operate and in return how Build operates.

  • Perpetual adventure: We attract the strongest of the strange. Extraordinary experiences are part of the culture - from the food we eat together to the space we occupy. Intensity is intentional.

  • Shape the built world: We are rebuilding how the physical world gets made. Our software doesn't live in the abstract - it turns into real projects breaking ground because we exist. We work with the largest institutions, push the frontier of AI, and watch our decisions translate directly into the world around us.
