title: Member of Technical Staff, GPU Kernels
description:
At SF Tensor, we're building the future of high-performance compute

We firmly believe that the future of AI depends on the unglamorous: rethinking and rebuilding the stack, all the way down. From the hardware underneath it to the compiler targeting it and the cloud running it. Right now those three things fight each other and that friction shows up as a tax on every researcher trying to build something ambitious. We're here to axe that tax and make compute faster, cheaper and more available. When we succeed, compute will be portable enough that "which cloud, which chip" stop being something you worry about.

To achieve this, we are building our Kernel Optimizer, which takes code and finds its fastest possible form for whatever vendor and cluster topology you point it at, automatically, as well as the Model Foundry which manages the runs, makes research easier and moves workloads across clouds and chips as prices and availability ship, instead of leaving you locked into whatever vendor you signed with first.

We're backed by Susa Ventures, Y Combinator, along with some great funds and angels including Max Mullen and Paul Graham, as well as founders and executives at Neuralink, Notion and AMD. We're looking for researchers, engineers and organizations who agree with the basic premise: you don't get the next leap in AI without a leap in compute first.

About the Role

We build the fastest GPU compiler in the world. Most compilers have to preserve correctness at every transform, constraining how far they can search, while we prove correctness at the end instead, allowing us to search a far wider space, with agents, with RL, with anything that works and still guarantee the result. It's why we hold #1 on NVIDIA's own kernel benchmark across hundreds of production kernels.

We're hiring a Member of Technical Staff for GPU Kernel Engineering to establish and push the envelope on what the hardware can actually do before any search ever runs. To this extent, you'll write and hand-optimize kernels that execute during pre-training, post-training and inference, across NVIDIA, AMD, TPU and Trainium. You'll then take those learnings and convert them into structures the compiler can search: instruction sequences, scheduling strategies, cost signals, to ensure that the ceiling you worked for by hand can become the floor for the search finding kernels everywhere else.

You'll have access to better tooling than anywhere else because we own the stack all the way down to the ISA, allowing us to create kernels that others can't even express. For example, our custom LLVM backend emits cubins directly, without a PTX handoff or ptxas doing our scheduling, letting us write kernels that have no expression in CUDA at all. Our team understands the hardware better than anyone else, to this extent we've built a bit-exact software model of Blackwell's tcgen05.

You'll be writing kernels that ship immediately on runs such as pre-training AlphaFold v3 at 3.4× the throughput, post-training robotics models on Trainium or running our custom RL rollout engine on TPU at multi-100B parameter scale.

What You'll Do

  • You'll write and hand-optimize kernels for real workloads to find the ceiling before the search goes looking for it

  • You'll profile at the microarchitectural level: SM and CU utilization, warp stalls, memory bank conflicts, register pressure, instruction throughput, occupancy tradeoffs

  • You'll debug down to the clock behavior, thermal throttling and driver paths where the docs are often missing or just wrong

  • You'll turn hard-won knowledge into a machine-searchable structure the compiler can explore on it's own

  • You'll work below PTX at the ISA-level, reasoning about SASS and cubins to emit schedules PTX has no way to express

  • You'll build the performance models, microbenchmarks and tooling that lets us predict kernel behavior

  • You'll work alongside the formal correctness team, so that aggressive, unintuitive kernels ship with a formal proof attached

Expect roughly two-thirds of your time on kernels and one-third on turning what you learned into the compiler search space.

What We're Looking For

  • Someone with a track record of hand-writing kernels that match or beat vendor libraries

  • Someone comfortable reading PTX, SASS, GCN/CDNA ISA or equivalent machine-level assembly

  • Someone fluent with low-level profiling tools: Nsight Compute, Nsight Systems, rocprof, omniperf or their equivalent

  • Someone with solid systems programming skills in C++ and CUDA or ROCm/HIP with a working understanding of how high-level ML operations map onto the hardware, including where the framework layers get in the way

Nice to Have

  • Someone who's worked on compiler backends (MLIR, LLVM, codegen, instruction selection, scheduling)

  • Someone who's done research in the areas of superoptimization, program synthesis, formal verification or search-based compilation

  • Someone who's worked with silicon beyond NVIDIA (AMD MI-series, TPU, Trainium) or mobile edge GPUs (Metal, Mali, Aderno)

  • Someone who's worked on distributed AI training at depth

  • Someone with experience in high-speed interconnects (NVLink, NVSwitch, InfiniBand, RoCE)

  • Someone with an HPC background: large-scale scientific computing, MPI, supercomputing

  • Someone who's worked in driver development or has a background in EE, computer architecture or hardware design

Why Join Us

This role is for someone who wants to know why things are fast or slow on the actual silicon and is tired of watching that knowledge die undocumented in their own head the moment they move on to the next thing. The compiler takes what you found and runs the same search across every workload we touch, on every vendor's hardware, meaning every optimization compounds across thousands of kernels going forward.

We're a small team operating at frontier scale. We pre-trained foundation models on 4,000 AMD GPUs as a team of three, designed and brought up GB300 NVL72 clusters and designed a TOP500 supercomputer.

We believe that hard problems get solved in person and most of our work happens at our office in San Francisco. We offer relocation assistance and, where possible, we'd like you here as often as possible.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $285,000-$315,000, plus meaningful equity and benefits.

The company's diverse portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for tardive dyskinesia, chorea associated with Huntington's disease, classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia, hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome, endometriosis* and uterine fibroids*, as well as a robust pipeline including multiple compounds in mid- to late-phase clinical development across our core therapeutic areas. For more than three decades, we have applied our unique insight into neuroscience and the interconnections between brain and body systems to treat complex conditions. We relentlessly pursue medicines to ease the burden of debilitating diseases and disorders, because you deserve brave science. For more information, visit neurocrine.com, and follow the company on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and YouTube. (*in collaboration with AbbVie)

title: Member of Technical Staff, Product Engineering
description:
At SF Tensor, we're building the future of high-performance compute

We firmly believe that the future of AI depends on the unglamorous: rethinking and rebuilding the stack, all the way down. From the hardware underneath it to the compiler targeting it and the cloud running it. Right now those three things fight each other and that friction shows up as a tax on every researcher trying to build something ambitious. We're here to axe that tax and make compute faster, cheaper and more available. When we succeed, compute will be portable enough that "which cloud, which chip" stop being something you worry about.

To achieve this, we are building our Kernel Optimizer, which takes code and finds its fastest possible form for whatever vendor and cluster topology you point it at, automatically, as well as the Model Foundry which manages the runs, makes research easier and moves workloads across clouds and chips as prices and availability ship, instead of leaving you locked into whatever vendor you signed with first.

We're backed by Susa Ventures, Y Combinator, along with some great funds and angels including Max Mullen and Paul Graham, as well as founders and executives at Neuralink, Notion and AMD. We're looking for researchers, engineers and organizations who agree with the basic premise: you don't get the next leap in AI without a leap in compute first.

About the Role

We build the fastest GPU compiler in the world. Most compilers have to preserve correctness at every transform, constraining how far they can search, while we prove correctness at the end instead, allowing us to search a far wider space, with agents, with RL, with anything that works and still guarantee the result. It's why we hold #1 on NVIDIA's own kernel benchmark across hundreds of production kernels.

Speed at the kernel layer is only worth what we do with it though, so we're hiring a Member of Technical Staff for Product Engineering to own the surface that the engine reaches the world through.

That surface is Model Foundry and it takes a researcher from idea to a running experiment in one commit or one message. When a researcher needs to see the perplexity curve from last night's run or to try an experiment with a new annealing rate, Foundry writes the config, queues the job on whatever silicon makes sense that week, then stream the logs back and versions the whole thing so it can be reproduced six months later. You'll own it end to end from the interfaces researchers live in all day to the services behind them, making sure the software doesn't just work, but the experience feels right and is enjoyable even when using it 16 hours a day for months on end.

The users are close and the loop is short. Foundry is used by both our customers, our internal research team as well as our forward-deployed researchers to train models every hour of the day, so your users either sit next to you or a Slack message away. The data you're processing is not gentle: you'll be processing telemetry from thousands of GPUs across NVIDIA, AMD, TPU and Trainium from runs that last for weeks to months parsing logs and charts that don't stop and making sure all of the data is accessible to user as well as their agents.

What You'll Do

  • You'll take full ownership of product areas in Model Foundry: scoping, designing, building and iterating on them

  • You'll build clean, fast and polished web interfaces with NextJS that feel almost native

  • You'll design the surfaces where researchers live: run dashboards, live log streaming, experiment comparison, eval results, cluster and storage views

  • You'll build the conversational and commit-driven entry points into Foundry, where a Slack message or commit become a training run

  • You'll obsess over the small things, from loading states to smooth animations and the edge cases that turn a good product into an exceptional one

  • You'll work directly with our forward-deployed researcher and our own training team. They're your users, they sit next to you and their feedback loop is measured in minutes

  • You'll make smart product tradeoffs with little hand-holding, which means knowing when to ship fast and when to spend extra time polishing

What We're Looking For

  • Someone with proven experience shipping complete products, ideally something you can show us

  • Someone with real taste and a sharp eye for design and motion, which means you notice when an animation eases awkwardly, when padding feels inconsistent or something just feels cheap

  • Someone with solid backend chips, which means you can build APIs and troubleshoot production issues

  • Someone with enough infrastructure comfort to handle AWS, containers and Kubernetes (you don't need to be a DevOps wizard but shouldn't be scared of a Dockerfile either)

Nice to Have

  • Someone with experience working with Bun or an eagerness to dive in

  • Someone with a background in developer tools, infrastructure products or building for technical users

  • Someone with any exposure to ML training workflows or tools like Weights & Biases, Ray or Slurm

  • Someone comfortable using Figma to mock up things yourself when needed

Why Join Us

Most infrastructure companies treat their interface as an afterthought and their users can tell. The engineering and engine behind our product is as good as it gets and the product on top deserves to be just as good. You'll be defining what researchers at frontier labs feel when they train a model and are staring at logs and curves for hours on end with the goal of making the research experience as enjoyable as possible and let the infrastructure get out of the way and fade into the background.

We're a small team operating at frontier scale. We pre-trained foundation models on 4,000 AMD GPUs as a team of three, designed and brought up GB300 NVL72 clusters and designed a TOP500 supercomputer.

We believe that hard problems get solved in person and most of our work happens at our office in San Francisco. We offer relocation assistance and, where possible, we'd like you here as often as possible.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $225,000-$275,000, plus meaningful equity and benefits.

title: Sr Director, Revenue Cycle Management
description:
It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

The Senior Director, Revenue Cycle Management provides enterprise-wide leadership for Sarah Cannon Research Institute's (SCRI) revenue cycle operations across both the Site Management Organization (SMO) and Contract Research Organization (CRO). This role oversees the full research revenue cycle, from budget and contract development through study startup, billing compliance, invoicing, collections, and revenue realization.

Reporting to this role are the Director of Revenue Cycle and, through a dotted-line relationship, the Director of Budgets & Contracts (SMO), ensuring seamless alignment between upstream contracting activities and downstream revenue cycle execution. The Senior Director is responsible for driving operational excellence, compliance, standardization, process efficiency, and financial performance across the network.

This is a remote U.S.-based position. Preference will be given to candidates in the greater Nashville, TN area. Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.

What You'll Do

  • Define and execute SCRI's revenue cycle strategy across SMO and CRO operations, aligning departmental goals with enterprise financial objectives.

  • Lead, develop, and retain a multi-level organization, including direct oversight of the Director of Revenue Cycle and dotted-line leadership of the Director of Budgets & Contracts.

  • Drive integration between budgets, contracts, study startup, billing, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition to create a streamlined end-to-end revenue cycle.

  • Prioritize resources, technology investments, and process improvement initiatives that improve compliance, cash flow, profitability, and operational efficiency.

  • Establish and maintain scalable processes, controls, and documentation that optimize revenue cycle performance and billing compliance.

  • Ensure compliance with clinical research billing requirements, coverage analyses, contract terms, accounting standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Partner with Finance, Operations, Legal, and Executive Leadership to evaluate financial performance across studies, sponsors, projects, and business units, and drive resulting action plans.

  • Lead monthly operating reviews and executive reporting on key metrics, including accounts receivable, days sales outstanding (DSO), unbilled revenue, aged balances, write-offs, and cycle times.

  • Serve as a strategic advisor on revenue cycle best practices, operational improvements, and growth initiatives.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications for Success

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree strongly preferred.

  • Minimum 1 year of Director-level experience with direct people leadership responsibilities.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in revenue cycle, receivables, finance, or a related discipline, including at least 3 years within healthcare or clinical research.

  • Seven or more years of progressive leadership experience preferred, including experience leading managers and/or directors.

  • Clinical research industry experience strongly preferred, particularly within both SMO and CRO environments.

  • Working knowledge of clinical trial budgets, site contracts, coverage analysis, Medicare Clinical Trial Policy, and research billing compliance requirements preferred.

  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial systems, reporting, and revenue cycle operations.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Engineering Lead
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Engineering Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Front Office Representative
description:
Position Summary

The Front Office Representative is responsible for the full scope of front office operations, including patient check-in, check-out, scheduling, phone management, and cross-coverage across clinic locations. This role ensures a seamless patient experience from initial contact through visit completion while maintaining accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.

This position serves as the first point of contact for patients and plays a critical role in patient flow, revenue cycle support, and overall clinic operations. The role requires strong communication, multitasking, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced healthcare environment.


Duties and Responsibilities

Patient Scheduling and Phone Management

• Manage high-volume inbound and outbound calls in a timely and professional manner
• Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments including consultations, follow-ups, testing, and procedures
• Route calls appropriately based on patient needs, urgency, and department workflows
• Provide clear and accurate information regarding appointments, preparation instructions, and clinic policies
• Work recall lists, task buckets, and provider requests to ensure appropriate patient follow-up
• Verify and update patient demographics, insurance, and referring provider information during scheduling
• Address patient inquiries, concerns, and requests or escalate as appropriate


Front Desk Check-In Operations

• Greet patients promptly and professionally upon arrival
• Complete patient check-in by verifying identification, insurance, and required documentation
• Collect copays, deductibles, and outstanding balances in accordance with company policy
• Ensure all required forms, consents, and documentation are completed prior to services
• Maintain accurate and complete patient records within the electronic medical record system
• Communicate patient arrival and status updates to clinical staff to support efficient patient flow


Patient Check-Out Operations

• Complete check-out process including scheduling follow-up appointments per provider instructions
• Provide visit summaries, referrals, and any required patient instructions
• Process payments and ensure accurate posting to patient accounts
• Confirm future appointments and provide clear next steps to patients


Clinic Operations and Administrative Support

• Monitor and manage registration, scheduling, and front office work queues
• Maintain organized and accurate patient documentation, including scanning and indexing
• Coordinate with clinical staff, providers, and other departments to support daily operations
• Ensure compliance with HIPAA and all confidentiality standards
• Identify and resolve workflow or patient experience issues proactively
• Support revenue cycle processes through accurate data entry and collection practices


Cross-Coverage and Team Support

• Provide coverage for all front office functions including check-in, check-out, phones, and scheduling as needed
• Float to other clinic locations to support front office operations based on business and staffing needs
• Adapt quickly to different clinic workflows, providers, and patient volumes
• Collaborate with team members to maintain consistent service standards across all locations


Other Responsibilities

• Perform additional duties as assigned based on operational needs
• Participate in training and process improvement initiatives
• Maintain professionalism and represent the organization positively at all times

title: Research Analyst (AI Data Engineer)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities

Interested applicants are invited to apply directly at the NUS Career Portal. Please note your application will only be processed if you apply via NUS Career Portal. NUS Career Portal link - We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Background

The Asian Institute of Digital Finance (AIDF) is a university-level institute in NUS, jointly founded by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), the National Research Foundation (NRF) and NUS. AIDF aspires to be a thought leader, a Fintech knowledge hub, and an experimental site for developing digital financial technologies as well as for nurturing current and future Fintech researchers and practitioners in Asia. The Credit Research Initiative (CRI) is a non-profit undertaking under the AIDF. Pioneering the “public good” credit risk measures, the initiative is committed to advancing big data analytics and providing directly useful credit intelligence to academic and professional communities. Reliable data infrastructure sits at the core of our operations — from daily credit risk production to AI and LLM research. AIDF-CRI is dedicated to staying updated with the latest trends and technologies, and we are continually enhancing our data pipelines and applying AI to our research and workflows. We are looking for an AI Data Engineer who can take genuine ownership of this foundation and keep it evolving with the demands of the AI era. Responsibilities

Data underpins nearly everything we do: our credit risk measures, analytics, and AI models all depend on the quality of the data behind them. Efficient and reliable data collection, preparation, and delivery are easy to overlook, yet they are critical to high-performing models and trustworthy research. At its core, therefore, this is a data engineering role in the AI era. The selected candidate will take ownership of our existing data pipelines, databases, scheduling and monitoring, and operate them reliably. Beyond this core scope, the role also offers opportunities to gain additional exposure to research-oriented work targeting top AI conferences and/or R&D work under our industrial research collaborations. Particularly, the responsibilities will include: Data Pipeline Ownership & Maintenance

Operate, maintain, and enhance our existing ETL/ELT data pipelines.Own scheduling and workflow orchestration, including monitoring, alerting, data quality checks, and incident recovery, to keep pipelines reliable.Develop and optimize data models and schemas to support analytics, reporting, and machine learning requirements. Database & Infrastructure Management

Manage and tune our relational, NoSQL, and vector databases for storage, querying, and retrieval workloads.Improve the robustness, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness of the data infrastructure as data volumes and use cases grow. AI Research & Automation

Where involved, contribute to research projects targeting top AI conferences, and/or R&D work under our industrial research collaborations, building on deep familiarity with our data assets.Occasional ad-hoc tasks applying LLM-based agents to automate parts of our data collection, document processing, and other internal workflows. Team Collaboration & Documentation

Collaborate with financial analysts and the R&D team to ensure data accessibility and usability.Maintain comprehensive documentation of pipelines, system architecture, and database schemas to promote knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding. Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with solid software practices (e.g., Git, virtual environments, testing mindset). Hands-on experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT data pipelines on cloud platforms; working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform and/or Snowflake is strongly preferred. Experience with workflow orchestration and scheduling tools (e.g., Airflow / Cloud Composer), including monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting of production data pipelines. Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, MongoDB) — designing schemas, writing performant queries, and managing day-to-day operations. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and documentation skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Bonus Skills

Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into data pipelines or internal workflows — e.g., RAG / vector search, fine-tuning, or agentic automation. Exposure to vector databases or extensions (e.g., Milvus, PostgreSQL with pgvector). Experience applying NLP to alternative data at scale, such as news articles, financial filings, and social media content. Publications, open-source contributions, or a strong project portfolio; interest in pursuing research toward top AI conferences. Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud deployment. Familiarity with machine learning techniques in a financial context Tell employers what skills you have Communication Data Pipeline Documentation Information Technology Computer Science Writing Data Science Laboratory Infrastructure Management Research

title: Interventional Cardiologist | High Volume + Partnership Track | Baton Rouge, LA
description:
Cardiovascular Logistics (CVL) is seeking a Board Certified or Board Eligible Interventional Cardiologist to join Cardiovascular Institute of the South (CIS) in Baton Rouge, LA.

About Cardiovascular Institute of the South

Founded in 1983, Cardiovascular Institute of the South has earned a national reputation for innovation, clinical excellence, and physician leadership. You will join a nationally respected, physician-led cardiovascular organization that combines the resources of a large group with the autonomy, collaboration, and physician-focused culture of an established practice. CIS is also home to a nationally recognized Peripheral Interventional Fellowship program led by Dr. Craig Walker. We are committed to providing physicians with the clinical support, technology, and infrastructure needed to build a successful and rewarding practice. CIS offers tremendous opportunities for professional growth while maintaining a strong focus on physician satisfaction and patient care.

The organization includes:

  • 63 Physicians
  • 59 Advanced Practice Clinicians
  • 43 Interventional Cardiologists
  • 14 Non-Invasive Cardiologists
  • 6 Electrophysiologists
  • 21 locations across Louisiana and Mississippi
  • 9 telecardiology sites

Position Highlights

  • Interventional schedule includes hospital, clinic, and procedures in OBL/ASC settings
  • 24/7 Virtual Care Center support with APCs taking first call for physicians
  • Partnership opportunity with long-term wealth creation
  • Opportunity to perform coronary and peripheral interventions
  • Full-time opportunity
  • Dedicated APC support in the clinic and hospital
  • 9 telecardiology sites and OMS EHR
  • Established referral base with high new patient volume
  • Physician-led practice with opportunities for long-term growth and leadership
  • Excellent group reputation with supportive administration
  • Hospital systems include Lane Regional Medical Center, Thibodaux Regional Medical Center, Lafayette General Medical Center, and Opelousas General Health System

The Ideal Candidate

You may be an excellent fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Are Board Certified or Board Eligible in Interventional Cardiology
  • Are fellowship trained in Interventional Cardiology
  • Want a high-volume practice with an established patient and referral base
  • Are interested in performing both coronary and peripheral interventions
  • Value access to OBL/ASC procedural settings
  • Want the opportunity to build long-term equity through partnership
  • Appreciate clinical autonomy while having strong physician and APC support
  • Enjoy working in a collaborative, patient-centered environment
  • Are seeking a better quality of life with an incredible work/life balance
  • Have completed a U.S. residency program
  • Are eligible for Louisiana medical licensure
  • DO NOT require J-1 visa sponsorship

Compensation & Benefits

CIS offers a comprehensive recruitment and compensation package designed to support your professional success and transition to the Lafayette community.

  • Competitive base salary with strong earning potential
  • Sign-on bonus
  • Relocation assistance
  • Productivity-based compensation
  • Partnership opportunity
  • Paid time off
  • CME allowance and dedicated CME time
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • Retirement plan
  • Student loan assistance through Navigate

Why Baton Rouge, Louisiana?

Baton Rouge offers cardiologists an exciting combination of career opportunities, vibrant culture, and Southern quality of life. As Louisiana’s capital city, Baton Rouge has a strong and growing healthcare community, excellent restaurants, live music, sports, festivals, and a rich blend of Cajun, Creole, and Southern culture. The area offers a variety of family-friendly communities, affordable housing options compared with many larger metropolitan areas, and plenty of opportunities to enjoy the outdoors along the Mississippi River and nearby lakes and parks. Baton Rouge also provides convenient access to New Orleans and Lafayette, making it easy to enjoy even more dining, entertainment, and cultural experiences. For a cardiologist looking to build a rewarding career while enjoying great food, a welcoming community, and an affordable Southern lifestyle, Baton Rouge is a fantastic place to call home.

Interested in Learning More?

If you are looking for an opportunity that combines clinical autonomy, strong earning potential, partnership, professional growth, and an exceptional quality of life, we would love to tell you more about CIS and Baton Rouge. Apply now and our team will reach out to schedule a phone call with you. We invite you to apply here or contact Sylvia at Sylvia.Moyle@cvlhealth.com.

title: Pediatric Neuropsychologist, Epilepsy
description:
Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago provides superior pediatric care in a setting that offers the latest benefits and innovations in medical technology, research and family-friendly design. As the largest pediatric provider in the region with a 140-year legacy of excellence, kids and their families are at the center of all we do. Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago is ranked in all 10 specialties by the U.S. News & World Report.

Location

Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children's Hospital of Chicago

Job Description

General Summary:

Provides neuropsychological assessment, diagnostic, and treatment services to patients and their families. Provides consultation to Lurie Children’s medical services (e.g., Cardiology, Endocrinology, Hematology/Oncology, Neurology, Neurosurgery) regarding the neurocognitive status of their patients and its relationship to medical-neurological disease factors and treatment factors. Understands the growth, development, and cultural needs of neonatal, pediatric, and adolescent patients and integrates this into the delivery of care.

The position actively supports the Hospital’s and the Department’s Continuous Quality Improvement and customer service goals through modeling of appropriate behavior and by providing a work environment conducive to attaining these goals.

The position also adheres to the Hospital’s and the Department’s commitment to equitable access to care and to the neuropsychology community’s commitment to racial, cultural, and social justice.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Conducts diagnostic evaluations using neuropsychological testing measures; interprets and communicates results. Designs protocols for monitoring the cognitive, socioemotional, and behavioral status of medical patient populations. Interfaces with outpatient clinic programs of Lurie Children’s medical services for the purpose of monitoring their patient populations.

  • Maintains appropriate clinical documentation in the electronic medical record in a timely manner. Writes letters, notes, and formal clinical reports on patient contacts. Communicates progress over the telephone, via telemedicine, and via the electronic medical record as appropriate.

  • Follows protocols and procedures of the Department of Child & Adolescent Psychiatry and Lurie Children’s Hospital.

  • Participates in the APA-approved internship training program and training programs for psychology practicum students and fellows, the social work student training program, and the child and adolescent psychiatry and general psychiatry residency program by preparing and presenting seminar topics and providing supervision to psychology trainees.

  • Collaborates and consults with medical providers, schools, and social service agencies as well as city, county, and state funding and placement agencies through oral and written presentation of clinical findings and recommendations. Completes all case management duties of assigned cases including discharge planning, completion of the diagnostic evaluation and referrals to appropriate support services as needed.

  • Participates in rounds, patient care conferences, diagnostic and treatment staff team meetings, multidisciplinary case conferences, and discipline-specific team meetings.

  • Engages in research related to pediatric neuropsychology and, when appropriate, in program evaluation. Scholarly activities and research related to the disorders encountered in their work or treatment approaches used in their clinical activities is strongly encouraged

  • Assists in the training and supervision of psychometrists/neuropsychology technicians.

  • Works with team members to provide appropriate coverage for scheduled absences.

  • Maintains test equipment and supplies of the Neuropsychology service as state-of-the-art resources.

  • Participates in continuing education events including hospital and department mandatory education courses and courses required to maintain professional certification/licensure requirements.

  • Performs job functions adhering to customer service principles of innovation, service excellence, and teamwork to provide the highest quality care and service to our patients, families, co-workers and others.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Minimum education required to perform job: a doctoral degree in clinical psychology with appropriate internship and a two-year post-doctoral fellowship in pediatric neuropsychology. If degree is in a related area (e.g., human development) must have completed APA-approved internship.

  • Required licensure and/or certification: Must be licensed in the State of Illinois prior to start date. If employee is license-eligible, employee must obtain license and be granted clinical privileges before start date.

  • Must be board certified or eligible for board certification in clinical neuropsychology through ABPP/ABCN.

  • Trained in aspects of clinical and/or behavioral translational research.

  • Ability to think proactively, act creatively, and take initiative appropriately. Excellent verbal and written communication, critical-thinking, and interpersonal skills.

  • Documented track record of academic productivity/potential, including peer-reviewed publications and grant applications.

  • Demonstrated ability to work as a part of a multidisciplinary team.

  • Special physical requirements – sits and stands throughout the day. Physical management of patients in crisis situation may be necessary.

  • Basic Life Support Certification required within sixty days of hire.

  • Spanish language fluency is preferable.

Education

title: Agency Assistant
description:
Full Circle Recruiting, LLC is seeking a highly organized, dependable, and proactive Agency Assistant to support the day-to-day operations of our recruiting and staffing business. This position will work closely with recruiters and management to keep candidates, clients, job orders, schedules, documentation, and administrative tasks organized and moving efficiently.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who can multitask, prioritize competing deadlines, maintain confidentiality, and work independently in a fast-paced recruiting environment.
Recruiting Support

* Assist recruiters with candidate sourcing, screening, and follow-up.
* Post and maintain job advertisements across recruiting platforms.
* Review resumes and applications for basic qualifications.
* Contact candidates regarding job opportunities, interviews, availability, and required documentation.
* Schedule candidate interviews and coordinate calendars between candidates, recruiters, and clients.
* Maintain accurate candidate records and update applicant information.
* Conduct candidate follow-ups and help maintain an active candidate pipeline.
* Assist with reference checks, background-check coordination, credential verification, and onboarding paperwork as needed.

Client & Job Order Support

* Assist with entering and maintaining client job orders.
* Track open positions and candidate submissions.
* Prepare candidate information and submission packages for clients.
* Communicate professionally with clients regarding scheduling, documentation, and candidate status.
* Maintain organized records of client contacts, job requirements, and recruiting activity.
* Assist with follow-up communications to prospective and existing clients.

Administrative & Office Support

* Manage emails, phone calls, calendars, and general correspondence.
* Maintain electronic files and recruiting records.
* Prepare reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and other business documents.
* Track deadlines, interviews, candidate statuses, and onboarding requirements.
* Assist with invoicing, timesheet collection, payroll-related documentation, and other administrative functions as needed.
* Maintain confidentiality of candidate, employee, and client information.
* Assist with general office organization and day-to-day agency operations.

Business Development Support

* Research prospective clients and potential business opportunities.
* Assist with maintaining prospect lists and CRM records.
* Help prepare outreach materials, proposals, capability statements, and presentations.
* Support email and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.
* Track leads, follow-ups, meetings, and business-development activity.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor's degree preferred.
* 1–3 years of administrative, recruiting, staffing, customer service, or office experience preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Professional phone and email etiquette.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Comfortable working with Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, spreadsheets, email, and online systems.
* Ability to learn applicant tracking systems (ATS), CRM platforms, job boards, and recruiting software.
* Ability to handle confidential information professionally.
* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently.

Preferred Skills

* Recruiting or staffing agency experience.
* Experience with an ATS or CRM.
* LinkedIn recruiting or sourcing experience.
* Experience with job boards such as Indeed, ZipRecruiter, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with healthcare, engineering, IT, manufacturing, or professional staffing.
* Experience with business development or lead generation.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

Ideal Candidate

* Highly organized and naturally keeps things on track.
* Proactive rather than waiting to be told what needs to be done.
* Detail-oriented and able to catch errors before they become problems.
* Professional and personable when communicating with candidates and clients.
* Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new software quickly.
* Resourceful and able to find solutions independently.
* Reliable and accountable with strong follow-through.
* Comfortable working in a small-business environment where priorities can change quickly.

Performance Expectations
* Keep recruiting and administrative processes organized.
* Respond to candidates and clients promptly and professionally.
* Maintain accurate candidate and client records.
* Keep recruiters informed of important updates and deadlines.
* Ensure follow-ups and scheduled activities are completed.
* Support recruiters in moving candidates efficiently through the hiring process.
* Contribute to a professional and positive candidate/client experience.

Job Description:

Transform technology into opportunity as a Systems Architect with GDIT supporting the National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA). In this mission-focused role, you’ll shape secure, scalable enterprise IT and cloud solutions that directly impact how a critical U.S. government agency operates. This position is on-site in Denver, CO.

As a Systems Architect at GDIT, you will be a recognized technical leader responsible for designing, evaluating, and guiding enterprise and cloud architectures that align with business and mission needs. You will drive architectural decisions, modernize existing environments, and provide thought leadership on current and emerging technologies—especially around DNS, Azure, AWS, cloud migrations, on‑premises infrastructure, and Linux.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT
As a Systems Architect, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of the National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA). You will play a crucial role via the following:

  • Serve as a trusted solutions architecture expert, recognized as an industry leader in your domain.
  • Identify and design solutions based on business and technical requirements; assess alternatives, analyze trade-offs, and recommend optimal architectures.
  • Research and evaluate current and emerging technologies, tools, and methods, and recommend where to adopt, adapt, or refine processes and standards.
  • Assess existing system and business process architectures and work with stakeholders to recommend improvements for performance, security, and efficiency.
  • Ensure technical architecture teams deliver effective, scalable, and secure system and cloud solutions that support organizational goals and mission objectives.
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain service design procedures and processes using established frameworks and methodologies.
  • Prepare and deliver technical presentations, test plans, and analytical briefings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Elicit and refine customer requirements, evaluate alternatives, and recommend products and configurations across software, platform, network, and cloud domains.
  • Design, plan, and deploy DNS architectures with an emphasis on scalability, reliability, and security.
  • Implement and optimize monitoring tools and alerts to proactively detect and address performance and security issues.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams to integrate on-premises and cloud-based solutions into the broader enterprise environment.
  • Support and guide cloud migration initiatives, including assessment, planning, and execution of application and infrastructure migrations to Azure and AWS.
  • Provide clear status updates on cost, schedule, risks, and quality to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Coach and mentor less-experienced professionals; may serve as a team or task lead.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your technology expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT. The Systems Architect must have:

● Education: Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science

● Experience: 15+ years of related experience

● Technical Skills & Capabilities (Required):

  • Deep expertise in DNS architecture, with the ability to clearly explain DNS concepts and intricacies to technical teams.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing solutions in Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Cloud migration expertise, including understanding of migration strategies and patterns (e.g., rehost, replatform, refactor) and experience supporting or leading migrations of workloads to Azure and/or AWS.
  • Strong understanding of on-premises infrastructure, including:
    • VDI solutions
    • Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)
    • VMware technologies, including load balancing concepts and integrations
    • Microsoft 365 / Office 365 (O365) services and integrations with on-prem and cloud environments
  • Experience with Linux (e.g., system administration, troubleshooting, integration in mixed Windows/Linux environments, and supporting Linux workloads on-prem and in the cloud).
  • Familiarity with DNS-related and network services technologies such as Infoblox or similar platforms.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

● Security Clearance Level: Must possess an active Top Secret Clearance -or- active DOE Q Access Authorization.

● US Citizenship Required.

● This position is subject to random drug screening.

● Location: On customer site in Denver, CO., Washington, D.C., Germantown, MD, or Albuquerque, NM

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.


● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities.
● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals.
● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off.
● Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home.
● Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace.

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore an enterprise IT career at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your desire to drive operations forward.

We're looking for someone who doesn't simply produce reports—they understand how a business operates, can identify opportunities for improvement, and can use NetSuite, data and technology to make those improvements happen.

The Role

Reporting to senior management, the Business Systems & Data Analyst will become a key internal resource for Oracle NetSuite ERP, business intelligence, reporting, data integrity, process improvement and automation.

You will work across Sales, Customer Service, Procurement, Finance, Warehouse, Operations and Marketing to understand how each department operates and identify opportunities to improve systems, reporting and productivity.

A major focus of this position will be ensuring Matthews is getting the maximum possible value from its investment in Oracle NetSuite.

What You'll Be Doing

Oracle NetSuite ERP

Act as a key internal Oracle NetSuite subject matter expert and provide strong functional knowledge of the platform across the business.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Understanding and improving existing NetSuite processes and workflows

  • Developing and maintaining Saved Searches, reports, dashboards and KPIs

  • Building role-specific dashboards that provide teams with clear, relevant information

  • Reviewing how NetSuite is currently configured and identifying opportunities to better utilise existing functionality

  • Supporting NetSuite users across different departments

  • Troubleshooting system and process issues

  • Improving user adoption and consistency

  • Reviewing roles, permissions and system access in conjunction with management

  • Assisting with NetSuite configuration and system enhancements

  • Identifying opportunities to automate repetitive processes within NetSuite

  • Working with external NetSuite consultants and implementation partners when required

  • Testing and documenting system changes before deployment

  • Supporting integrations between NetSuite and other business platforms

  • Maintaining strong system documentation and process controls

  • Keeping up to date with NetSuite releases, functionality and opportunities relevant to the business

Strong practical knowledge and previous experience working with Oracle NetSuite ERP is essential for this position.

Data, Reporting & Business Intelligence

Develop reporting that gives management clear visibility of business performance and supports faster, better decision-making.

This will include analysis across areas such as:

  • Revenue and sales performance

  • Gross profit and gross margin

  • Customer profitability

  • Product and category performance

  • Salesperson and territory performance

  • Customer retention and purchasing behaviour

  • Pricing and discounting

  • Inventory levels and stock turns

  • Slow-moving and obsolete inventory

  • Stock availability and stock-outs

  • Procurement and supplier performance

  • Purchasing trends

  • Warehouse and operational performance

  • Freight and distribution costs

  • Working capital

  • Business productivity and efficiency

Develop and maintain management dashboards using NetSuite and business intelligence/reporting tools such as Microsoft Power BI.

The goal is to move the business toward having accurate, easily accessible and increasingly real-time information rather than relying heavily on manually prepared spreadsheets and reports.

Data Integrity & Governance

Take ownership of improving the quality and reliability of data across key business systems.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Identifying data-quality issues

  • Developing processes to improve data accuracy

  • Monitoring master-data integrity

  • Identifying duplicate, incomplete or inconsistent records

  • Improving customer, supplier and product data structures

  • Establishing reporting standards

  • Ensuring consistent definitions for business KPIs

  • Working with department managers to improve data-entry disciplines

The successful candidate will understand that good business reporting starts with good underlying data.

Process Improvement & Automation

Work across the organisation to identify processes that can be simplified, automated or eliminated.

You will:

  • Map existing business processes

  • Identify manual and repetitive tasks

  • Recommend better system-based processes

  • Develop workflow automation

  • Reduce unnecessary spreadsheet-based processes

  • Improve information flow between departments

  • Identify opportunities to eliminate double-handling and duplicate data entry

  • Improve system controls and approvals

  • Measure the benefits delivered from process improvements

You should naturally question:

"Why are we doing this manually if our systems can do it for us?"

AI & Emerging Technology

Help Matthews identify practical opportunities to use AI, automation and emerging technologies to improve productivity.

This could include:

  • Automating administrative processes

  • Improving internal knowledge access

  • Assisting with data analysis

  • Improving reporting

  • Supporting customer-service efficiency

  • Sales analysis and opportunity identification

  • Document and information processing

  • Workflow automation

The focus should always be on practical commercial outcomes, rather than implementing technology simply for the sake of technology.

Commercial Analysis

Work with management to turn data into actionable commercial recommendations.

We don't just want someone who can tell us what happened.

We want someone who can help us understand:

Why did it happen?

Where is the opportunity?

Where are we losing margin or productivity?

What should we do differently?

Examples may include identifying:

  • Customers with declining spend

  • Customers purchasing below expected margins

  • Cross-selling opportunities

  • Product categories with strong or weak growth

  • Pricing inconsistencies

  • Unprofitable products or customers

  • Excess inventory

  • Supplier performance issues

  • Territory opportunities

  • Operational inefficiencies

  • Changes in customer purchasing behaviour

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will ideally have:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle NetSuite ERP

  • Demonstrated experience using NetSuite in a commercial business environment

  • Strong understanding of NetSuite Saved Searches, reporting, dashboards and KPIs

  • Experience improving NetSuite workflows and business processes

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI or similar BI/reporting platforms

  • Strong understanding of databases, data structures and reporting principles

  • Experience working with ERP data

  • Strong commercial understanding

  • Ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations

  • Excellent attention to detail

  • Strong communication skills

  • Ability to work effectively with people across all levels of a business

Experience within distribution, wholesale, importing, supply chain, warehousing or a similar B2B environment would be highly advantageous.

Experience with NetSuite integrations, SuiteAnalytics, SuiteFlow, SQL or similar technical capabilities would also be advantageous.

The Person We're Looking For

You'll be naturally curious and analytical.

When you see an inefficient process, you'll want to understand why it exists and how it can be improved.

You'll be comfortable moving between a management meeting discussing business performance and sitting with an operational team member understanding exactly how a process works inside NetSuite.

You'll have the confidence to challenge existing processes constructively and the practical ability to implement better solutions.

Most importantly, you'll combine systems knowledge with commercial thinking.

We're not looking for someone whose only focus is maintaining an ERP system.

We're looking for someone who can use NetSuite, data and technology to make Matthews a better business.

Key Measures of Success

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Increased utilisation of Oracle NetSuite functionality

  • Improved accuracy and accessibility of management reporting

  • Reduction in manual reporting and spreadsheet dependency

  • Improved data quality

  • Increased automation of repetitive processes

  • Improved NetSuite user adoption

  • Reduced administrative workload across departments

  • Faster access to meaningful business information

  • Successful implementation of system improvements

  • Measurable productivity improvements

  • Identification of commercial opportunities through data

  • Improved management visibility of company performance

Key Relationships

The Business Systems & Data Analyst will work closely with:

  • Managing Director

  • General Manager

  • Operations Manager

  • National Sales & Service Manager

  • Finance

  • Procurement

  • Sales

  • Customer Service

  • Warehouse & Distribution

  • Marketing

  • External Oracle NetSuite partners and technology providers

Qualifications & Experience

Ideally, you will have a qualification in one or more of the following areas:

  • Information Systems

  • Business Analytics

  • Data Analytics

  • Accounting / Finance

  • Computer Science

  • Business

  • Supply Chain

  • Or equivalent relevant professional experience

Previous hands-on Oracle NetSuite experience is a key requirement for this position.

Why Join Matthews?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of business systems and analytics within a growing New Zealand company.

Rather than being restricted to one department, you'll have the opportunity to work across the entire organisation and directly influence how we operate.

For the right person, this role provides significant scope to grow alongside the business and become an important part of Matthews' continued development.

title: Audit & Move-out Coordinator
description:

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Karius

Karius is a life science, venture-backed clinical metagenomics company, focused on elevating patient care through microbial insights. We are committed to advancing diagnostic science and technology to optimize the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases. Through the use of genomics and AI, we are driven to improve the diagnostic landscape for infectious diseases. Karius delivers unprecedented diagnostic insight detecting microbial cell-free DNA circulating in the body to assist physicians to make rapid treatment decisions.

Position Summary

We are building and operating a unique software stack of cloud infrastructure, software services, APIs, web and mobile interactive interfaces, and AI-driven data analytics pipelines to deliver life-saving results in the highly complex infectious disease landscape. We believe the success of Karius’ products is driven by both our unique technology and the elegance of the software solution. The Senior Software Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, reliable software solutions that support Karius’ products and mission. This role requires strong technical judgment, thoughtful problem-solving, and close collaboration across engineering, product, scientific, and clinical teams.

Why Should You Join Us?

Karius aims to conquer infectious diseases through innovations around genomic sequencing and machine learning. The company’s platform is already delivering unprecedented insights into the microbial landscape, providing clinicians with a comprehensive test capable of identifying more than a thousand pathogens directly from blood, and helping industry accelerate the development of therapeutic solutions. The products Karius offers today are some of the most advanced solutions available to physicians who aim to deliver better care to many otherwise ineffectively treated patients. Our tests are the result of some incredible work done by our scientists, statisticians, engineers, and physicians, all driven by the same mission. You, as part of the Karius team, will be able to see how directly your work has a life-changing impact on people, and at scale.

Reports to:

Senior Director, Engineering

Location:

Redwood City, CA (Hybrid) or Remote (USA)

Primary Responsibilities

  • Understand user needs, requirements and objectives by collaborating closely with cross-functional groups across Karius, including Engineering, Software Products, Analytics, Lab Operations, and other business partners, developing strong domain expertise to ensure software solutions align with operational and user needs.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation for system designs, software components, workflows, and operational procedures.
  • Implementation and end-to-end testing of software solutions and components.
  • Monitor the performance, reliability, and scalability of software systems and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Participate in design reviews and code reviews.
  • Support production deployments
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective and preventive solutions.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs, and provide recommendations to support informed engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the engineering lifecycle by collaborating on enhancements to tools, processes, and ways of working.
  • Develop strong domain expertise to ensure software solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with user and operational requirements.

What’s Fun About the Job?

Karius is operating at the edge of what is now known to be possible in diagnostics. With that, comes a wave of new and incredible challenges and opportunities. To deliver on that value, you will be tapping into some of the most advanced technologies, architecting and innovating where the current solutions simply don't suffice. You will get to see how much your work really matters.

Travel:

Up to 10% for onsite team building activities.

Physical Requirements

Subject to extended periods of sitting and/or standing, vision to monitor and moderate noise levels. Work is generally performed in an office, lab or clinical environment.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Bioengineering, or a related technical field involving significant coursework in software development, algorithms, or quantitative problem-solving, with 7+ years of relevant software engineering experience; or a master’s degree in a related technical field with 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience
  • Experience designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining backend software solutions in production environments
  • Advanced knowledge and 3+ years of experience building and maintaining substantial TypeScript and Node.js services in production
  • Experience contributing to the design and implementation of scalable, reliable, and maintainable software systems
  • Experience designing and operating microservices-based systems, including event-driven architecture, with a clear understanding of service boundaries, contract evolution, event and message design, error handling across synchronous and asynchronous service calls, and observability
  • Experience designing PostgreSQL database schemas, with a strong understanding of transactions, indexing, and migration strategy.
  • Working knowledge of containerized, cloud-based systems using technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, GraphQL, and AWS or equivalent cloud platforms.
  • Experience with unit and end-to-end testing frameworks such as Jest, Vitest, Playwright, or similar, with strong test design skills and the ability to translate acceptance criteria or user stories into a balanced coverage strategy across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, including code review, automated testing, source control, continuous integration, deployment, monitoring, observability, and technical documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex technical work, troubleshoot production issues, and deliver high-quality solutions across the software development lifecycle.
  • Production experience with Kafka or a comparable event-streaming platform is preferred, including topic design, partition strategy, consumer group behavior, idempotency, ordering guarantees, and handling delayed, failed, or unprocessable messages; Confluent experience is a plus.
  • Experience operating services in AWS or similar environments is preferred, including the ability to navigate services such as EKS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, and IAM and troubleshoot issues across application and infrastructure boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience using modern AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar to accelerate development, code review, testing, and documentation is preferred.
  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, healthcare domains, diagnostic laboratory environments, next-generation sequencing, or other regulated settings is preferred.

Personal Qualifications

  • Demonstrated commitment to engineering excellence, with a strong focus on testability, maintainability, reliability, and long-term system quality.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to develop clear design documents, pull request descriptions, test cases, and technical documentation. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop practical, scalable solutions to complex technical challenges.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues across multiple systems, services, applications, and integration points while collaborating effectively across teams.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments by asking thoughtful questions, identifying assumptions and dependencies, and helping define a clear path forward.
  • Growth-oriented learning mindset, with the curiosity and adaptability to learn new technologies, deepen domain expertise, seek feedback, and continuously improve.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively managing shifting priorities, competing demands, and tight deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail.

It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Responsibilities and duties may change or be adjusted to meet the needs of the company, and additional duties may be assigned as necessary. The job description is subject to change at any time at the discretion of Karius.

title: Senior Product Manager - Instant Payments
description:
Job Description:

Drive the Future of Real-Time Payments

CSI is seeking a strategic and innovative Senior Product Manager - Instant Payments to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of products supporting the rapidly evolving real-time payments ecosystem. This role will focus on CSI's Instant Payments portfolio, including FedNow® Service and RTP® network solutions, helping financial institutions deliver immediate funds availability, improved cash flow management, and modern payment experiences.

As a key member of our Product Management organization, you will define product strategy, shape product roadmaps, conduct market research, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring innovative payment solutions to market. You will serve as a subject matter expert in instant payments and help drive CSI's leadership position in the financial services industry.

What You'll Do

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management. You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel

description:

In 2023, we launched our fourth therapy and the first ever gene therapy to treat Duchenne.

We’re looking for people who see unlimited potential in themselves and who are motivated by an unwavering commitment to patients.

What Sarepta Offers

At Sarepta, we care deeply about all the people in our community and believe in the importance of supporting them in all aspects of their lives. We aspire to maintain a culture that acknowledges people bring their whole selves to work, and we will strive to help everyone in our community integrate their work and personal lives while maintaining productivity. The Importance of the Role

The Importance of the Role
The Director, Patient Advocacy serves as a strategic leader within the Patient Affairs organization, responsible for shaping and advancing advocacy strategies that deepen Sarepta’s partnerships with patient communities and integrate patient perspectives across Sarepta’s business and development priorities. Reporting to the Senior Director, Patient Advocacy, this leader will drive high impact collaborations with patient advocacy organizations and global patient community engagement. This role is critical to ensuring patient and caregiver perspectives are incorporated into cross-functional planning and decision-making across the product lifecycle, spanning research and development to commercialization.
The Director will serve as both an internal strategist and external relationship leader, helping Sarepta deliver on its mission through authentic community partnership, insight-driven action, and patient-centered leadership.

The Opportunity to Make a Difference

The Opportunity to Make a Difference

Primary Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Lead the development and execution of Sarepta’s patient advocacy strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities, community needs, and the company’s commitment to patients and caregivers.
  • Community Engagement: Build, strengthen, and sustain trusted strategic partnerships with patient advocacy organizations, community leaders, and other key stakeholders to advance shared goals and reinforce Sarepta’s connection to the communities it serves.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a strategic advisor to internal cross-functional teams, ensuring patient and caregiver perspectives are incorporated into planning, decision-making, and the organization’s priorities.
  • Patient Insights and Strategy: Identify, synthesize, and translate patient and caregiver insights into actionable recommendations that inform business decisions, development programs and patient-centered initiatives.

More about You

More about You

  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills; strong presentation and PowerPoint design abilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and build alignment across all levels of the organization and with external stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to balance strategic vision with operational execution in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Willingness to travel 30–40%, including weekends, based on community needs.

What Now?

We’re always looking for solution-oriented, critical thinkers.

So, if you’re comfortable with ambiguity and candor, relish challenging yourself, and place kindness and integrity at the forefront of how you approach your peers and work, then we encourage you to apply.
