title: Vice President, Clinical Operations
description:
Attention recruitment agencies: All agency inquiries are vetted through 4DMT’s internal Talent Acquisition team. No unsolicited resumes will be accepted. The 4DMT Talent Acquisition team must expressly engage agencies on any requisition. Agencies contacting hiring managers directly will not be tolerated, and doing so may impact your ability to work with 4DMT in the future.

4DMT is a leading late-stage biotechnology company advancing durable and disease-targeted therapeutics with potential to transform treatment paradigms and provide unprecedented benefits to patients. The Company’s lead product candidate 4D-150 is designed to be a backbone therapy forming the foundation of treatment of blinding retinal vascular diseases by providing multi-year sustained delivery of anti-VEGF (aflibercept and anti-VEGF-C) with a single, safe, intravitreal injection, which substantially reduces the treatment burden associated with current bolus injections. The Company’s lead indication for 4D-150 is wet age-related macular degeneration, which is currently in Phase 3 development, and second indication is diabetic macular edema. The Company’s second product candidate is 4D-710, which is the first known genetic medicine to demonstrate successful delivery and expression of the CFTR transgene in the lungs of people with cystic fibrosis after aerosol delivery

General Summary:

Vice President, Clinical Operations is responsible for strategic operational oversight and execution of one or more complex global clinical programs across the ophthalmology and/or broader portfolio. Reporting to the Chief Clinical Operations Officer, this role ensures clinical trials are planned and executed with excellence, delivering high-quality, inspection-ready data on time and within budget.

The VP provides leadership to Clinical Operations teams responsible for study execution and partners closely with cross-functional development teams, including Clinical Science, Medical, Regulatory, Data Sciences, Clinical Compliance, Quality, and Business Operations, to proactively identify and mitigate operational risks, optimize trial performance, and drive executional excellence across Phase 1–3 clinical development.

The VP fosters a culture of operational excellence by building scalable systems, standardized processes, and performance metrics that enable predictable execution, informed decision-making, and continuous improvement. This leader creates an environment where decisions are driven by objective data and operational metrics rather than individual effort.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

Clinical Trial Execution & Oversight

  • Provide operational leadership and oversight for one or more large global clinical development programs or multiple phase 1-2 clinical studies from study start-up through database lock.
  • Ensure clinical trials are executed according to timelines, quality standards, budget, and corporate objectives.
  • Lead Clinical Operations teams to proactively identify risks, develop mitigation plans, and resolve operational challenges.
  • Ensure consistent execution of operational strategy across studies while maintaining inspection readiness.
  • Drive study performance through key operational metrics and continuous improvement initiatives.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Operations leaders (Senior Directors, Directors, CTMs) responsible for study execution.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Build organizational capability through coaching and talent development.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Partner with Clinical Science, Regulatory, Data Sciences/Medical, Clinical Compliance, Quality, Pharmacovigilance, and Technical Operations to ensure seamless trial execution.
  • Represent Clinical Operations on cross-functional program teams.
  • Escalate critical operational issues and recommend solutions to executive leadership.

Vendor & Financial Oversight

  • Provide executive oversight of CROs and strategic vendors supporting assigned programs.
  • Partner with Clinical Compliance to establish and maintain risk-proportionate sponsor oversight of vendors and delegated trial activities, ensuring documented oversight processes, issue escalation, and continuous evaluation of performance and compliance.
  • Partner with Clinical Outsourcing and Business Operations to ensure vendor performance, governance, and accountability.
  • Oversee study budgets, forecasts, change orders, and resource planning.

Operational Excellence

  • Drive inspection readiness across assigned programs.
  • Ensure adherence to GCP, SOPs, regulatory requirements, and quality standards.
  • Develop and implement scalable operational processes and governance that improve execution efficiency, consistency, and inspection readiness.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics to proactively identify risks, measure performance, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Utilize data and performance analytics to support operational decision-making, resource planning, and study execution.
  • Drive a culture of operational excellence through standardization, accountability, and continuous process improvement.

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrated success leading execution of complex global Phase 1-3 clinical trials.
  • Proven ability to lead multiple Clinical Operations trial teams across concurrent programs.
  • Strong systems thinker with the ability to design scalable processes that support organizational growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage metrics, dashboards, and operational analytics to drive performance and informed decision-making.
  • Experience implementing process improvements that increase efficiency, quality, and execution predictability.
  • Ability to translate operational data into actionable insights and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience leading global CROs and strategic vendor partnerships.
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and organizational development skills.

title: Vice President of Information Technology & Chief Information Security Officer (V
description:
About Multiview

Multiview is The Healthcare ERP Company. Purpose-built for healthcare finance teams, Multiview delivers a powerful, scalable, and cost-effective ERP that unites financials, supply chain management, reporting, and analytics in a single platform. Backed by deep expertise in healthcare finance and recognized by KLAS Research as the #1 ERP for healthcare organizations under 300 beds, Multiview helps mid-sized healthcare organizations gain clarity, move faster, make better decisions, and stay focused on care.

We are a values-led organization:

People First. Client Obsessed. Stronger Together. Work Smart. Believe in Better.

Position Summary

Reporting to the President and CEO, the Vice President of Information Technology & Chief Information Security Officer (VP of IT/CISO) is responsible for leading the organization's overall internal technology strategy, IT operations, cybersecurity programs, and regulatory compliance initiatives. This executive role serves as both the senior technology leader and the principal information security officer, ensuring that technology investments, security controls, and governance programs enable business growth while protecting critical company assets and client data.

As a SaaS ERP provider supporting clients who maintain highly sensitive Protected Health Information (PHI), the VP of IT/CISO is accountable for developing and maintaining a best-in-class security and compliance program that meets the requirements of HIPAA, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and other applicable privacy and security regulations. The role will be responsible for the protection of internal corporate systems and cloud infrastructure. This is not a DevOps role, nor is there DevOps responsibility, however our compliance and security are owned by this position.

The ideal candidate is a strategic executive capable of balancing innovation, scalability, risk management, compliance, and execution at a high level of operational excellence in a high-growth SaaS environment. A successful VP of IT/CISO will combine the strategic mindset of a technology executive with the rigour of a security leader.

This role is not suited for someone who prefers delegation or high-level oversight alone. The VP of IT/CISO must be eager to roll up their sleeves, dive into day-to-day IT activities, and personally influence the employee and stakeholder experience.

We are a proud award winning employer and intend to continue to improve the company as a place to work so that we can be worthy of the incredible talent we have.

We are a remote-first company and welcome candidates across Canada. The expectations are that in-person meetings or in-person work will be less than 10% of the time.

We welcome candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

If you bring strong IT leadership, a passion for security, and a willingness to work directly at both strategic and tactical levels, we want to hear from you.

The salary for this role is $180,000.00 to 250,000.00 CAD plus variable. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's IT and cybersecurity strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership on technology investments, cybersecurity risk, compliance obligations, and operational scalability.
  • Establish IT and security roadmaps that enable growth, scalability and employee effectiveness.
  • Lead annual technology planning, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation processes.
  • Present regular updates to leadership regarding cybersecurity posture, risk landscape, compliance status, and strategic initiatives.
  • Build and lead a high-performing technology and security organization focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Support and participate as required on the Security & Privacy Committee.

Cybersecurity & Information Security Leadership

  • Serve as the company's Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) with enterprise-wide responsibility for information security governance.
  • Implement and maintain an enterprise cybersecurity program based on recognized frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
  • Maintain appropriate security architecture, policies, procedures, and standards across all systems and environments.
  • Lead security monitoring, vulnerability management, penetration testing, threat intelligence, security operations, and incident response capabilities.
  • Ensure implementation of robust identity and access management, privileged access controls, multi-factor authentication, endpoint protection, data loss prevention, encryption, and zero-trust principles.
  • Oversee third-party security reviews and vendor risk management programs.
  • Direct forensic investigations, incident response activities, and breach notification processes when required.
  • Conduct regular cybersecurity risk assessments and maintain enterprise risk registers.

Data Privacy & Compliance

  • Maintain responsibility for protecting sensitive data and ensuring continued compliance with applicable standards including:
    • HIPAA
    • Provincial, state and federal privacy regulations
    • SOC 2 Type II requirements
    • Client contractual security obligations
  • Partner with Legal, Engineering, Product, and Client Success teams to ensure proper handling of PHI and Personally Identifiable Information (PII).
  • Oversee security controls protecting client data throughout its lifecycle including collection, transmission, storage, processing, backup, archival, and destruction.
  • Ensure implementation of appropriate administrative, physical, and technical safeguards for all regulated information.
  • Lead client security reviews, audits, and due diligence assessments.
  • Serve as executive sponsor for external audits, compliance certifications, and client risk assessments.
  • Serves as Privacy Officer

IT Infrastructure & Operations

  • Lead all internal IT operations including corporate systems, service desk, networking, cloud infrastructure, endpoint management, and collaboration platforms.
  • Oversee disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and resilience testing programs.
  • Monitor and maintain appropriate service-level agreements (SLAs), operational metrics, and performance standards.
  • Drive modernization, automation strategies, and operational excellence programs, including support functions to improve security posture, operational efficiency, and service delivery.
  • Support organizational wide adoption of AI to increase velocity of stakeholder impact.
  • Ensure secure remote workforce capabilities and endpoint management practices.

SaaS Platform Security

  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Champion secure-by-design and privacy-by-design principles.
  • Oversee application security programs and cloud-native security controls across AWS and applicable multi-cloud environments with Engineering.
  • Ensure corporate applications maintain the highest standards of confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
  • Support the completion of RFP/RFQs from prospective and current clients and other stakeholders as required.

Risk Management & Governance

  • Maintain applicable enterprise technology governance structures and security oversight programs.
  • Develop risk management methodologies and reporting mechanisms.
  • Maintain cybersecurity insurance readiness and support annual policy renewals.
  • Create meaningful executive dashboards and KPIs related to:
    • Security risk
    • Compliance posture
    • System availability
    • IT performance
    • Audit findings
    • Incident response metrics
  • Lead business continuity and crisis management planning efforts.

Team Development & Vendor Management

  • Recruit, develop, and retain top-tier IT and cybersecurity talent.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, security awareness, and client-centric service.
  • Manage strategic technology vendors, managed service providers, cloud providers, and security partners.
  • Negotiate and manage technology contracts and licensing agreements.
  • Develop succession plans for critical technology and security leadership positions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience.
  • 7+ years leading enterprise cybersecurity programs.
  • Experience serving as a CISO, VP of IT, CIO, or equivalent
  • Experience within SaaS, cloud software, healthcare technology, ERP software, or highly regulated industries with specific data-handling considerations.
  • Strong understanding of applicable security, privacy and compliance standards, certifications and frameworks including:
    • HIPAA
    • NIST Cybersecurity Framework
    • ISO 27001
  • Experience managing IT budgets and technology organizations.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certifications such as: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, CCSP, HCISPP
  • Experience leading organizations through significant growth and scaling initiatives.
  • Experience supporting rapidly growing SaaS businesses.
  • Strong understanding of data privacy and protection laws.
  • Experience and curiosity surrounding the advancements of AI in SaaS operations.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please submit your resume, and a cover letter describing, why you are a unique fit for this position by applying to this posting. We thank all applicants for expressing their interest in Multiview; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. Multiview is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible candidate experience. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know. We will work with you to meet your needs.

ACCESSIBILITY & DIVERSITY:

Multiview promotes a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. By embracing diversity, we are building a more effective organization that empowers our employees to be the best that they can be. We know that diversity of thought makes for the best problem-solving and creative thinking, which is why we are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and encouraging everyone to apply.

Multiview is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to creating a barrier-free working environment for all. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and Ontario Human Rights Code, Multiview will provide accommodation throughout the recruitment, selection and/or assessment process for applicants with disabilities, upon request.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
At Castor, we’re modernizing the backbone of clinical research

Clinical trials are the gatekeepers of human health, yet the industry is still bogged down by fragmented, manual processes that can waste time and exclude patient populations. At Castor, we are building the operating system for the next era of clinical research.

We provide a modular cloud platform designed to run trials end-to-end. Our foundation is a robust Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system, supported by eConsent for recruitment and screening and eCOA to accurately capture patient reported outcomes. We don’t just stop at data collection; we use Castor Catalyst (our high-precision AI automation) to strip away the manual effort that historically makes research slow and expensive.

How we work: Trust over tracking

We are a remote-first company built on the belief that talented people do their best work when they have the agency to manage their own lives. We believe that high performance requires a foundation of trust, health, and cutting-edge support.

  • Work-life integration: We don't believe in performative presence. We trust you to own your schedule and show up for your team, while also making space for your life outside of work.
  • Deep work & async: We protect your time. We prioritize thoughtful, asynchronous communication so you can focus on solving hard problems without a calendar full of status update meetings.
  • Radical candor: We value the truth over hierarchy. We give and receive direct feedback because that’s how we grow—as individuals and as a company.

Your mission and impact

As a Senior Platform Engineer at Castor, you will be building the foundations that empower our product developers to ship secure, reliable services at scale. Your mission is to bridge the gap between code and production by building out a robust containerized environment on Azure and maintaining a reliable, high-performance messaging backbone that minimizes toil and maximizes efficiency. By championing automation and infrastructure-as-code, you’ll directly impact our ability to deliver life-changing health-tech solutions to patients and researchers worldwide.

Who are you

  • You are biased toward avoiding manual, repetitive work and strive to find the perfect balance between keeping the lights on and building elegant automated systems.
  • You enjoy sharing knowledge, creating clear guidelines, and participating in training sessions to elevate the technical capabilities of the entire engineering organization.
  • You value documentation and technical clarity, contributing to Architecture Decision Records to ensure our systems are understood today and scalable tomorrow.
  • You are curious about the evolution of DevOps, particularly in how to effectively leverage AI tooling and agents to streamline workflows.

What you'll be doing

  • Designing and implementing solutions that allow product teams to run containerized services seamlessly.
  • Developing internal best practices, guidelines, and documentation to help developers navigate cloud infrastructure.
  • Writing and maintaining code for centrally managed services while improving security and reliability.
  • Manage our centralized messaging infrastructure (NATS), ensuring its reliability, scalability and performance
  • Providing support through a dedicated on call rotation.
  • Contributing to technical documentation and Architecture Decision Records to keep our ecosystem transparent and stable.

What you'll bring

  • Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language (Python or Go preferred).
  • Solid experience deploying and optimizing solutions on a major cloud provider (Azure or GCP).
  • A strong grasp of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and the containerization ecosystem (like Kubernetes) and related tooling.
  • An understanding of Linux, networking, web applications, and database fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with monitoring server and application performance, with the troubleshooting skills to resolve issues in a distributed environment.
  • You have a deep understanding of distributed systems and message brokers, and you are comfortable taking ownership of critical infrastructure components that keep our services communicating reliably.

Our preference is for this role to be based in CET+/-2.

We are currently unable to accept applications from people based in: Spain, France, Belgium, Switzerland and Germany.

How we invest in you

High performance isn't sustainable without real support. We provide the infrastructure you need to stay healthy, focused, and rewarded.

  • Rest is non-negotiable: Unlimited annual leave with 25-day minimum. We don’t just allow time off; we expect you to take it.
  • Downtime weeks: Once a quarter, the whole company shifts gears. No new shipping—just a week for deep focus, learning, or catching up so we can start the next quarter fresh.
  • AI-first culture: We provide the tools and training to ensure you’re spending your energy on high-value work, not manual repetition.
  • Real ownership: All Castor team members are offered options through our Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP).
  • Comprehensive wellbeing: Free access to Open Up for mental health, specialized sleep courses (for you and your family), and a budget to make your home office a place you actually want to be.
  • Annual bonus: A guaranteed "Happy Holidays" bonus every December.

Belonging at Castor

We build products to make research accessible to everyone, and we believe our team should reflect that same diversity.

Our remote setup is designed to support you as a whole person—your family, your mental health, and your authentic self. We don't care about your background as much as we care about your perspective and your expertise. We strongly encourage applications from women, people of color, and the LGBTQ+ community. Please feel free to share the pronouns you use (for example she/her/hers, he/her/his, they/them/theirs, etc.).

Contribute to the strategic direction of the business and support impactful mission outcomes as a TPA Core Services Business Analyst at GDIT. Here, you’ll enable the success of one of the most critical federal healthcare missions and support high‑quality administrative services for the World Trade Center Health Program.

As a TPA Core Services Business Analyst, the work you’ll do at GDIT will directly support the mission of the World Trade Center Health Program (WTCHP). You will play a crucial role in ensuring business requirements, workflows, and system interactions across Third Party Administrator (TPA) core services are clear, aligned, and ready for accurate and compliant healthcare delivery.

● Lead requirements elicitation, documentation, and refinement activities that directly support eligibility, claims, provider management, member services, and payment workflows.
● Collaborate with cross‑functional technical teams, operational staff, system vendors, QA testers, and government stakeholders to ensure requirements and workflows align with system capabilities and mission needs.

● Utilize requirements management tools, workflow modeling skills, healthcare administrative expertise, and integration analysis techniques to support seamless operational execution.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

Bring your initiative and drive for innovation to GDIT. The TPA Core Services Business Analyst must have:

● Education: Technical training, certification(s), or degree
● Experience: 3+ years of related experience (healthcare operations, payer systems, or federal program support preferred)
● Technical skills: Experience with requirements management, workflow/process mapping, EDI or API integrations, eligibility and claims systems, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
● Security clearance level: MB(T2)
● US citizenship required
● Role requirements: Ability to collaborate with technical and operational teams; familiarity with HIPAA and secure handling of PHI/PII; experience validating system behavior; 0–10% travel as needed

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

title: Scientist I/II – LC-MS/MS Bioanalysis
description:
Position: Scientist I/II – LC-MS/MS Bioanalysis

Salary Range: $55,000-$70,000

Location: Exton, PA (On-site)

About Pharmaron

Pharmaron is a global contract research and manufacturing organization (CRO/CDMO) helping pharma and biotech companies bring new therapies to life. With over 25,000 employees worldwide across 28 locations in the US, UK, China, and Singapore, we support drug discovery through to manufacturing with fully integrated high-quality services.

We're proud of the impact we make and just last year, we supported 887 discovery projects, 1,100+ CMC programs, and 1,397 clinical trials across all phases. Our teams are involved in everything from small molecules, ADC's, biologics, and gene therapies and we work with more than 3,300 global customers. To learn more, visit www.pharmaron.com.

Job Overview:

As a Scientist I/II – LC-MS/MS Bioanalysis, you will develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and validate bioanalytical methods supporting DMPK and regulated studies. You'll work with advanced LC-MS/MS and high-resolution mass spectrometry platforms while gaining exposure to a broad range of therapeutic modalities-from traditional small molecules to peptides, oligonucleotides, PROTACs, biologics, and emerging therapies.

This opportunity is ideal for an early-career bioanalytical scientist who wants to expand beyond routine sample analysis and develop deeper expertise in method development, complex bioanalysis, scientific problem-solving, and study execution within a global CRO/CDMO environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and validate LC-MS/MS bioanalytical methods supporting drug discovery and development programs.
  • Perform bioanalytical sample analysis for DMPK, method development, validation, and regulated studies.
  • Operate LC-MS/MS and HPLC platforms and gain exposure to advanced mass spectrometry technologies.
  • Design and execute scientifically sound experiments aligned with client objectives, study requirements, and internal quality standards.
  • Process, analyze, interpret, and report bioanalytical data while identifying and resolving technical challenges.
  • Review and execute study protocols and ensure accurate documentation of experimental procedures, results, and conclusions.
  • Author and contribute to protocols, validation reports, technical summaries, study reports, and other scientific documentation.
  • Support GLP and regulated bioanalytical activities in accordance with applicable procedures and quality requirements.
  • Collaborate with scientists, project teams, management, Business Development, and clients to support successful project execution.
  • Participate in scientific project reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • As experience develops, take on increasing scientific ownership and opportunities to support studies in a Principal Investigator and/or Study Director capacity, as appropriate.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
  • 1–3+ years of relevant bioanalytical laboratory experience; position level will be determined based on experience and demonstrated technical capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS bioanalysis, including exposure to method development, optimization, validation, and/or sample analysis.
  • Understanding of chromatographic and mass spectrometric principles.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to troubleshoot scientific and technical challenges.
  • Ability to accurately analyze, interpret, document, and communicate scientific data.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative scientific environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing and validating LC-MS/MS bioanalytical methods.
  • Experience working within a GLP or regulated bioanalytical environment.
  • Experience with SCIEX Triple Quad platforms, including 6500+ and/or 7600 systems, or comparable LC-MS/MS instrumentation.
  • Experience with high-resolution mass spectrometry platforms.
  • Experience supporting DMPK and regulated bioanalytical studies.
  • Experience analyzing complex modalities such as peptides, oligonucleotides, PROTACs, biologics, or other emerging therapeutic modalities.
  • Experience with HPLC and other analytical detection platforms.
  • Experience authoring protocols, validation reports, technical summaries, or study reports.
  • Previous CRO, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology industry experience.
  • Experience collaborating directly with clients or cross-functional scientific teams.

Why Pharmaron?

Pharmaron is a premier service provider for the life sciences industry. Founded in 2004, Pharmaron has invested in its people and facilities and established a broad spectrum of research, development, and manufacturing service capabilities throughout the entire drug discovery, preclinical, and clinical development process across multiple therapeutic modalities, including small molecules, biologics, and CGT products. With over 25,000 employees and operations in the US, UK, China, and Singapore. Pharmaron has an excellent track record in delivering R&D solutions to its partners in North America, Europe, Japan, and China.

Collaborative Culture: You will thrive in our inclusive and collaborative environment, where teamwork and innovation go hand in hand. Here, your voice matters, and your contributions make a real impact. "Employees Number One" and "Clients Centered" are the core cultural values at Pharmaron. Our culture, which sets Pharmaron apart from other organizations, has evolved from our deep commitment to our employees, partners, and collaborators.

Benefits: As part of our commitment to your well-being, we offer a comprehensive benefits package:

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance with significant employer contributions
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with generous employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Sick Leave & Company Holidays to support work-life balance
  • Employer-funded Health Savings Account (HSA) contributions (for eligible plans), plus Healthcare & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 100% Employer-paid Employee Life Insurance, AD&D, Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP), mental health resources, and wellness programs
  • Family-friendly benefits, including fertility support and maternity resources
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities within a leading global CRO/CDMO

How to Apply:

Ready to seize this incredible opportunity? Join us at Pharmaron and be part of a dynamic team driving innovation and excellence in biopharmaceutical research and development. Apply online today!

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer, Pharmaron values diversity and inclusion in the workplace, fostering an environment where all individuals are empowered to succeed. Join us in our mission to make a difference in the world of life sciences.

title: Head of Design, Global Expansion
description:
About Nu

Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services.

Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns.

Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks.

Visit our Institutional Page

Location: East Coast of U.S./Canada or Brazil (Eastern timezone for Europe-compatibility)

---

The Role

We're launching a brand-new global account into dozens of markets at once — multi-currency holdings, yield, diversification across digital assets, and a suite of debit cards, built for people whose work and family span borders. The infrastructure underneath is powered by stablecoins and open financial services, but that complexity is fully abstracted. What the customer feels is a delightful, magical consumer product — as simple and effortless as anything Apple makes.

This is the project where every new thing at Nu lands first: the Magic App, the next evolution of the design system, new components and patterns. You'd have unusual room to experiment, iterate, and push the system forward rather than just consume it. The benchmark isn't the domestic market — it's global leaders like Revolut and Wise, and we're building to raise the bar past them.

As Head of Design for this initiative, you'll own the design function for the entire project. This is a player-coach role: you'll manage a team, but you'll also stay deeply in the craft — prototyping, refining, and setting the standard by doing, not just by directing. We need someone whose work itself is the bar.

What You'll Do

* Lead the design function for Nubank's most ambitious global expansion — a multi-currency, multi-market account launching to 40+ countries simultaneously.

* Set and hold the craft bar at a global standard, benchmarking against the best fintech products in the world (Revolut, Wise, and beyond).

* Stay hands-on. You manage people, but you're also in the work — shipping design, prototyping, and elevating every surface and interaction.

* Push the design system forward. This product is the proving ground for new components and patterns that flow back into Nu's global design system. You don't just use the system; you evolve it.

* Navigate the balance between creative freedom and organizational maturity — earning autonomy by influencing and persuading the central design organization, contributing patterns back to the system, and building bridges rather than working in isolation.

* Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and the broader design organization to ship experiences that feel magical and effortless to customers across China, Italy, Spain, and dozens of other markets.

What We're Looking For

* Craft first. Extreme attention to detail and a portfolio that demonstrates world-class product design — the kind of work that stands out against Revolut, Wise, or Apple.

* A hands-on manager. You've led teams, but you still design. You set the bar by doing, not just by directing.

* Fintech-adjacent domain experience. You've worked in or around financial products — payments, cards, banking, digital assets, consumer finance. If you come from outside finance, you should have extraordinary craft and a track record of making complex products feel dead simple.

* A system-level collaborator. You know how to operate within a mature design organization — influencing the global system, contributing patterns, and partnering with central teams rather than working around them.

* A bar-raiser. You're not satisfied with "good enough." You push your team and yourself to the next level, especially when competing against the best in the world.

About the Product

A global account designed for people with cross-border lives — those who work across markets, have family in different countries, or need to move money internationally with ease. It offers multi-currency holdings, yield, diversification across digital assets, and a set of debit cards. The underlying technology is powered by stablecoins and open financial services, but that's invisible to the user. What they experience is a consumer product that feels as simple and delightful as anything Apple makes.

The product is launching nonlinearly into 40+ countries simultaneously — customers in China, Italy, Spain, and beyond. This is Nubank's most ambitious global expansion to date, and the design bar must match the ambition.

Why This Role, Why Now

The current Head of Design is transitioning to a new role, and this is a long-term replacement for someone who can take the project through its next chapter. The previous leader struggled with the tension between creative autonomy and working within a maturing, centralized design organization. We need someone who thrives in that complexity — who earns creative freedom by influencing the system, not by circumventing it. Someone who sees the connection to the global design team as an opportunity to shape the system, not a constraint.

This is an urgent hire. The role is open now.

Interview Process

1. Async portfolio review with Ethan Eismann (CDO).

2. Live portfolio presentation (1 hour) — walkthrough of your best work with the design leadership team.

3. Hiring manager interview (45–60 min) with Thomaz Fortes and Thais Burin.

4. Final conversation with Ethan if needed.

---

Hiring managers: Thomaz Fortes & Thais Burin · CDO: Ethan Eismann

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

title: Associate Director of Content  and Search Growth (Remote, CA)
description:
THE ROLE

Avocado is seeking an Associate Director of Content & Search Growth to join our growing marketing team.

This role is designed for an exceptional writer who thinks like a marketer. You will launch a new authority content platform on our main domain, work intimately on the content that sells our products, and be accountable for organic traffic, engagement, and revenue — including how visible we are inside AI search tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.

We compete against brands with years of accumulated domain authority and large content teams. What we have that they don't is transparency: we know where our materials come from, we hold certifications our competitors cannot credibly write about, and we are a B Corp with the impact and documentation to back it up. Content grounded in facts only we can substantiate earns rankings on merit and gets cited by AI assistants. Your job is to help build that engine.

You will report directly to our Chief Marketing Officer and partner closely with our design and UX team, in-house studio, brand marketing team, and VP Sourcing & Certifications.

This is a hands-on writing role. You will work directly with the CMO, and as the program evolves, we expect to add a writer under you — but this job stays hands-on. We are looking for a player-coach, not a manager. We have deliberately scoped this as an Associate Director role with a clear path to Director. If you are strong, you will grow into broader ownership of our content strategy and voice, and eventually a team.

*Note on Location: This role is remote within the United States. We prefer candidates based in the Washington, DC metro area, the New York metro area, or the Fullerton, CA area for in-person collaboration, but we are open to strong remote candidates.

*Note on Pay Transparency:. The pay range for this role is $100,000-130,000

WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

Authority Content Platform

  • Launch and own a new authority content platform on our main domain, from a blank page.

  • Build the information architecture, topic clusters, editorial standards, internal linking strategy, and publishing cadence.

  • Write and commission content on certifications, materials, sourcing, sleep science, buying guides, and our impact work — substantiated, citation-worthy, and factually airtight.

  • Align with our brand marketing team on a shared topic map so this platform and our lifestyle magazine complement, rather than compete with, each other. (The magazine is a separate property owned by brand marketing; you will not manage it.)

Website & Commercial Content

  • Own the copy on our product detail pages, category pages, comparison modules, and landing pages — what our pages say and whether they persuade.

  • Write the small, high-leverage content most brands neglect: navigation labels, CTAs, FAQs, tooltips, and in-page education.

  • Run page optimization as a continuous program, not a series of one-offs.

  • Partner with our design and UX team, who own how pages look and function.

Search & AI Visibility

  • Own organic search strategy, including keyword research, technical SEO fundamentals, and content architecture.

  • Own our visibility inside AI-generated answers. We already run Profound and Semrush, and you will be the first person to own them.

  • Report on organic traffic, organic revenue, and citation share in AI answers.

Product & Brand Messaging

  • Turn product specifications into a reason to buy. Our product development program manager will keep you current on timing and specs; the narrative is yours.

  • Write our certification, sustainability, and B Corp story in a form that both search engines and journalists find credible. This material is also placed externally through our PR agency.

  • Support copy needs across other channels as they come up, which may include audio and TV scripts.

Claims Accuracy & Editorial Standards

  • Own the substantiation process. Any content referencing our materials, certifications, or sustainability claims goes through review with our VP Sourcing & Certifications before it publishes.

  • Use AI tools to improve speed and quality while maintaining editorial standards. A hallucinated or loosely worded certification claim is a legal exposure in our category, not a typo.

  • Build and direct a freelance bench. You will have budget and authority to commission writers who can handle technical, certification-backed material.

WHAT YOU BRING

What You Bring

  • Minimum of 5 years of content, SEO, or copywriting experience, ideally for DTC or e-commerce brands.

  • Exceptional writing ability. You can move between a technical explanation of an organic certification, a product page that converts, and a brand paragraph someone actually finishes reading.

  • The ability to write exceptionally well within an established brand voice. Our voice and editorial standards are set at the executive level, and you will extend and sharpen them rather than start from scratch.

  • A track record of excellent work inside a content program, and the judgment to decide what to work on rather than waiting to be assigned.

  • A working understanding of buying psychology, objection handling, and how high-consideration purchases actually get made.

  • Fluency with AI tools as a system rather than a shortcut. You have built workflows for research, briefing, brand voice, and quality control, and you can tell us specifically where the models get things wrong.

  • Rigor about factual accuracy and the instinct to ask what backs up a claim before publishing it.

  • Comfort reporting on your work in terms of revenue rather than pageviews.

  • Passionate about our brand's values of healthy living, environmental awareness, and social responsibility; previous experience working for a brand with similar values is a plus!

  • Agency experience is valuable here, particularly for writing in an established voice and working at volume. We would like to see at least some in-house or brand-side experience alongside it.

  • Experience with a certified, regulated, or claims-heavy product category is a plus.

  • Experience writing direct response scripts for audio or TV is a plus.

  • Technical SEO depth, including site migrations and architecture, is a plus.

  • Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.

  • Regular and predictable attendance.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Communicate: This role frequently communicates with team members and cross-functional partners to update them on task status.

  • Travel: Occasional travel for team meetings, offsites, and company events. Travel can be done by train, airplane, or car.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

  • 100% Employer Paid Life Insurance

  • 401(k) with employer match

  • PTO

  • Volunteer days

  • Employee product purchase program

  • Annual Bonus Plan

  • Training and Tools to be successful along with a strong partnership from your peers and leaders

  • Access to wellness apps

  • Referral Bonus

  • Career growth opportunities

WHY WORK AT AVOCADO GREEN BRANDS?

Be part of the change; work at a disruptive company on a mission to be one of the world’s recognized and trusted sustainable brands.

  • Proactively identify and document potential billing errors, including duplicate billing of items, services, or procedures as improper unbundling of services (e.g., separating components that should be billed together) and charges for non-covered or non-rendered services
  • Compare billed charges against both payor-specific contracts and industry guidelines to confirm appropriate billing practices.
  • Apply working knowledge of national coding systems (e.g., CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, MS-DRGs) to validate the accuracy of codes used for services billed.
  • Review claims eligible under specific reimbursement scenarios: a percentage of charges or those exceeding stop-loss levels, ensuring the claim exceeds the minimum dollar threshold set by the payor
  • Prepare clear, concise, and professional documentation of all findings, including savings identified, policy violations, and recommended claim adjustments
  • Contribute to the refinement of internal audit processes and tools to enhance efficiency and accuracy in identifying claim inaccuracies
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for internal and external stakeholders regarding complex billing issues, coding guidelines, and payor policies
  • Provide subject matter expertise and in-depth understanding of Payment Integrity internal claims processing edits, external vendor edits and Oscar reimbursement policies
  • Identify claims payment issues from data mining, process monitoring, etc., provide scoping and action steps needed to remediate the issue
  • Respond to internal and external inquiries and disputes regarding policies and edits.
  • Document industry standard coding rules and provide recommendations on reimbursement policy language and scope
  • Ideate payment integrity opportunities based on a deep knowledge of industry standard coding rules. Translate into business requirements; submit to and collaborate with internal partners to effectuate change
  • Provide training and education to team members when necessary
  • Perpetuate a culture of transparency and collaboration by keeping stakeholders well informed of progress, status changes, blockers, completion, etc.; field questions as appropriate
  • Support Oscar run state objectives by providing speedy research, root cause analysis, training, etc. whenever issues are escalated and assigned by leadership
  • Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • A bachelor's degree or 4+ years of commensurate experience
  • 2+ years of bill / coding audit experience with a focus on hospital or facility billing (UB-04)
  • 4+ years experience in medical coding
  • Medical coding certification through AAPC (CPC, COC) or AHIMA (CCS, RHIT, RHIA)
  • Experience with reimbursement methodologies, provider contract concepts and common claims processing/resolution practices

Bonus points:

  • 3+ years of experience working with large data sets using excel or a database language
  • Knowledge management, training, or content development in operational settings
  • Process Improvement or Lean Six Sigma training
  • Experience using SQL

title: Project Executive
description:
Title: Project Executive

Location: Toronto, Ontario

Company: Triumph Group of Companies

Role Overview

The Project Executive is the single accountable partner on Triumph's largest multi-division projects, the ones where two or more Triumph divisions share the same build and the client needs one coordinated point of contact instead of a set of separate scopes. You own the client relationship from award through substantial completion, chair weekly coordination meetings, and keep the cross-scope schedule and issue log current so nothing falls into the gaps between divisions. You work closely with the COO, the Business Unit Vice Presidents whose divisions are on the job, and senior clients such as developers, institutional owners, and general contractors, on projects that regularly run into the tens of millions of dollars and up.


Good work in this role looks like a client who never has to chase down which division owns what, a bid that captures every scope once and accurately, and a coordination fee that reflects the real value you're delivering. You're building this function largely from the ground up, so the first stretch is hands-on: personally running every assigned project while standing up the process and the team around you as volume grows.


What We Offer

  • Excellent Total Rewards: Commensurate with experience
  • A high-visibility, executive-adjacent role built to grow into a larger office as the function scales
  • Direct exposure to the COO, the CEO, and Business Unit Vice Presidents across Triumph's divisions
  • The chance to build a new function from the ground up, with a clear path to leading a larger team as pipeline grows
  • A culture that rewards practical execution over bureaucracy, and backs people who deliver

What You Bring to the Table

Technical Skills

  • 10+ years of progressive project management or construction management experience in commercial construction, including multi-trade coordination on complex builds
  • A track record running large ($10M+) multi-disciplinary projects involving multiple sub-trades or divisions, as a senior PM at a general contractor or in an owner-side or CM-agency role
  • P&L ownership or equivalent commercial accountability, including setting pricing, delivering margin, and reporting operating results
  • Working knowledge of MS Project or MS Project Online and standard construction management software such as Procore
  • Building envelope exposure (glazing, cladding, roofing, waterproofing, curtainwall, facades, windows) is a strong asset, along with a PMP, Gold Seal, or equivalent credential

Attributes

  • You're comfortable being the senior face in the room with sophisticated clients like developers, institutional owners, and general contractors, and you communicate clearly under pressure
  • You hold people accountable across teams and reporting lines you don't formally manage, without becoming a bottleneck
  • You think like an owner. You'd rather solve a coordination problem quietly than let it show up in front of a client
  • You're organized enough to run a consolidated schedule and issue log across multiple divisions without losing track of the details
  • You're motivated by building something new, and you don't need a fully built out team or process to get started

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own the client relationship on assigned multi-division projects from award through substantial completion, serving as the single accountable point of contact
  • Coordinate the bid across participating Triumph divisions so every scope is quoted once, accurately, and on time
  • Price the internal coordination fee for each assigned project based on the coordination value delivered
  • Chair weekly internal coordination meetings and require written updates from each participating division's project manager ahead of time
  • Maintain the cross-scope coordination issue log and the consolidated schedule view in MS Project Online, while each division continues to own its own schedule
  • Collect and distribute key client communications, including change orders, schedule changes, major RFI responses, and formal correspondence
  • Coordinate cross-scope RFIs, submittals, and change order positioning so Triumph presents one unified response to the client
  • Escalate to the applicable Business Unit Vice President when a division isn't meeting response or delivery expectations
  • Report project-level gross margin and overall office performance to the COO on a regular cadence, including pipeline and coordination revenue
  • Build and lead a team of Multi-Scope Project Managers and a dedicated estimator as the function grows

Company Overview: Triumph Group of Companies

Triumph Group of Companies is a diversified construction and infrastructure services organization supporting projects across multiple sectors. We provide specialized services in roofing, waterproofing, cladding, energy, restoration, and glazing, ensuring comprehensive care of building envelopes and infrastructure.


Our culture is built on safety, accountability, teamwork, and consistent standards across all divisions. We value people who take ownership, communicate directly, and help move work forward. This role plays a key part in a new initiative to deliver one coordinated Triumph experience on projects that span multiple divisions.

title: Sviluppatore Software Real-Time – Sistemi di Controllo HVAC / BTMS
description:
Telema S.p.A. è un’azienda di riferimento nella produzione di resistenze elettriche di potenza e nella progettazione di sistemi sistemi di raffreddamento per applicazioni ferroviarie “plug and play”. Questi sistemi possono includere ventilatori, radiatori, filtri e altri accessori, sviluppati e integrati in un unico pacchetto per garantire prestazioni ottimali sotto il profilo meccanico, aerodinamico, acustico, termico e di filtraggio. Operiamo in settori strategici quali il ferroviario e l’impiantistica industriale e residenziale, offrendo soluzioni innovative e personalizzate. Telema S.p.A. è riconosciuta tra i “migliori fornitori” dei principali costruttori mondiali di veicoli ferroviari, dai tram alle metropolitane, dai treni ad alta frequentazione fino ai convogli ad alta velocità.



Sia tra i primi a candidarsi: legga la panoramica completa del ruolo qui sotto, quindi invii la sua candidatura per essere preso/a in considerazione.
Descrizione del ruolo:

Siamo alla ricerca di uno Sviluppatore Software competente e motivato, con esperienza nell’automazione industriale e nello sviluppo di software di controllo in tempo reale per sistemi HVAC e sistemi di gestione termica delle batterie (BTMS). La risorsa sarà coinvolta nell’intero ciclo di sviluppo del software, inclusi: definizione delle specifiche, progettazione dell’architettura, implementazione, test, debug e validazione di applicazioni embedded e di controllo real-time utilizzate nei settori ferroviario, industriale o energetico. Il candidato ideale possiede esperienza con ambienti di sviluppo IEC 61131-3, come CODESYS o sistemi analoghi PLC/real-time, ed è a proprio agio con algoritmi di controllo, protocolli di comunicazione e interfacce hardware.


Responsabilità principali:

  • Definire e sviluppare software di controllo in tempo reale per applicazioni HVAC e BTMS
  • Analizzare i requisiti di sistema e tradurli in specifiche software
  • Progettare l’architettura software e la logica di controllo per sistemi embedded/industriali
  • Sviluppare applicazioni utilizzando i linguaggi IEC 61131-3:
  • Implementare strategie di controllo per:
  • sistemi di raffreddamento/riscaldamento batterie
  • Sviluppare interfacce di comunicazione e diagnostica utilizzando protocolli industriali quali:
  • Eseguire integrazione software, test, debug e validazione
  • Supportare test di laboratorio e messa in servizio di prototipi
  • Collaborare con ingegneri elettrici, meccanici e di sistema
  • Preparare documentazione tecnica e documentazione di rilascio software
  • Supportare attività di troubleshooting durante commissioning e test sul campo
  • Laurea o diploma tecnico in: Ingegneria del Software, Ingegneria dell’Automazione, Ingegneria Elettronica, Meccatronica, Informatica oppure esperienza tecnica equivalente
  • Esperienza nello sviluppo software real-time o industriale
  • Buona conoscenza dei linguaggi IEC 61131-3
  • Esperienza con PLC o sistemi di controllo embedded
  • Esperienza nel debug e nella validazione di software di controllo
  • Comprensione dei sistemi di controllo e dei processi termodinamici
  • Capacità di lettura di schemi elettrici e documentazione tecnica

Requisiti Preferenziali:

  • Esperienza nei settori ferroviario, automotive, HVAC o accumulo energetico
  • Conoscenza delle architetture BTMS e delle strategie di controllo termico
  • Esperienza nello sviluppo HMI/SCADA
  • Conoscenze di base di Linux embedded o C/C++
  • Esperienza con progettazione model-based o strumenti di simulazione
  • Familiarità con i concetti di cybersecurity per sistemi di controllo industriali
  • Conoscenza dei concetti xysqume di sicurezza funzionale

Competenze Personali:

  • Approccio strutturato, metodico e orientato alla soluzione
  • Buone capacità di problem solving e analisi
  • Conoscenza dell’inglese tecnico
  • Forte attitudine al debugging
  • Attitudine al lavoro in team
  • Capacità di lavorare in autonomia su task tecnici
  • Disponibilità a trasferte occasionali per attività di test o commissioning
  • Opportunità di lavorare su tecnologie innovative HVAC e BTMS
  • Ambiente dinamico, innovativo, internazionale e multidisciplinare
  • Partecipazione a progetti nel settore ferroviario e della transizione energetica
  • Crescita professionale in ambito R&S e system engineering
  • Coinvolgimento diretto, dalla fase di concept fino alla validazione
  • Contratto di lavoro a tempo pieno indeterminato (C.C.N.L. Metalmeccanico Industria + Integrativo aziendale)
  • Pacchetto retributivo commisurato all’esperienza e alle competenze
  • Percorso di sviluppo professionale e formazione continua

title: Sr Lead Cable Engineer
description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

The Senior Lead Cable Engineer plays a pivotal role as a key technical leader on the Cable Engineering team. This team is responsible for the oversight of low voltage design and installation across all upcoming SHC construction as well as moves/adds/changes and the management of the cable infrastructure of across all SHC, Stanford Medicine Partners and Stanford Tri-Valley locations. The Senior Lead Cable Engineer plays a key leadership role in the oversight of telecommunications infrastructure, distribution rooms, outside plant and as well as the vendors, suppliers and distributors of structured cabling and related equipment. The role is an exciting opportunity to be deeply involved in the strategic growth of SHC’s facilities, the development and management of Telecommunications standards and the professional technical growth of the Cable Engineering team.

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
The Senior Infrastructure Cabling Engineer is a technical resource responsible for SHC's outside and inside cabling/pathway infrastructure and telecommunication spaces design, standards, quality control, implementation, maintenance, and capacity planning. This includes but not limited to reviewing cabling infrastructure designs and scopes of work, providing technical support and monitoring telecommunications construction activities to ensure compliance with SHC-IT standards.

Excellent structured cabling/pathway, engineering/design and project management skills are required to balance both infrastructure integrity and project deliverables to ensure the cabling infrastructure supports technically advanced telecommunication services. Candidates must have proficient time management skills to work in a dynamic operations environment with varying priorities and schedule demands. Excellent communications skills are required for collaboration with technical and non-technical individuals at all levels inside and outside of Stanford Healthcare.

Additional responsibilities include overseeing the development of and operation of Move/Add/Change (MAC) activities throughout all SHC facilities.
The Senior Infrastructure Cabling Engineer is responsible for mentoring and aiding ICE Engineers in their professional development as Subject Matter Experts.


Locations
Stanford Health Care

What you will do

  • Collaborate with the network operations team, network architecture team, facilities team and planning, design & construction team in the development of infrastructure design and provide budgetary cost estimate plans for inside and outside cabling/pathways and spaces.
  • Ensure that all infrastructure designs in compliance with both Industry and SHC standards within allocated budgets. Designs will include (but not limited to) telecommunications rooms and spaces, inside and outside cabling to new buildings, existing buildings and data centers.
  • Oversee and maintain capacity planning, cable record management of outside and inside cabling both copper and fiber and outside pathways. Implement software tools and databases for tracking MAC activity and cabling inventory.
  • Review and create documentation for infrastructure design and scopes of work to be used as bid documents and reference materials. Actively participate in design meetings for new buildings, data centers, and renovations and approve cabling scopes of work in these areas.
  • Attend meetings with outside contractors, architects, engineering firms, and SHC support departments. Participate in job walks pre-construction and ongoing construction meetings on a regular basis.
  • Develop and maintain preventative maintenance plans for the fiber and copper cabling outside infrastructure and update documentation (including standards) on a quarterly basis. Create new documentation and replace existing documentation, as needed.
  • Collaborate and coordinate with technical operational staff with cabling activities including (but not limited to) the following telecommunications areas: moves, changes, additions, and repairs.
  • Work closely with outside contractors to repair damaged cabling resulting in telecommunications services outages and develop solutions to minimize future outages.
  • Schedule and coordinate outside contractors for preventative repairs to minimize telephone and network outages. Coordinate planned and unplanned infrastructure outages with SHC departments. Work closely with outside telecommunications providers for services to SHC.
  • Provide written status reports to senior management on a regular basis. Develop communication plans for future and current infrastructure upgrades that may or may not affect telecommunications services.
  • Develop and maintain a document repository to store all facility design and construction drawings/specifications, test results and warranty information.
  • Oversee and coordinating contractor activities, providing quality assurance and inspections for SHC projects requiring cabling performed by outside contractors, vendors, and/or SHC departments.
  • Ensure that the cabling complies with SHC and Industry standards and codes. Actively participate in updating SHC standards.
  • Review cabling scopes of work and collaborate with Project Managers in establishing target dates for requested deliverables from others.
  • Provide guidance and technical expertise operational staff and other departments. Troubleshoot and resolve any problems that may arise with the infrastructure and offer alternate solutions to senior management and field support staff.
  • Verify cabling materials and parts utilized meets or exceed industry/SHC standards by inspecting materials on job sites and performing periodic field inspections in conjunction with the field support staff.
  • Stay informed about short and long-range plans for new buildings, renovations, remodels, and departmental moves requiring telecommunications infrastructure, develop action plans based on these findings and actively engage SHC technical and operational staff about these plans.
  • Review schedules and project deliverables with Project Managers and assist Project Managers and Senior Management to identify SHC resources for projects.
  • Provide and review information for estimates SHC-IT department. Coordinate resources with outside contractors, vendors, telecommunication providers and SHC departments to meet project deadlines and milestones.
  • In conjunction with SHC Project Managers, set realistic expectations with clients and keep them informed of the implementation activities on projects, upgrades and repairs.
  • The essential functions listed are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.


Education Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED Equivalent
  • Bachelor's Degree preferred


Experience Qualifications

  • Ten (10) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience and five (5) years of project management experience.


Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Trained in Telecommunications Cabling Installation Codes and Standards
  • Trained in Grounding and Bonding Principles
  • Trained in Cable Installation Safety
  • Working knowledge of Outside Plant industry guidelines and standards and codes.
  • Proven experience as a communications planner with extensive background in telecommunications infrastructure planning and design, and the ability to communicate the plans and concepts to all levels of personnel, management, and contractors.
  • Proven experience with telecommunications and network infrastructure to include: an understanding of terms, concepts, inside and outside fiber and copper cabling, communications cabling infrastructure design, cost estimation, industry standards and codes, and telephone systems and data network equipment.
  • Ability to design, estimate costs, develop scope of work, specify materials, and oversee the implementation of intra and inter-building communications cabling infrastructure to include the construction and modification of pathways and spaces, and all types of copper and fiber cable and termination devices.
  • In depth and applied understanding of industry standards for communications cabling systems, electrical systems, communications pathways and spaces, and for general construction.
  • Proven skills in reading and interpreting maps, blueprints, and electrical plans.
  • Project management skills: planning, estimating, budgeting, leading technical teams in projects, scheduling, coordinating, communicating, documenting, etc. required to manage multiple large telecommunications projects.
  • Problem solving skills to identify complex problem areas and service requirements, and to develop innovative solutions.
  • Analytical skills required for evaluating projects, performing needs assessment, estimating costs, managing a budget, prioritizing workload, etc.
  • Proven ability to work independently and to manage time to meet deadlines in an environment of changing priorities, and frequent interruptions.
  • Customer service skills and strong interpersonal/conflict resolution skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills required in order to provide information and reports in a clear, concise and logical manner. Proven ability to present written and verbal communications to upper management.

The Manager owns hiring, performance management, and development decisions for their team, sets and measures performance objectives, and builds/manages team capacity and capability to meet both current demands and evolving strategic priorities. Working based on IT governance direction, the Manager guides requirements gathering and solution design across relevant experts and peer IT leaders. Job Description:

Transform technology into opportunity as a Systems Architect with GDIT supporting the National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA). In this mission-focused role, you’ll shape secure, scalable enterprise IT and cloud solutions that directly impact how a critical U.S. government agency operates. This position is on-site in Denver, CO.

As a Systems Architect at GDIT, you will be a recognized technical leader responsible for designing, evaluating, and guiding enterprise and cloud architectures that align with business and mission needs. You will drive architectural decisions, modernize existing environments, and provide thought leadership on current and emerging technologies—especially around DNS, Azure, AWS, cloud migrations, on‑premises infrastructure, and Linux.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT
As a Systems Architect, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of the National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA). You will play a crucial role via the following:

  • Serve as a trusted solutions architecture expert, recognized as an industry leader in your domain.
  • Identify and design solutions based on business and technical requirements; assess alternatives, analyze trade-offs, and recommend optimal architectures.
  • Research and evaluate current and emerging technologies, tools, and methods, and recommend where to adopt, adapt, or refine processes and standards.
  • Assess existing system and business process architectures and work with stakeholders to recommend improvements for performance, security, and efficiency.
  • Ensure technical architecture teams deliver effective, scalable, and secure system and cloud solutions that support organizational goals and mission objectives.
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain service design procedures and processes using established frameworks and methodologies.
  • Prepare and deliver technical presentations, test plans, and analytical briefings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Elicit and refine customer requirements, evaluate alternatives, and recommend products and configurations across software, platform, network, and cloud domains.
  • Design, plan, and deploy DNS architectures with an emphasis on scalability, reliability, and security.
  • Implement and optimize monitoring tools and alerts to proactively detect and address performance and security issues.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams to integrate on-premises and cloud-based solutions into the broader enterprise environment.
  • Support and guide cloud migration initiatives, including assessment, planning, and execution of application and infrastructure migrations to Azure and AWS.
  • Provide clear status updates on cost, schedule, risks, and quality to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Coach and mentor less-experienced professionals; may serve as a team or task lead.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your technology expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT. The Systems Architect must have:

● Education: Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science

● Experience: 15+ years of related experience

● Technical Skills & Capabilities (Required):

  • Deep expertise in DNS architecture, with the ability to clearly explain DNS concepts and intricacies to technical teams.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing solutions in Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Cloud migration expertise, including understanding of migration strategies and patterns (e.g., rehost, replatform, refactor) and experience supporting or leading migrations of workloads to Azure and/or AWS.
  • Strong understanding of on-premises infrastructure, including:
    • VDI solutions
    • Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)
    • VMware technologies, including load balancing concepts and integrations
    • Microsoft 365 / Office 365 (O365) services and integrations with on-prem and cloud environments
  • Experience with Linux (e.g., system administration, troubleshooting, integration in mixed Windows/Linux environments, and supporting Linux workloads on-prem and in the cloud).
  • Familiarity with DNS-related and network services technologies such as Infoblox or similar platforms.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

● Security Clearance Level: Must possess an active Top Secret Clearance -or- active DOE Q Access Authorization.

● US Citizenship Required.

● This position is subject to random drug screening.

title: Animal Care & Enrichment Specialist
description:
Join Our Pack & Pride as an Animal Care & Enrichment Specialist

Hourly Rate: Starting at $17.00+ based on experience | Excellent Benefits


Do you light up at the swish of a happy cat tail and the thump-thump-thump of an excited dog? Does turning “just another day” into a second chance for a homeless pet make your heart race—in the best possible way? If so, the Humane Society of Sarasota County (HSSC) wants you on our team.


Why HSSC

At HSSC, we’re more than just a shelter—we’re a community fueled by compassion, innovation, and high-quality care. For more than 70 years we’ve been Sarasota County’s trusted animal shelter, pairing lifesaving programs with a people-first culture that supports the staff and volunteers who make the magic happen.


We provide compassionate care for over 2,000 cats and dogs each year, plus another 2,000 felines through our community cat program, investing every donor dollar back into their rescue, rehabilitation, and rehoming. By fostering collaboration, expanding volunteer-powered initiatives, and sharing expertise statewide, we’re building a No-Kill Florida—one wag, one purr, and one adoption at a time.


Benefits That Matter:

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Life & AD&D Insurance fully covered
  • Disability Insurance
  • 401(k) with up to 3% employer match
  • 3+ Weeks of PTO starting to accrue from day one of employment
  • FSA and Supplemental Insurance for added peace of mind
  • Employee Discounts on retail and medical care for your own pets
  • And much more!

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Purpose-Driven Work. Every kennel you scrub, litter box you refresh, enrichment puzzle you prep, and gentle chin scratch you offer moves an animal closer to a forever home.
  • Dog Walks & Cat Chats. From twice-daily leash walks and energy-burning playgroups for our canines to confidence-building enrichment sessions with whiskered friends, your days will be equal parts wag and purr.
  • Positive, People-First Culture. We lead collaboratively, build positivity, communicate intentionally, nurture ourselves, and transform continuously—because caring for animals starts with caring for each other.
  • Growth on Day One. Whether you’re new to sheltering or already Fear-Free certified, we’ll meet you where you are and help you advance (Animal Care Specialist I, II, III) through on-the-job training, mentorship, and cross-department learning.

What the Day Really Looks Like

  • Move & Groove. You’ll be on your feet—bending, lifting (up to 50lbs), and zipping between dog runs and cat condos—so your fitness tracker will love you.
  • Weather the Weather. Sarasota heat, surprise rain, a chorus of meows and barks—our shelter is equal parts indoor hub and outdoor playground.
  • Big Emotions, Bigger Rewards. Caring for sick and scared animals can tug at the heart, but the wagging tails, contented purrs, and adoption send-offs refill your cup every time.
  • Health & Safety Front-of-Mind. Daily exposure to animal dander, common food allergens, cleaning agents, and the potential for zoonotic diseases is part of shelter life—so we provide PPE, thorough protocols, and ongoing training to keep everyone safe.

WellQor is a patient centered, full-service psychological practice accessible online. We're a new model in care that marries the best of traditional and innovative approaches.

Unlike other online providers, our clinical therapists are one member of a team, collaborating with peers and a Clinical Director who is responsible for developing and guiding their team, all in pursuit of achieving the best possible outcome for you and your client. We’re not a directory service, we’re a full service psychology practice. And you won’t have to do it alone. We follow a care-team treatment model, which means clinicians are assigned to teams which they can connect with and consult for advice, institutional knowledge, and continued feedback to help advance you in your career.

description:
Job Description Summary

‎

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Senior Director of Change Management and Culture to lead our efforts in navigating the complexities of organizational change within our healthcare company with fostering a collaborative and thriving culture. This role is pivotal in developing and executing a comprehensive change management strategy that aligns with our vision to provide exceptional patient care and innovate healthcare delivery.
