title: Personlig assistent i Göteborg med omnejd, timmar till 80 %
description:
Vi söker dig som vill arbetar som personlig assistent. Du måste kunna tala och förstå svenska bra, eftersom många tjänster kräver att du skall tolka den personen du arbetar för.

Just nu har vi allt från timanställningar, extrajobb på kvällar och helger och större tjänster på 30-80 % som rullar på så länge assistansuppdraget varar. Vi har sällan tjänster som bara innebär arbete enbart på dagtid på vardagar.

Vi på rekryteringsavdelningen kommer att göra ett urval bland inkomna ansökningar och matcha lämpliga kandidater med någon av de assistansberättigade i GIL som just nu söker personal.

Att arbeta som personlig assistent kan många gånger vara olikt andra arbeten. Hur det blir beror på vem du jobbar hos och vem du är. Ni väljer varandra och bygger upp en relation som känns bra för båda. För många är tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet och utbildningar ganska ointressant, utan oftast handlar det om personkemi.

Arbetsuppgifterna för en personlig assistent beror på vem man jobbar hos. Somliga behöver mycket hjälp med kroppen, andra med knoppen. Vissa festar hårt, reser lång, har många barn. Somliga pluggar, andra jobbar. Någon hänger ofta i stallet, andra gillar hockey. Någon tycker om att måla, en annan älskar prinsesstårtor. Somliga är tystlåtna, andra snacksaliga.

Om du är intresserad av att jobba som personlig assistent i GIL, så skickar du in ett personligt brev, ditt CV och svarar på videofrågorna samt urvalsfrågorna.

Tjänsterna tillsätts löpande!

GIL samordnar personlig assistans sedan 1989. För oss handlar personlig assistans om att skapa förutsättningar för att en person med funktionsnedsättning ska kunna leva det liv hen själv vill leva. I många uppdrag är den assistansberättigade själv arbetsledare, medan andra har utsett en ställföreträdande arbetsledare. Uppdrag och roller ser olika ut beroende på verksamhet och funktion.

GIL:s kontor ger stöd inom bland annat arbetsledning, administration, ekonomi, HR och utbildning. Tillsammans bidrar vi till att vardagen fungerar för både assistansberättigade och medarbetare inom kooperativet.

För att få och behålla trygga och engagerade medarbetare satsar GIL på utbildning och gemensamma aktiviteter.

• GIL:s assistenter har kollektivavtal med Fremia–Kommunal

• Friskvårdsbidrag upp till 2 500 kr/år

• Individuell lönesättning

• Utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister ska visas upp vid anställning

Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, då urval sker löpande.

Summary of HB 531

The bill requires the Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA), in consultation with all specified agencies, to develop and maintain a user-friendly, public-facing webpage to serve as a centralized hub for education and awareness of the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse and state background screening processes and standards. The webpage must maintain up to date information and explain the background screening process through the clearinghouse, Level 2 screening requirements, fingerprinting procedures, and include a searchable job catalog, disqualifying offenses, exemption steps, and a downloadable checklist with timelines and details of the process.

Additionally, the bill requires all specified agencies to prominently link to this resource from their websites and require the inclusion of the link in all job postings by qualified entities

title: Transplant Coordinator II, RN - Liver Acquisition - Full Time 8 Hour Days (Exempt) (Union)
location: Los Angeles, CA - Health Sciences Campus
description:
Develops and maintains nursing practice standards of care for a specific transplant population. Serves as a liaison and provides consultation and education services to support standards of care. Identifies and resolves clinical issues relating to the transplant patient. Collaborates with staff, the patient, and his/her family concerning patient evaluation and discharge planning. Maintains appropriate documentation for transplant candidacy and post-transplant follow-up care. Coordinates communications with the outpatient transplant population such as transplant clinic visits, community referrals, telephone consultations, outpatient treatments, and subsequent hospital admissions. Develops and coordinates a system to organize the flow of patients from initial referral, through evaluation and education, to post-transplant follow-up and referral back to the community. Participates in collaborative, interdisciplinary research activities related to transplant patients or process improvement activities. Performs related responsibilities as required. This position may require rotating on call responsibilities as needed, including nights, weekends and holidays.

Departmental Specific Summary

The Donor Allocation Transplant Coordinator II has responsibility for taking call for the transplant programs. This call includes delegating appropriately all aspects of call related duties to the Donor Allocation Specialist, reviewing deceased donor organ offers when organs become available to transplant candidates for all organs, triaging patient calls for the transplant programs and other duties as may be assigned by the Donor Allocation Managers. The Donor Allocation Transplant Coordinator II facilitates acceptance or refusal of donor organs for transplant and coordinates the organ recovery with the transplant surgeons, Organ and Tissue Donation Team, Histocompatibility lab, and communicates effectively and sensitively with patients receiving the organs. The Donor Allocation Transplant Coordinator II must be able to spend the majority of his/her time executing complex logistical support pertaining to all aspects of organ recovery and placement. The coordinator provides 24/7 coverage on a rotating schedule including nights, weekends and holidays. The Donor Allocation Transplant Coordinator is a home-based position that may require on campus meetings and trainings.

Essential Duties

  • Takes deceased donor organ offers when organs become available to transplant candidates and after hour’s patient triage calls for the transplant programs.
  • Facilitates acceptance or refusal of donor organs for transplant and coordinates the organ recovery with the transplant surgeons, Organ and Tissue Donation Team, Histocompatibility lab, as well as communicates with patients receiving the organs
  • Executes complex logistical support pertaining to all aspects of organ recovery and placement.
  • Maintains composure and professional communication in all interactions with surgeons, potential recipients, Organ and Tissue Donation Staff, and donor hospital staff.
  • Demonstrate competence in triaging patient calls after hours and escalating calls to the on-call physician when appropriate
  • Demonstrates competence and management in the care of people with renal, hepatic, cardiac, and respiratory failure, diabetes, cardiopulmonary disease, hypertension, and other disorders related to transplantation. Knowledgeable in the management of immunosuppression including a host of adverse reactions and drug interactions.
  • Demonstrates sound knowledge base of UNOS policy and CMS regulatory requirements in relation to organ allocation, waitlist management as well as ongoing patient status updating.
  • Participates in UNOS responsibilities (listing, delisting, disease transmission reporting, donor culture reports management, status updates for all solid organs, etc.), and waiting list management
  • Knowledge of computer software is required to operate within the program’s local network, utilizing the Cerner platform and UNOS platform.
  • Responsible for entering and obtaining information in the potential recipient’s chart, and accessing the UNOS database for transplant donors.
  • Participates in 24/7 on call coverage on a rotating schedule, including nights, weekends and holidays.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


Qualifications

  • Req Bachelor's degree Nursing Graduate of an accredited school of Nursing OR
  • Req Associate's degree Nursing If graduate of an accredited school of nursing with Associate Degree, must have BSN degree conferred within two years of hire
  • Req 5 years Documented clinical experience working as a transplant coordinator.
  • Req Must have excellent communication skills, including the ability to speak, read and write English proficiently.
  • Req Knowledge of medical procedures and conditions and ability to understand, follow and successfully perform duties, including whole blood collection, and apheresis procedures, in accordance with administrative and clinical policies, regulations and procedures.
  • Req Experience taking organ offer or donor call.
  • Req Registered Nurse - RN (CA DCA)
  • Req Basic Life Support (BLS) Healthcare Provider from American Heart Association
  • Req Fire Life Safety Training (LA City) If no card upon hire, one must be obtained within 30 days of hire and maintained by renewal before expiration date. (Required within LA City only)
  • Req Certified Clinical Transplant Coordinator - CCTC (ABTC) CCTC or CPTC required. If CPTC certified must obtain CCTC within three years of hire
  • Req Certified Procurement Transplant Coordinator - CPTC (ABTC) If CPTC certified, must obtain CCTC within three years of hire.

    • Use of, overseeing and harnessing the advantages of AI tools in providing accurate and relevant copy content.

    • Minimum of 3+ years of experience, including an in-house creative or agency role working with Pharma sector clients
    • Awareness of local and country/region specific regulatory requirements
    • Familiarity with / intermediate understanding of, the fields of medicine and good to have respiratory & immunology, cardiovascular, renal & metabolic, oncology therapy areas
    • Be open to developing such knowledge, outlined immediately above, further working with relevant Medical teams
    • Strong flair, skills and passion for writing with conceptual ability and a solid knowledge of the digital landscape
    • Strong written and verbal communication/presentation skills
    • To have had relevant experience and being skilled in SEO copywriting, pairing best practices that drive traffic (keyword research), with compelling copy, encouraging a desired action, is a distinct advantage.
    • Passion for networking and stakeholder engagement.
    • Being up to date with the latest technical/scientific developments and relating them to various projects
    • Client-oriented attitude with focus on creating strong long-term relationships with clients and encouraging others to work toward this goal
    • Ability to assure timely completion of assignments
    • Skilled in problem identification and problem solving
    • Detail oriented, well organized and timeline driven with the ability to multitask.
    • Experience working within a large multi-national company in a matrix corporate environment preferable.
    • Should have both strong written and verbal communication skills in native Dutch language and good business English language skills.

title: Technical Compliance Program Manager
description:
Technical Compliance Program Manager

You'll build the operational bridge between what Firecrawl is legally and contractually required to do and how our technology actually does it. This is a build-from-scratch role: as we scale into our next phase, someone has to turn novel legal, security, and policy requirements into real technical controls, monitoring, and documentation that engineers will actually follow. That's you. You'll own how Firecrawl proves, in practice, that our systems do what our policies and commitments say they do.

This is not a legal role, and it's not a checklist compliance job. It's a technical program role for someone who speaks fluent engineer and fluent lawyer, and who is exceptionally good at turning ambiguous requirements into formal systems that work.

Salary Range: $251,000–$276,000/year

Equity Range: Competitive equity — details shared during the process.

Location: San Francisco, CA (Onsite)

Job Type: Full-Time

Experience: 4–8 years in technical program management, product/engineering operations, trust & safety, privacy operations, or a comparable role

Visa: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We're not able to sponsor visas right now, though that may change down the line.

About Firecrawl

Firecrawl is the easiest way to turn the web into data AI agents can use. One API call converts any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data - the boring-hard problem everyone building with LLMs eventually hits, solved.

We hit 8 figures in ARR in year one and more than doubled it in year two. We have 170k+ GitHub stars, and developers, agents, and category-defining AI companies build on us every day. Growth like this is rare, and we're just getting started.

We're a small team punching far above our weight. Everyone here owns a real piece of the product and company, end to end, and runs it themselves - no hiding behind process or headcount.

This is a place for people who want to work at the frontier: an AI company building the infrastructure other AI companies run on, not one bolting AI onto an existing product. We move fast, go deep, and are building the tools superintelligence will rely on to gather data from the web.

What You'll Do

  • Translate legal, security, and policy requirements into practical technical processes, controls, and documentation engineers will actually use

  • Build and maintain the monitoring and controls that show our systems do what our policies and commitments require

  • Own cross-functional compliance projects end to end across engineering, legal, sales, and ops — from novel requirement to shipped system

  • Document how our technical systems satisfy company policies and external obligations, in a way that survives a customer security review or an auditor's questions

  • Find the gaps before someone else does, escalate what matters, and drive it to closed

  • Build the metrics and reporting that tell leadership where we actually stand

  • Automate compliance wherever it's practical — you'd rather build a control that runs itself than police a process by hand

What We're Looking For

  • You've run technical programs across engineering teams and shipped operational systems, not just tracked them in a spreadsheet

  • You work fluently with software engineers and can hold your own on how systems actually work

  • You turn ambiguity into structure — novel, undefined requirements are the fun part, not the blocker

  • You're extraordinarily organized and you close loops without being chased

  • You're an excellent communicator in both directions: you can make a lawyer understand an architecture and an engineer understand an obligation

  • You're an AI super user — this is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have. You reach for AI to move faster by default.

  • Bonus: direct experience with legal, regulatory, privacy, or policy requirements. Preferred, not required — we care more about how you think than what frameworks you've memorized.

What We're NOT Looking For

  • Someone who runs compliance as a checklist and hands engineering a list of no's

  • A pure legal or GRC background with no real technical depth

  • Someone who needs the requirements fully defined before they can start

  • Someone who optimizes for process over shipping

A Note On Pace

We operate at an absurd level of urgency because the window for what we're building won't stay open forever. If that excites you, keep reading. If it doesn't, no hard feelings — but this role probably isn't for you.

Benefits & Perks

Available to all employees

  • Salary that makes sense — $251,000–$276,000/year, based on impact, not tenure

  • Own a piece — Gain competitive equity in what you're helping build

  • Generous PTO — 15 days mandatory, anything after 24 days, just ask (holidays excluded); take the time you need to recharge

  • Parental leave — 12 weeks fully paid, for all parents

  • Wellness stipend — $100/month for the gym, therapy, massages, or whatever keeps you human

  • Learning & Development — Expense up to $1,000/year toward anything that helps you grow professionally

  • Team offsites — A change of scenery, minus the trust falls

  • Sabbatical — 3 paid months off after 4 years, do something fun and new

Available to US-based full-time employees

  • Full coverage, no red tape — Medical, dental, and vision (100% for employees, 50% for spouse/kids) — no weird loopholes, just care that works

  • Life & Disability insurance — Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance — coverage for life's curveballs

  • Supplemental options — Optional accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and voluntary life insurance for extra peace of mind

  • Doctegrity telehealth — Talk to a doctor from your couch

  • 401(k) plan — Retirement might be a ways off, but future-you will thank you

  • Pre-tax benefits — Access to FSAs and commuter benefits (US-only) to help your wallet out a bit

  • Pet insurance — Because fur babies are family too

Available to SF-based employees

  • SF HQ perks — Snacks, drinks, team lunches, intense ping pong, and peak startup energy

  • E-Bike transportation — A loaner electric bike to get you around the city, on us

Interview Process

Application Review — Send us your work and a quick note on why this excites you. Show us something you've built or run — a program, a control, a system that made a messy requirement real. We care about what you've done, not where you went to school.

Intro Chat (~25 min) — A quick conversation to get to know each other before we go deep. We'll talk about what you've been working on, what drew you to Firecrawl, and what you're looking for in your next role. Time for your questions too.

Technical Chat (~45 min) — We'll dig into a real problem from our world — how you'd stand up a control and prove a system does what our policy says, or turn a vague external requirement into something engineers can ship against — and talk through how you'd approach it. Come ready to think out loud; we care how you reason, not whether you memorized a framework.

Founder Chat (~25 min) — Culture, pace, ownership, and how you like to work. Time for your questions too.

Paid Work Trial (1-2 weeks) — Work with the team on a real, scoped piece of the work — paid at a contractor rate. It's the truest signal for both sides: you see what building at Firecrawl actually feels like, and we see how you operate. Remote-friendly, and we'll flex around your current commitments.

Decision — We move fast after the trial.

If you want to design a modern compliance function from scratch at one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world, you should join us.

👉 Apply now.

title: Instructional Coach
location: Old North Academy - Saint Louis, MO 63107
description:
Purpose Statement
The job of Instructional Coach is done for the purpose/s of coordinating the teacher mentoring program and
related activities by providing information, techniques, and strategies to help teachers work more effectively
with their students; implementing and maintaining services within established guidelines and standards;
providing leadership, coaching, and professional development in service of teacher development. The
Instructional Coach serves as a key member of the school site's Leadership Team.
This job reports to Principal
Essential Functions

  • Analyzes a variety of program related information (e.g. student improvement data, goal setting, etc.) for the purpose of providing direction and support, making recommendations, and/or ensuring overall outcomes are at required network standards.
  • Assesses professional development needs of teachers based on classroom observations and other means as necessary for the purpose of enhancing instructional practices, fostering professional growth, and ultimately improving student learning outcomes.
  • Assists teachers with a variety of items (e.g. resources, materials, tools, information, etc.) for the purpose of supporting classroom instruction and internalization/planning.
  • Builds and maintains strong relationships with teachers, administrators, and other coaches for the purpose of creating trust and advancing the work of the district.
  • Coaches teachers and intervention personnel (e.g. modeling best practices, etc.) for the purpose of improving performance, problem solving techniques, and a variety of personal issues for professional development.
  • Collaborates with school leadership and other instructional staff and coaches (e.g. solicit feedback and take action based on feedback, seek out professional learning opportunities to stay informed of current research and best practices, support one another's growth, etc.) for the purpose of planning and improving the overall quality of student outcomes and achieving established classroom objectives.
  • Conducts regular pedagogy meeting with specific goals for instructional staff (e.g. utilizing Adult Learning
  • Theory to motivate adult learners to improve professional practice, etc.) for the purpose of enhancing instructional practices, fostering professional growth, and ultimately improving student learning outcomes.
  • Coordinates local and state student assessments by organizing, distributing, and explaining the assessment process to instructional staff for the purpose of maintaining compliance with network and state assessment mandates.
  • Develops high-quality professional learning and coaching plans and identifies goals with teachers based on data (e.g. develop staff members’ knowledge, skills, attitudes, and behaviors through a variety of professional development targeted topics and designs, etc.) for the purpose of demonstrating progress to goal and guiding teachers in reflection.
  • Evaluates assigned personnel (e.g. cluster group teachers, instructional assistants, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring that standards are achieved and performance is maximized.
  • Monitors students in a variety of educational settings (e.g. classrooms, playground, field trips, etc.) for the purpose of providing a safe and positive learning environment.
  • Organizes instructional materials and resources delivering them to teachers for the purpose of enhancing instructional practices and improving student learning outcomes.
  • Participates in meetings, workshops, trainings, and seminars for the purpose of conveying and/or gathering information required to perform functions.
  • Prepares a variety of written materials (e.g. evaluations, anecdotal records, schedules, etc.) for the purpose of documenting teacher progress and meeting mandated requirements.
  • Provides individualized teacher support (e.g. observing/providing feedback, modeling instruction, co-teaching, etc.) for the purpose of enhancing instructional practices; implementing established curriculum and/or individual student plans; and improving student learning outcomes, consistent with District initiatives and best instructional practices.
  • Reports incidents (e.g. fights, suspected child abuse, suspected substance abuse, etc.) for the purpose of maintaining personal safety of students, providing a positive learning environment, and adhering to network, local, and state policies/mandates.
  • Responds to inquiries from a variety of sources (e.g. teachers, parents, administrators, etc.) for the purpose of resolving issues and providing information and/or direction.

Other Functions
Performs other related duties as assigned for the purpose of ensuring the efficient and effective
functioning of the school site.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

Summary:

Rover’s European Trust and Safety team is responsible for supporting Rover's reputation by providing excellent customer care through problem resolution of issues that pose the greatest risk to the company in our most challenging and sensitive situations for our entire European operation. As a Trust and Safety Agent, you will be responsible for supporting users with specialty Trust and Safety casework, investigating complex animal and person related safety incidents, and providing objective assessments and guidance on remediation. You will work as the front-line on issues that are integral to Rover’s mission and longevity by ensuring our marketplace standards and policies are upheld.

Who we're looking for:

You'll succeed in this role if you lean into hard conversations, have experience in de-escalation, and have a passion for getting the right solutions for both the customer and the company. You must be impartial, empathetic, and able to resolve issues in the best interest of our users, platform, and brand image. Your ability to identify between what is critical and what is secondary will aid you in being effective in this role.

In this role you will treat customers as part of our community. You never settle for good enough and strive to deliver above the minimum. You take the initiative to improve yourself and Rover. You bring your unique experiences and passions to your job every day.

The nature of this role may require working outside of normal business hours and on weekends/holidays to ensure adequate escalation coverage.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Effectively prioritize competing high priority internal and external customer demands
  • Manage a large volume of high severity, dynamic customer contacts with attention to detail, ownership, and follow-through
  • Educate users on how to maintain safety and security while being responsible members of the Rover community
  • Handle escalated customer contacts and appropriately escalate concerns to your leader when appropriate
  • Thoughtfully, decisively, and neutrally investigate Trust & Safety cases with high complexity and high sensitivity, maintaining customer satisfaction and Rover's Brand image
  • Exhibit the ability to make quick and accurate decisions under pressure
  • Consistently remain empathetic, and compassionate in high stakes emergency situations, and guide customers to efficient solutions. You remain level headed, not getting shaken by difficult or complex situations
  • Generate and respond to support calls, emails, and SMS messages in support of resolving active customer incidents (e.g., emergency pet care) while quickly assessing and routing incidents to the appropriate department.
  • Work with teammates and leadership across multiple locations to identify and scope risks related to customer experience, policy, tooling, and workflow improvements
  • Own decisions in holistic safety reviews where users may be removed from the platform for not following Rover Community Guidelines, Policies, or Terms of Service
  • Maintain high levels of confidentiality
  • Investigate complex veterinary claims with due diligence, including assessing eligibility of gray area claims.
  • Effectively deliver on other projects/duties as assigned by business management

Your Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of Trust and Safety or similar safety related experience
  • 1+ years of experience in customer facing roles requiring de-escalation of intense customer concerns or crisis response
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Able to quickly take accurate typed notes while talking to members of the Rover community.
  • Familiarity with web based applications such as ZenDesk, GSuite, CRM tools, and Telephony software.
  • Fluency in French

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field or equivalent
  • Used Rover as an owner or a sitter
  • Experience in digital marketplaces (Rover, Airbnb, Uber, etc)
  • 1+ years of experience in the Veterinary or Animal Health Clinic/Industry, or related field
  • 1+ years experience in public relations/communication, Social media monitoring and response
  • Fluency in other European languages

Benefits of Working at Rover.com:

  • Competitive compensation
    401k match
  • Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout
    4 weeks PTO
  • Competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Commuter benefits
  • Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)
  • Pet benefits, including $1000 toward adopting your first dog or cat
  • Stocked fridges, coffee, soda, and lots of treats (for humans and dogs) and free catered lunches monthly
  • Regular team activities performed in-person and virtually

Compensation:

    • In Spain the first-year salary range is €35,405 - €42,915. Additionally, Rover offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees.

title: Clerk
description:
Position: Store Clerk

Department: Retail

Reports To: Store Manager

Position Type: Part-Time
Location: We’koqma’q Irving One Stop



GENERAL ACCOUNTABILITY STATEMENT

Accountable to the Store Supervisor/Director,
the store Clerk at Irving One Stop is responsible for providing excellent customer service by efficiently scanning items, processing payments, and handling transactions. This includes accepting payments in the form of cash, checks, or credit cards from customers in exchange for products or services. The store Clerk also balances the cash drawer at the end of each shift. This role is fundamental in achieving customer satisfaction and contributing to revenue growth objectives.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Payment Transactions: Handle payment transactions (cash, credit/debit card) between customers and the retail store, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
  • Customer Interaction: Greet customers warmly, answer phones, and direct inquiries to the appropriate party.
  • Billing and Payments: Answer routine billing questions/issues from customers, receive and process all payments according to standard procedures, and balance daily cash to ensure receipts match.
  • Product Scanning: Scan products, operate scanning equipment, and resolve any scanning issues.
  • Opening and Closing: Assist in the opening and closing of the retail location, including cash handling and deposits.
  • Customer Assistance: Inform customers about available products/services, assess customer needs, and examine products for damages and price accuracy.
  • Coordination: Coordinate with retail staff for product inquiries and price checks.
  • Issue Resolution: Resolve escalated issues with customers who are angry or dissatisfied.
  • Training: Train and sometimes supervise new cashiers or other retail workers.
  • Store Maintenance: Assist in maintaining the storefront and retail displays, including stocking shelves/coolers with products as needed throughout the shift.
  • Inventory Management: Inform the manager or assistant manager of items needed, such as low numbers of lotto tickets or fully stocked packs of smokes.
  • Expired/Damaged Items: Dispose of any expired or damaged items in the store properly, ensuring proper documentation.
  • Cleaning: Dust and clean all shelves during the shift, ensuring all items are available at the front row of the shelf and checking expiry dates.
  • Paperwork: Complete, process, and maintain applicable paperwork, reports, and records.
  • Pricing: Itemize and total purchases by recording prices, departments, taxable and non-taxable items, and enter price changes by referring to price sheets and special sale bulletins.
  • Discounts: Apply discounts by redeeming coupons.
  • Customer Amenities: Ensure that fresh coffee is available for customers.
  • Store Cleanliness: Maintain cleanliness and maintenance of the store, including:
    • Cleaning counters, coffee area, and microwave throughout the shift.
    • Removing garbage from containers and disposing of it properly.
    • Checking and cleaning the bathroom on an hourly basis and ensuring it is well supplied.
    • Sweeping and mopping floors to maintain clean and safe premises.
    • Cleaning the parking area and walkway of debris.
    • Clearing the walkway of snow or ice and adding salt as necessary.
    • Shoveling the gas pump area and entrance ways when snow or slush-covered, and monitoring gas pumps for potential drive-aways.
  • Safety and Security: Ensure the store and property are safe, including:
    • Inspecting leak detection systems.
    • Manually observing the gauges of all tanks to detect the presence of water and taking readings.
    • Inspecting product pumps.
    • Gauging observation wells and inspecting spill pipes, and initialing the Operator’s Environmental handbook.
    • Reporting any leakage, safety, and/or environmental threats to management.
    • Inspecting and cleaning pump handles during the winter to ensure they are not frozen.
  • Team Contribution: Contribute to team efforts by accomplishing related results as needed.
  • Product Validation: Validate and establish prices of products and apply price stickers.
  • Packaging: Bag, box, or wrap packages for customers.
  • Patrol: Patrol assigned areas to guard against theft, vandalism, and fire.
  • Other Duties: Perform other related duties as assigned.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous retail or customer service experience preferred.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to handle transactions accurately and responsibly.
  • Basic math skills for handling cash and processing payments.



Why Join Our Team?

Join a friendly and supportive team where you'll have the opportunity to build valuable customer service and retail skills while serving the community. At Irving One Stop, we value teamwork, reliability, and a commitment to providing an excellent customer experience.


How to Apply

Interested applicants are invited to submit:

  • Cover Letter
  • Resume


We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.


Closing Date: Open until filled.


Preference may be given to qualified Indigenous applicants.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Core Commerce Platform
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy.

Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.

YOUR MISSION

About the Organisation & Role:

You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing & fulfilment and post-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. Through a portfolio of commerce platform capabilities, the organisation enables seamless omnichannel experiences while supporting efficient, scalable, and resilient commerce operations across the global digital ecosystem.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain production-grade backend services that power Inventory, Promise & Order Fulfilment capabilities. You will work closely with Tech Leads, Product Owners, and Data Engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and low-latency services. You will actively contribute to design decisions, code reviews and mentor junior engineers in the team.

What you will do:

  • Design and operate secure, observable and resilient Java/Spring Boot services and low-latency APIs for inventory availability and order promising with performance suitable for peak and concurrent demand

  • Implement robust concurrency-control and consistency patterns to prevent overselling when multiple orders compete for limited inventory.

  • Build event-driven inventory processing using Kafka or similar messaging technologies to handle receipts, adjustments, reservations, releases, cancellations, and fulfilment updates in near real time.

  • Integrate inventory and promising services with OMS, commerce, WMS, ERP, store, and fulfilment platforms to provide consistent availability across the order lifecycle.

  • Independently own complex services or components from technical design through production.

  • Write clean, tested and maintainable code, participate in peer reviews, and maintain relevant technical documentation.

  • Optimize performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency through automation and proactive improvements.

  • Support production services through monitoring, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis contributing to reliability improvements.

  • Lead component-level design, document trade-offs and contribute recommendations to team-level architecture decisions.

  • Mentor junior engineers, perform code reviews and help establish engineering standards and best practices.

YOUR TALENT

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and operating scalable, high-availability, consumer-facing platforms.

  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java, Spring Boot, and modern microservices architectures, building scalable, resilient, and production-grade services.

  • Strong understanding of design patterns, data structures and algorithms, with practical experience applying them to real-world use cases.

  • Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar event-streaming platforms for event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and enterprise-scale system integrations.

  • Deep understanding of caching strategies and hands-on experience with Redis or equivalent technologies.

  • Strong understanding of concurrency, consistency, and transactional integrity patterns required to prevent overselling in distributed commerce environments.

  • Experience implementing event-driven architectures and designing resilient solutions that maintain accuracy under peak trading and high-volume conditions.

  • Experience designing graceful degradation and fallback mechanisms that ensure continuity of commerce operations during downstream system disruptions.

  • Strong experience with observability and operational excellence practices, including monitoring, distributed tracing and alerting.

  • Understanding of inventory management concepts, order promising and delivery estimation models, including inventory location, fulfilment capacity, carrier constraints, and service-level commitments is highly desirable.

  • Experience configuring, customizing, and extending OMS platform capabilities to support complex business requirements and omnichannel commerce use cases is preferred.

  • Hands-on experience integrating or configuring Fluent Commerce or a comparable OMS platform such as IBM Sterling OMS, Manhattan Associates, Kibo, Salesforce OMS, or similar technologies will be an advantage.

  • Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity.

NEPEAN is a proud Australian-owned global organisation with operations across engineering, manufacturing and industrial solutions. We are currently rolling out Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations across a multi-entity global group, with Finance at the core of the platform.

This is a key opportunity to step into a senior internal role where you will help shape how Finance operates in D365 across the group.

As our Finance Functional Lead, you will own the global finance template, support live production environments and guide new entity deployments from design through to go-live and hypercare. You will be the internal authority for how Finance works in D365, protecting standardisation while helping the business move from vendor-led implementation to a sustainable internal ERP capability.

What you’ll be doing
  • Global template ownership. Act as the internal owner of the D365 Finance template. Govern chart of accounts, dimensions, posting profiles, tax structures and intercompany setup, and review and approve every finance-related change request. Protect standardisation across all legal entities and control how the template is allowed to evolve.
  • Multi-entity rollout. Support new entity deployments from design through go-live and hypercare, participate in solution validation and UAT, and ensure controlled localisation rather than fragmentation.
  • Production support. Support the finance environments of entities already live, resolving functional issues, supporting month-end and period close, and maintaining the health of the finance configuration in production. This includes the support work currently carried by our external finance consultant, which this role will absorb.
  • Vendor transition. Progressively take on responsibilities currently performed by external finance consultants, lead knowledge transfer, and ensure the finance configuration is fully documented and owned internally.
  • Stakeholder engagement. Act as the bridge between Finance leadership and IT, translate accounting requirements into D365 configuration, and provide training and support to key finance users across the group.
About you

You will bring strong D365 Finance functional experience, sound accounting knowledge and the confidence to own a group-wide template. This role will suit someone who can balance hands-on configuration, governance, production support and stakeholder engagement.

Ideal candidates will possess:

  • Substantial hands-on experience across D365 Finance / AX Finance modules, deep enough to own the template rather than take direction on it. As a guide, 7+ years in D365 or AX Finance, including at least one full multi-entity implementation.
  • Strong command of General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Receivable, Fixed Assets, intercompany, and tax and localisation.
  • Real experience in multi-legal-entity environments, and comfort supporting live production alongside ongoing rollout.
  • A solid grounding in accounting principles and financial governance, and the judgment and spine to hold a standard against a business unit that wants an exception.
  • Experience supporting end-to-end ERP implementations from design to hypercare.
Desirable experience
  • Manufacturing or multi-site environment experience.
  • Microsoft certification (MB-310 or equivalent).
  • Exposure to consolidation and intercompany processes at group level.
Why join us?
  • Take ownership of a critical global finance platform during a major transformation program.
  • Move beyond project delivery into a genuine internal authority and governance role.
  • Work across a diverse multi-entity business with exposure to finance leadership, IT and operational teams.
  • Help build NEPEAN’s long-term internal ERP capability and reduce reliance on external consultants.
If you're an experienced D365 Finance professional looking for ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to make a lasting impact, this could be your next career move. Click Apply Now to join the NEPEAN team!

title: Senior Full-stack Engineer

title: Enterprise Solutions Engineer
description:
Enterprise Solutions Engineer

The world's biggest companies want to build on Firecrawl. You'll own the cloud layer that makes that possible — the security, deployment, and infrastructure capabilities enterprises expect before they'll trust you with their web data. You'll sit alongside sales to understand exactly what a deal needs, then build it into the platform. This is a 0-to-1 role: real ownership from day one, not tickets in a backlog.

Salary Range: $235,000–$260,000/year

Equity Range: Competitive equity — details shared during the process.

Location: San Francisco, CA (Onsite)

Job Type: Full-Time

Experience: 5+ years in backend, platform, or cloud security engineering

Visa: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We're not able to sponsor visas right now, though that may change down the line.

About Firecrawl

Firecrawl is the easiest way to turn the web into data AI agents can use. One API call converts any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data - the boring-hard problem everyone building with LLMs eventually hits, solved.

We hit 8 figures in ARR in year one and more than doubled it in year two. We have 170k+ GitHub stars, and developers, agents, and category-defining AI companies build on us every day. Growth like this is rare, and we're just getting started.

We're a small team punching far above our weight. Everyone here owns a real piece of the product and company, end to end, and runs it themselves - no hiding behind process or headcount.

This is a place for people who want to work at the frontier: an AI company building the infrastructure other AI companies run on, not one bolting AI onto an existing product. We move fast, go deep, and are building the tools superintelligence will rely on to gather data from the web.

What You'll Do

  • Own enterprise requirements end to end — from the security review or sales conversation where they surface, through design, to shipped platform capability

  • Sit in enterprise sales conversations alongside the team, translating what a prospect actually needs into what gets built

  • Build the security and deployment capabilities big companies expect — key management, tenant isolation, compliance integrations, flexible deployment across cloud and on-prem

  • Turn one-off enterprise asks into reusable platform capability, not per-customer patches

  • Work directly with the founders and core platform engineers to land what you design

  • Ship what you design — this is a building role, not an advisory one

What We're Looking For

  • You've shipped what enterprise security teams ask for — and gone deep on it, not just checked boxes

  • You've built or operated multi-cloud or hybrid infrastructure — cloud and on-prem, not just one provider

  • You have deep cloud security and IAM fundamentals

  • You're comfortable shipping in TypeScript/Node — you build what you design, you don't hand it off

  • You can walk an enterprise security team through your design and answer the hard questions on the spot

What We're NOT Looking For

  • Someone who treats security and compliance as a checkbox, not real engineering

  • Someone who solves it once per customer instead of once for the platform

  • Someone looking for a solutions-engineering seat — this is a builder role that visits the sales room, not the other way around

A Note On Pace

We operate at an absurd level of urgency because the window for what we're building won't stay open forever. If that excites you, keep reading. If it doesn't, no hard feelings — but this role probably isn't for you.

Benefits & Perks

Available to all employees

  • Salary that makes sense — $235,000–$260,000/year (SF, U.S.-based), based on impact, not tenure

  • Own a piece — Gain competitive equity in what you're helping build

  • Generous PTO — 15 days mandatory, anything after 24 days, just ask (holidays excluded); take the time you need to recharge

  • Parental leave — 12 weeks fully paid, for all parents

  • Wellness stipend — $100/month for the gym, therapy, massages, or whatever keeps you human

  • Learning & Development — Expense up to $1,000/year toward anything that helps you grow professionally

  • Team offsites — A change of scenery, minus the trust falls

  • Sabbatical — 3 paid months off after 4 years, do something fun and new

Available to US-based full-time employees

  • Full coverage, no red tape — Medical, dental, and vision (100% for employees, 50% for spouse/kids) — no weird loopholes, just care that works

  • Life & Disability insurance — Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance — coverage for life's curveballs

  • Supplemental options — Optional accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and voluntary life insurance for extra peace of mind

  • Doctegrity telehealth — Talk to a doctor from your couch

  • 401(k) plan — Retirement might be a ways off, but future-you will thank you

  • Pre-tax benefits — Access to FSAs and commuter benefits (US-only) to help your wallet out a bit

  • Pet insurance — Because fur babies are family too

Available to SF-based employees

  • SF HQ perks — Snacks, drinks, team lunches, intense ping pong, and peak startup energy

  • E-Bike transportation — A loaner electric bike to get you around the city, on us

Interview Process

Application Review — Send us your work and a quick note on why this excites you. Show us what you've built — enterprise security capabilities, multi-cloud or hybrid infrastructure, integrations that passed a real security review. We care about what you've shipped, not where you went to school.

Intro Chat (~25 min) — A quick conversation to get to know each other before we go deep. We'll talk about what you've been working on, what drew you to Firecrawl, and what you're looking for in your next role. Time for your questions too.

Technical Chat (~45 min) — We'll dig into a real enterprise requirement from our world — the kind a security review or a big contract puts on the table — and talk through how you'd design and ship it. Come ready to think out loud; we care how you reason, not whether you memorized the answer.

Founder Chat (~25 min) — Culture, pace, ownership, and how you like to work. Time for your questions too.

Paid Work Trial (1-2 weeks) — Work with the team on a real, scoped piece of the enterprise roadmap — paid at a contractor rate. It's the truest signal for both sides: you see what building at Firecrawl actually feels like, and we see how you ship. Remote-friendly, and we'll flex around your current commitments.

Decision — We move fast after the trial.

If building the infrastructure the world's biggest companies trust with their web data sounds like your kind of problem, you should join us.

👉 Apply now.

title: Program Manager, Radiopharmaceutical & Life Sciences Logistics
description:
Program Manager, Radiopharmaceutical & Life Sciences Logistics

About Ascent

Ascent Global Logistics, headquartered in Belleville, Michigan, is a leading global provider of expedited, time-critical logistics solutions and other direct transportation services. The company connects customers to its extensive carrier network, internal ground fleet and airline via its proprietary, digital PEAK freight marketplace, which provides robust carrier capacity and transparent pricing, backed by 24/7/365 logistics experts. Ascent’s offerings include air charter and ground expedited solutions as well as truckload, less-than-truckload, global forwarding, brokerage, and managed transportation services. The experienced Ascent team solves customers’ most challenging logistics needs by providing industry-leading service and top-tier satisfaction.

Our Guiding Principles

At the core of Ascent's culture is a strong commitment to excellence, driven by the passion and dedication of every team member. We're equally dedicated to going above and beyond for our customers, ensuring this commitment extends beyond our team and brings exceptional value to those we serve. We aim for perfect execution in everything we do and ‘play hard’ by creating an environment where tasks are performed with a can-do attitude from start to finish. We ‘play smart’ by delivering on our commitments in an honest, fair and ethical manner. We treat every person with whom we interface with the utmost dignity and respect. We understand that our teammates are our most valuable assets, so we ‘play together’ by making every effort to provide a professional and enjoyable experience, enabling careers to flourish and personal growth to be achieved.

What You’ll Do

Ascent Global Logistics is seeking a highly organized Program Manager with deep operational command to run our specialized, time-critical logistics programs for radiopharmaceutical manufacturers, nuclear medicine pharmacies, and healthcare networks.

Because radioactive medical isotopes have short half-lives and decay rapidly, this role demands absolute operational precision and a zero-fail mindset. You will own execution within our control tower driving milestone tracking, carrier and network coordination, and disruption response to ensure life-saving diagnostics and theranostic treatments reach patients safely and on time. This is fundamentally an operations command role: the discipline is running a tight, fast-reacting control tower, not managing a client relationship from the outside.

This is a senior, high-visibility role built around Ascent's dedicated 4PL control tower model for life sciences accounts, with direct exposure to senior operations leadership and the chance to shape how this segment scales operationally.

  • Control Tower Execution: Run day-to-day operational command of time-sensitive isotope shipments end-to-end dispatch, routing, carrier coordination, and real-time transit monitoring with zero tolerance for missed windows.
  • Proactive Disruption Management: Continuously monitor flight and ground transit status to identify risk early and re-route before a delay threatens a dose; this is anticipatory operations, not reactive firefighting.
  • Cross-Functional Network Coordination: Direct specialty healthcare couriers, airport/ground operations, and internal technology teams to build and enforce frictionless, repeatable transportation workflows.
  • Regulatory & Safety Alignment: Work with Quality Assurance and safety officers to ensure strict operational adherence to transport requirements for hazardous, radioactive, and temperature-sensitive biological materials.
  • High-Urgency Escalation Ownership: Lead root-cause investigations and drive corrective action plans (CAPA) when disruptions occur, rapidly deploying alternative routing and standing up contingency plans under pressure.
  • Operational Program Build: Help shape and scale the control tower's operating model and playbooks as this segment expands this is a build-and-own role, not a maintain role.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • 7+ years in time-critical logistics operations, control tower management, program management, or specialized transportation operations.
  • Solid understanding of healthcare supply chains, cold-chain logistics, or high-care transport operations. Direct experience with radiopharmaceuticals or nuclear medicine is a major plus.
  • A track record of running intense, time-critical operations where delays directly affect patient health outcomes — comfortable making fast, high-consequence routing decisions under pressure.
  • Able to work fluently across transportation tracking systems and translate operational metrics into performance reporting and process improvements.

Ascent’s Competitive Benefits

  • 401(k) and employer matching
  • Life Insurance
  • Health, Dental, Vision Insurance
  • Short- & Long-Term Disability
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Wellness Program
  • Paid Holidays
  • Employee Recognition Programs
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Overtime, Differential & Bonus Pay
Salary Range: $80,000 - $110,000

title: FOODSERVICE DESIGN MANAGER- (REMOTE, GA, US, REMOTE)
description:
Salary: $100,000-$120,000 + bonus eligible

A family of companies and experiences

As the leading foodservice and support services company, Compass Group USA is known for our great people, great service and our great results. If you’ve been hungry and away from home, chances are you’ve tasted Compass Group’s delicious food and experienced our outstanding service. We have over 284,000 US associates who work in award-winning restaurants, corporate cafes, hospitals, schools, arenas, museums, and more in all 50 states. Our reach is constantly expanding to shape the industry and create new opportunities for innovation. Join the Compass family today!

great people. great services. great results.

Each and every individual plays a key role in the growth and legacy of our company. We know the next big idea can come from anyone. We encourage developing and attracting expertise that differentiates us as a company as we continue to raise the bar.

Job Summary

The Foodservice Design Manager oversees the planning, technical execution, and day-to-day coordination of foodservice and retail design projects across Compass Group’s portfolio. This role directly manages Foodservice Designers and BIM Managers, guiding the creation of forward-thinking café and dining spaces for corporate workplaces, education, sports, and leisure sectors while helping establish national design guidelines.

Responsibilities

  • Team Supervision & Workflow Management: Manage and guide Foodservice Designers and BIM staff on daily project tasks, Revit/CAD standards, and production deadlines.
  • Design Delivery & Quality Control: Oversee and develop foodservice layouts across all design phases (SD, DD, CD, and CA), ensuring technical accuracy and alignment with project scopes.
  • Technical & MEP Coordination: Supervise the drafting of equipment layouts, plumbing/electrical utility rough-ins, and Special Conditions plans, coordinating directly with external Architectural and Engineering project teams.
  • Equipment Specification Oversight: Review and approve equipment selections, AutoQuotes documentation, cut books, and 11400 foodservice specification manuals for accuracy and code compliance.
  • Custom Fabrication Review: Review custom millwork and fabrication drawings, collaborating with the VP of Design to implement necessary design modifications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary design point of contact in project engineering meetings, working closely with Project Managers and clients to maintain project milestones and budgets.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or Engineering.
Experience: 10+ years of professional experience in commercial foodservice design, kitchen planning, and design coordination.

title: Director, Planning & Strategic Sourcing
description:
Overview

The Director, Planning & Strategic Sourcing is responsible for leading the procurement, planning, and category sourcing strategies for key materials, equipment, and services that are essential to renewable energy construction projects. This position is responsible for optimizing supplier partnerships, reducing costs, managing risks, and ensuring the supply chain supports Mastec Renewables’ sustainability and growth objectives. The Director-Planning and Strategic Sourcing will also be vital for leading the management of project material needs and schedule with project operations and other relative departments. This position will anticipate market capabilities, understand company goals and execute long-term negotiations to help the organization achieve pricing advantages. This position requires a strong understanding of global sourcing, contract negotiation, and regulatory compliance.

Location and Travel Details: This is a remote position, which can be based anywhere in the U.S. This position supports our business across the United States. This position will have up to 50% travel.

Company Overview

MasTec Renewables, comprised of Wanzek Construction, IEA Constructors, and White Construction, combines over 20 years of experience in renewable energy construction. Depending on your position and project, you may work for one or more of our companies over your career with us. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News-Record [ENR]: #1 in Power, #17 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, #20 Transportation Contractor).

We embrace diverse perspectives among our employees and across all levels of our business, including our suppliers, community partners, and clients. We have built a multidimensional workforce that brings valuable differences in perspectives, work ethics, and approaches to our organization. By collaborating across departments, we foster innovation and encourage everyone—from interns to executives—to share their ideas and make an impact. Our goal is to create a respectful work environment where all employees feel valued, included, and empowered to become innovative leaders in our industry.

The MasTec Renewables market sector is part of the MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure business segment. MasTec’s Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) segment generates over $4 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across industrial, renewables and infrastructure sectors. Our renewables sector focuses on solar, wind and battery storage. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do.

MasTec, a minority-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Develop and implement long-term sourcing strategies that align with company goals
  • Identify and qualify new suppliers to mitigate risks, reduce costs, and improve supply chain efficiency
  • Identify and evaluate domestic and international suppliers to optimize cost, quality, and supply chain resilience
  • Optimize procurement processes to enhance value creation, cost reduction, and risk management
  • Stay informed on market trends, tariffs, and trade regulations to adjust sourcing strategies proactively
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with executive leadership at key suppliers, ensuring service level agreements and performance benchmarks are met
  • Negotiate contracts, pricing agreements, and terms to secure the best value for the company
  • Work collaboratively with management to coordinate supplier selection, credit and terms, track supplier performance standards, and conduct ongoing evaluation
  • Develop supplier diversification strategies to reduce dependency on single sources and high-risk regions
  • Implement cost saving initiatives through value engineering, supplier consolidation, and alternative sourcing through total cost of ownership (TCO)
  • Identify, manage, and mitigate risks related to tariffs, supply chain disruptions, and geopolitical factors
  • Drive early identification and risk mitigation strategies to address supply chain disruptions, material shortages, and price volatility on long lead equipment and high-risk materials
  • Collaborate with finance and operations teams to forecast and manage procurement budgets effectively
  • Partner with internal stakeholders (estimating, engineering, and operations) to align sourcing strategies with business needs
  • Oversee the collaboration with Project Managers, Pre-construction, Scheduling, and Procurement teams to align project construction needs and material purchasing and delivery schedules
  • Ensure project material needs and schedule are managed effectively from project aware through completion of project
  • Facilitate timely resolution of issues with suppliers related to price, quality, delivery, condition, etc. to management
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging technology and data analytics for decision making
  • Lead a team of Category Managers & Buyers and Procurement Planners, providing mentorship, training, and performance management
  • Develop succession planning for the organization for continued retention and professional development
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Education and Work Experience Requirements:

  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, procurement, construction management or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 10+ years of procurement and strategic sourcing experience, with at least 5 years in a management and leadership role
  • 5+ years of Energy industry experience preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Ability to influence and lead employees, internal partners, and external vendors
  • Ability to work within precise standards of accuracy and follow set procedures and standards
  • Ability to think strategically and multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of Company’s offerings (solutions, products, and services)
  • Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma, Operational Excellence, or other continuous improvement strategies
  • Excellent collaboration and written/verbal communication skills
  • Excellent computer skills with working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and system databases
  • Knowledge of best practice and benchmarking function to industry norms
  • Excellent knowledge of contract negotiation, administration, and procurement practices
  • Excellent knowledge of purchasing, goods deliveries, and demand planning practice
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to recognize discrepancies
  • Ability to interact with all levels within the organization, client, subcontractors and suppliers to provide information necessary to obtain and complete a project
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time

Working Environment:

  • When visiting jobsites, the work environment involves some exposure to hazards or physical risks, which require following basic safety precautions
  • This work environment may involve moderate exposure to unusual elements, such as extreme temperatures, dirt, dust, fumes, smoke, unpleasant odors and/or loud noises

The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also MasTec's policy to comply with all applicable state, federal and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Application and OS Enablement
description:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We’re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a Flex Work approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work.

What we offer

  • Work on technology that helps Dolby capabilities run reliably across consumer devices, operating systems, and OTT services.
  • Contribute to practical reference, demo, and testing applications used by engineering teams and ecosystem partners.
  • Collaborate with application teams, OS platform owners, product stakeholders, and technology experts across Dolby.
  • Own meaningful technical investigations, prototypes, and platform recommendations with visible impact on Dolby’s home entertainment business.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain OTT testing, demo, and reference applications used to validate Dolby capabilities across consumer device platforms.
  • Support ecosystem enablement efforts by helping identify missing APIs, platform limitations, and functionality gaps in consumer devices.
  • Troubleshoot ecosystem issues across applications, operating systems, media frameworks, software versions, and device configurations.
  • Assess Dolby technology and product capabilities relevant for OTT services across the installed device base.
  • Analyse gaps across Dolby audio and video capabilities, media playback, platform APIs, and related core technologies.
  • Prototype solutions inside applications and operating systems to validate technical approaches.
  • Define OS-specific architectures, workarounds, and integration solutions.
  • Engage with OS platform owners and internal Dolby teams to support adoption of Dolby capabilities in operating systems.
  • Identify needs for common components and industry efforts, including OTT reference applications, Chromium, common media players, W3C, and MPEG.
  • Provide OS-specific guidance and documentation for app developers, including content for Dolby’s developer portal.
  • Support other Dolby application teams by building demo, reference, and testing apps and by resolving issues in underlying integration layers

What you bring

  • Strong software engineering experience in C++, Kotlin, Java, or similar languages used in application and platform development.
  • Experience building, debugging, or integrating applications on Android, Linux-based, embedded, TV, STB, or consumer device platforms.
  • Good understanding of operating system concepts, application/runtime integration, media playback pipelines, APIs, and system configuration.
  • Strong debugging skills across application and platform boundaries, including logs, traces, device configuration, software versions, and integration layers.
  • Ability to analyse technical gaps, propose practical solutions, and validate them through prototypes.
  • Experience working with test applications, reference implementations, automated test environments, or ecosystem validation tools.
  • Ability to work independently, make technical trade-offs, and communicate clearly with engineering and product stakeholders.
  • Comfortable writing technical documentation for engineers, platform teams, and app developers.

Nice to have

  • Experience with OTT services, streaming media, media players, Chromium, Web APIs, or platform browser stacks.
  • Experience with Android TV, TV/STB platforms, media frameworks, audio/video pipelines, middleware, or OS platform integration.
  • Familiarity with consumer audio/video technologies, Dolby technologies, or related device interations.
  • Experience working with platform vendors, OS owners, industry standards groups, or external technical partners.
  • Experience with reference apps, certification tools, test automation, or ecosystem validation.

title: Senior Project Engineer – IT and Cyber security
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Er du klar for å ta en nøkkelrolle innen cyber security i noen av verdens mest avanserte maritime prosjekter?

ABB Marine & Ports driver utvikling mot en bærekraftig fremtid. For å lykkes med å være den partneren våre kunder velger å jobbe med, må vi sikre bærekraft både i våre løsninger og i vår organisasjon fra et forretningsperspektiv. Våre kunder søker i økende grad løsninger som gir større effektivitet, sikkerhet og pålitelighet, og forbereder fartøyer for dagens og morgendagens oppdrag. Dette gjør overgangen enda mer spennende, da det driver oss til å stadig utfordre vår teknologi, våre løsninger og måten vi opererer på.

Vi søker en Senior Project Engineer – IT and Cyber Security til våre prosjekter på Fornebu eller i Ulsteinvik. Du vil jobbe med cyber security for både IT- og OT-systemer (Operational Technology) innen våre maritime systemer og løsninger.

Vi er åpne for både erfarne kandidater og nyutdannede med sterk interesse for cyber security, IT og industrielle kontrollsystemer. Rollen og ansvarsområdet vil tilpasses din erfaring og kompetanse, og du vil få god støtte og utviklingsmuligheter i et sterkt fagmiljø.

Alle våre prosjekter må tilpasses den gjeldende klasse-notasjon for fartøyene.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Være hovedkontakten i egen disiplin i prosjektet for kunde, klasseselskap og underleverandører.

  • Designe, dokumentere, konfigurere/programmere, teste og ferdigstille Cyber leveransen for automasjon og kontrollpakken i prosjektet.

  • Spesifisere funksjonalitet og nettverkstopologi

  • Design og integrert testing av servere, arbeidsstasjoner og nettverk.

  • Støtte commissionings-teamet ved ferdigstillingen av prosjektet, via remote forbindelse og/eller på site.

  • Utføre service oppdrag på skipsverft eller ombord på skip i inn- og utland. Noe reisevirksomhet kan påregnes i perioder.

  • Støtte R&D og salg for å forbedre løsningene våre.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Ingeniørutdanning (B.Sc/M.Sc) innen relevante fagfelt som IT/ automasjon/energi

  • Flytende norsk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig

  • Kunnskap om sikkerhetsløsninger og nettverksutstyr

  • Evne og fleksibilitet til å reise på kundebesøk på bl.a. verft og fartøy

  • Selvgående, resultatorientert og gode kommunikasjonsevner

  • Kjennskap til klassifiseringsselskaper og gjeldende regler fra DNV, BV, ABS, LR mfl. for kontrollsystemer er en fordel

  • Kjennskap til IEC 62443, IACS UR E26/E27 eller andre relevante cyber security-standarder for industrielle kontrollsystemer er en fordel

Hva du kan forvente av oss

Vi tilbyr tekniske og personlige utfordringer i et internasjonalt og innovativt miljø. Profesjonell vekst er like viktig for oss som det er for deg, og vi legger til rette for læring og utvikling gjennom blant annet mentorordninger, regelmessige utviklingssamtaler, interne kurs og spennende karrieremuligheter.

Du kan forvente et uformelt arbeidsmiljø med mange positive og engasjerte medarbeidere som vil ønske deg velkommen til vårt team. Ansatte-goder inkluderer fleksible arbeidsordninger, gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, hytteutleie og andre gunstige avtaler.

Har du spørsmål til stillingen? Da er er du velkommen til å kontakte Engineering Manager, Pål Klynderud, e-post: pal.klynderud@no.abb.com.

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad og CV senest 20. september 2026. Vi vil kun godta søknader som sendes via vår karriereportal. Søknader via e-post vil ikke behandles, og må slettes i tråd med krav til personvern.

ABB er leverandør av samfunnskritisk infrastruktur. Personellsikkerhet er derfor viktig for ABB og våre kunder. I samarbeid med Meditor, gjennomfører ABB Norge bakgrunnssjekk av kandidater som mottar tilbud om ansettelse. Dette for å sikre overholdelse av ABBs retningslinjer for rekruttering og personellsikkerhet, samt overholdelse av lovkrav knyttet til handelssanksjoner. Kandidater vil bli bedt om å avgi relevant informasjon.

Apply today or visit to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Full-Stack Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Data Products and Platform VP - Citi
description:
Discover your future at Citi

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview

The Opportunity

This is your chance to build the foundational systems for 'Citi Assist', a Generative AI assistant that will reach every Citi employee globally. You'll join us on the ground floor, becoming a core builder on a high-visibility platform that sets the standard for how a global bank adopts this technology safely and at scale.

Here's what makes this role unique: we know that data is the key to building a successful, safe, and scalable generative AI assistant. The difference between a good AI product and a great one isn't just the model-it's the testing, evaluation, and feedback loops that make it better every day. As a data-focused full-stack engineer, you'll help us craft the tools and systems that let us understand how Assist is performing, where it's succeeding, and where it needs to improve.

You'll work across the stack, building everything from intuitive dashboards that surface insights to robust backend pipelines that process evaluation data at scale.

What You'll Do

  • Build the tools that make Assist great. You'll design and build the testing, evaluation, and feedback systems that help us understand how our AI assistant is performing in the real world. This means creating tools for both our team and our users to provide feedback, analyse interactions, and measure quality.
  • Work with data across the full stack. You'll build data pipelines that collect and process evaluation metrics, create visualisations that surface insights to the team, and design APIs that power our testing infrastructure. You'll be equally comfortable writing SQL queries as you are building React components.
  • Own your features end to end. You'll take responsibility from conception to production. That means understanding the problem we're trying to solve, designing the right solution, building it, and measuring whether it's working. You'll drive your work forward with autonomy while keeping the team aligned.
  • Build with safety and quality in mind. For us, building safe, sound, and compliant systems is non-negotiable. You'll help us establish the data practices and evaluation frameworks that ensure Assist meets our high standards for quality, safety, and regulatory compliance.
  • Set the technical direction. As a VP-level engineer, we expect you to influence how we approach problems. You'll mentor other engineers, contribute to architectural decisions, and help establish best practices for how we work with data across the platform.
  • Be a great teammate. We expect you to be a leader in our engineering culture. That means offering thoughtful code reviews, unblocking your peers, sharing what you learn, and helping raise the bar for the whole team. We succeed together.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience building and deploying production applications across the full stack
  • Proficiency in multiple languages, including Python and TypeScript/JavaScript (experience with Go or Java is a plus)
  • Deep experience working with data-whether that's building data pipelines, designing analytics systems, or creating data-driven products
  • Experience building user-facing features with modern frontend frameworks like React, Vue, or Angular
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases like Postgres
  • Experience building backend services and APIs that handle data at scale
  • Comfort with containerised environments and cloud infrastructure (we use OpenShift/Kubernetes)
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and automation
  • Experience with data visualisation tools and techniques
