title: Senior Steelmaking Process Specialist (US)
description:
Senior Steelmaking Process Specialist

Location: Remote

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Steelmaking Process Specialist to drive technical excellence and process optimization for steelmaking customers across North America. In this customer-facing role, you will leverage your expertise in steelmaking and refractory applications to solve operational challenges, improve product performance, and support sustainable growth. Working closely with Sales, R&D, and Recycling teams, you will help deliver innovative solutions that create value for both customers and the business.

This remote position requires 50-75% travel to customer sites.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with steelmaking customers to optimize processes and improve operational performance.
  • Analyze slag chemistry and operating conditions to develop technical recommendations and process improvements.
  • Investigate refractory wear issues, troubleshoot application challenges, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Select and recommend refractory materials and product designs tailored to customer requirements and operating practices.
  • Conduct technical training sessions for customers, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Sales during customer visits to evaluate product performance and identify growth opportunities.
  • Support sustainability and circular economy initiatives in partnership with Recycling teams.
  • Work closely with Research & Development, Sales, and other technical teams to develop innovative solutions for customer challenges.
  • Provide field support for refractory application equipment, including mixers, gunning machines, and related systems.
  • Maintain a strong commitment to safety, ensuring compliance with OSHA regulations and established workplace standards.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline required; Master's degree or PhD preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in steelmaking, refractories, or a closely related industry. (Industry experience may be considered in place of a degree.)
  • Deep knowledge of refractory products, applications, and steelmaking processes, including carbon steel, stainless steel, and specialty alloys.
  • Experience with integrated steelmaking operations and process equipment, such as BOF, RH Degassers, and related systems, is preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex technical issues into practical solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage customers and internal teams.
  • Advanced Microsoft 365 proficiency; SAP experience is a plus.
  • Mechanical aptitude and willingness to provide hands-on support in heavy industrial environments.
  • Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively to customer locations throughout North America (50-75%).

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation Package
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package – Including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability coverage.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan – With company matching to help you plan for your future.
  • Paid Time Off
  • Mileage reimbursement and paid travel, meals and accommodations
  • Training & Development – Access to learning resources and career development programs.
  • Inclusive Work Environment – A culture that values diversity, safety, and collaboration.

About RHI Magnesita

RHI Magnesita is the leading global supplier of high-grade refractory products, systems and solutions which are critical for high-temperature processes in a wide range of industries. Serving customers around the world, RHI Magnesita has more than 20,000 employees in 65 main production sites (including raw material sites), 12 recycling facilities and more than 70 sales offices.

RHI Magnesita’s team in North America helps build refractory products that solve the most extreme manufacturing challenges. From advanced lithium-ion batteries for laptops and EVs and specialized glass on smartphones and tablets, to the steel and cement that build the world around us, our high-performance bricks and linings make it possible to melt, bend, shape, and refine these materials at extreme temperatures.

With a vertically integrated value chain, RHI Magnesita has helped forge the materials that build industries and economies for almost 200 years. Refractory products are essential to the production processes for cement, steel, aluminum, and many other industrial producers in the region.


Come get fired up with our North American team!

title: Distrikt Viborg Midt søger sygeplejerske
description:
Trivedes du med en bred faglighed og en dagligdag, der ikke er ens?
Vil du gerne have faglig udvikling af dine kompetencer og være en del af et tværfagligt team, som står stærkt sammen med ca 65 medarbejdere?

Brænder du for et tæt samarbejde omkring borgeren i borgers eget hjem? Og vil du med til at gøre en forskel for vores borgere i Distrikt Viborg Midt?

Så har du nu muligheden for at blive vores nye kollega. Vi søger nye sygeplejersker for at ruste os til en fremtid hvor faglig kompleksitet stiger hos borgeren i eget hjem.

Med tiltrædelse snarest mulig eller senest den 1. november 2026, søger vi 2 sygeplejersker til Hjemmeplejen, Distrikt Viborg Midt, Viborg kommune.

Der er tale om en fast stilling med dagvagter og weekendvagt hver 4. weekend.
Timeantal kan aftales, så det passer til dine ønsker. Og vi arbejder efter konceptet ønskeplan for både vagter i hverdage og weekender.

Distrikt Viborg Midt dækker over Viborg centrum, hvor vi har en bred vifte af borgere inden for ældrepleje, psykiatri og misbrug. I Distrikt Viborg Midt arbejder vi tværfagligt og tæt sammen for at løse kerneopgaven, som er ”samarbejde med borgeren om et selvstændigt, meningsfuldt og aktivt liv – hele livet”.
Vi er både nyuddannede og nogle med erfaring indenfor alle faggrupper. Det giver en god dynamik, når vi arbejder sammen om at løse forskellige udfordringer. Vi har stort fokus på trivsel og det gode arbejdsmiljø, som vi arbejder aktivt med hver dag.
Du vil få engagerede kollegaer, der værdsætter dialog og samarbejde højt, uden at det bliver for højtideligt. Vi vægter humor er en vigtig del i vores team.
Vi har fokus på velfærdsteknologi, brug af skærmopkald, iPads og DigiRehab. Vi er ved at udvide vores lokaler med 2 sygeplejeklinikker for ambulant hjælp.

Distrikt Viborg Midt er et cykeldistrikt, og vi cykler fortrinsvis på kommunens elcykler, men har også almindelige cykler og bil til rådighed. Kørekort er ikke nødvendig.

Vi tilbyder
  • god oplæring og opfølgning ved mentor
  • god tværfaglig sparring med kollegaer
  • gode imødekommende kollegaer
  • et godt team med plads til dig
  • indflydelse på egen vagtplan. Der afholdes vagtplansmøder og man kan selv ønske elektronisk ind i vagtplanlægningssystemet.
  • en afvekslende hverdag med spændende opgaver
  • kompetenceudvikling i form af kurser

Vi forventer, at du
  • har erfaring som sygeplejerske, men det er ikke et krav
  • har et godt overblik, og kan bevare dette i en travl hverdag
  • arbejder sundhedsfremmende og rehabiliterende med udgangspunkt i borgers ønsker og behov
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt indenfor eget kompetenceområde og har lyst til, og ser værdien i, at arbejde tværfagligt til gavn for borgeren
  • har et positivt sind og en anerkendende tilgang til borger såvel som til kollegaer
  • ser IT som en mulighed frem for en begrænsning

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Samtaler
Der vil blive afholdt løbende samtaler.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Lønnen fastsættes på baggrund af gældende overenskomst og en konkret vurdering af din uddannelse, din dokumenterede erhvervserfaring samt dine faglige og personlige kvalifikationer. Forud for ansættelsen og indgåelse af lønaftalen har du mulighed for at modtage information om startlønnen i den konkrete stilling. Viborg Kommune anvender objektive og kønsneutrale kriterier for lønfastsættelse i overensstemmelse med reglerne om lige løn for samme arbejde eller arbejde af samme værdi, og i henhold til den relevante overenskomst. Du kan finde information om løn på: KRL
Ansættelsen er betinget af en godkendt autorisation, samt indhentning af straffeattest.

Yderligere oplysning

title: AI Context & Data Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About Town

Town () is AI that starts from who you are. We build a persistent model of your identity, your voice, your judgment, your relationships, and your priorities, and use it to do real work on your behalf across every tool where you operate: email, calendar, documents, Slack, and more. Town doesn't wait for you to prompt it. It observes, learns, and acts. The more you use it, the more it becomes an extension of you.

Town was founded by Jean-Denis Greze (CEO), former CTO of Plaid, and Tony Vincent (CPO), former Director of Applied AI Product at Google. We're a small, talent-dense team backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Forerunner Ventures, First Round Capital, and Conviction, with more than $73M raised to date.

About the role

Town is building the most personalized, most capable AI assistant for everyone — and personalization at that level is a retrieval and data problem. The assistant is only as good as the context it can bring into the moment: the right memory, message, document, or relationship, pulled fast and related by meaning across everything a person and their team touch.

You'll build the foundation the whole product reasons over: the search and data infrastructure behind that context. One shared retrieval layer combining lexical and semantic search, the realtime and batch pipelines that keep it fresh and correct, and the durable data model everything else is built on.

This is greenfield and high-leverage: you'll be the first person building this layer.

What you'll do

  • Build the search and retrieval layer that puts the right context at every Townie's fingertips, the moment it's needed — one shared layer the whole product pulls from instead of refetching context on its own.

  • Combine lexical and semantic search and own the tradeoffs between them: vector vs. lexical, precompute vs. fetch, hybrid retrieval, and ranking.

  • Design the durable data model the assistant's work is built on, so context is relevant, fast, and cost-effective.

  • Build and operate the pipelines behind it — realtime/streaming and batch — that keep the index fresh and correct as the underlying data changes.

  • Stand up the indexing and storage layer and keep it fast and reliable at scale: latency, cost, freshness, and completeness.

  • Lay the groundwork for relating content by meaning across everything the assistant knows — the start of a knowledge graph of people, companies, projects, and how they connect.

You might thrive here if you...

  • Have significant, hands-on experience across lexical and semantic search components and approaches (BM25, embeddings, ANN/vector indexes, hybrid retrieval, ranking).

  • Have run large-scale data infrastructure, ideally both realtime/streaming and batch — pipelines, indexing, and storage.

  • Can make retrieval fast and cheap at scale, and reason about the latency, cost, and freshness tradeoffs cold.

  • Are a systems thinker comfortable in greenfield, where the foundation doesn't exist yet.

  • Are excited to take these systems from rapid prototype to production scale.

  • Bonus if you've worked on ranking/relevance, knowledge graphs, or retrieval for LLM or agentic systems.

Location

San Francisco, CA. Five days a week in person at our Financial District office.

    • Level II: Bachelor's degree and 4+ years of relevant experience (Equivalent professional work or military experience will be considered in lieu of a degree).

title: RN – Labor and Delivery
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Registered Nurse (RN) – Labor and Delivery to join the Labor & Delivery team at Swedish First Hill in Seattle, Washington. This opportunity is designed specifically for an RN with established, hands-on experience caring for patients in a Labor & Delivery environment.

The RN will provide specialized nursing care throughout labor, delivery, and the immediate perinatal period while collaborating closely with physicians, advanced practice providers, and other members of the maternal care team. This is an experienced L&D RN position and is not intended as an entry-level pathway into the specialty.

Required Qualifications

  • Graduation from an accredited nursing program
  • Current Washington Registered Nurse (RN) License upon hire
  • Current American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS) certification upon hire
  • Current American Academy of Pediatrics Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) certification upon hire
  • Minimum 1 year of professional RN experience
  • Minimum 1 year of RN experience specifically within a Labor & Delivery environment
  • Labor & Delivery clinical rotations completed during nursing school do not count toward the required L&D experience
  • Labor & Delivery residency program experience does not substitute for the required experienced-RN background

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1–2+ years of Labor & Delivery RN experience
  • National certification in the applicable nursing specialty upon hire
  • Strong maternal-fetal assessment and clinical decision-making skills
  • Experience working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary Labor & Delivery team

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is an experienced Labor & Delivery RN with at least one full year of independent professional experience in an L&D setting. This role requires more than exposure to Labor & Delivery through nursing school clinical rotations or a residency program. Candidates should already be comfortable functioning as an experienced RN within the specialty and providing direct nursing care throughout labor and delivery.

A candidate with 1–2+ years of dedicated L&D nursing experience, strong maternal and newborn assessment skills, and specialty certification will be especially well positioned for this opportunity.

Compensation

$100,000 – $190,000 annually

Eligible external candidates may also qualify for a $15,000 hiring bonus, subject to meeting all applicable conditions for payment.

Why Join Through Tap Healthcare Solutions?

At Tap Healthcare Solutions, we understand that experienced specialty nurses aren't simply looking for another bedside position—they're looking for an opportunity that appropriately recognizes the experience they've already built. For an established Labor & Delivery RN, this position offers the opportunity to bring that expertise to a major Seattle healthcare environment while continuing to advance within maternal and newborn care.

Our team will support you throughout the hiring process with clear communication and a candidate-focused approach. We'll help ensure your Labor & Delivery experience, qualifications, compensation expectations, and career goals align with the opportunity before moving you forward.

title: Security Cleared ICT, Infrastructure, Cyber & Project Professionals - EOI
description:
ICT & Project Professionals - Expressions of Interest

These roles sit within high-performing environments supporting enterprise-scale infrastructure, modern digital services, and major transformation initiatives.

Eligibility

  • An active Australian Government Security Clearance (Baseline, NV1, NV2, or PV) is not required but is an advantage.

  • Roles available Australia wide, however many are Canberra-based so ability to work out of Canberra may be advantageous (on-site or hybrid requirements may apply).


About the roles

We are building a talent pipeline of skilled professionals to join dynamic project teams and business-as-usual (BAU) operations. We are looking for specialists across the following domains:

  • Cyber Security & SecOps: Security Operations Centre (SOC) Analysts, Penetration Testers, Incident Responders, Security Architects, Identity & Access Management (IAM) Specialists, and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Assessors.

  • Systems Administration & Platform Engineering: Windows/Linux Systems Administrators, Active Directory/Entra ID Specialists, VMware/Hyper-V Administrators, and Enterprise Messaging/M365 Engineers.

  • Network Administration & Engineering: Network Engineers, Firewall/Security Gateway Administrators, SD-WAN Specialists, Network Architects (Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto), and Unified Communications Engineers.

  • Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture: Cloud Engineers (Azure, AWS, Multi-Cloud), Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Specialists, Solution Architects, and Enterprise Infrastructure Architects.

  • Software Engineering & Development:

    • Languages: C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go (Golang), Rust, SQL.

    • Frameworks/Libraries: .NET, React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, Django, Flutter.

  • ERP & Enterprise Solutions: Functional and Technical Consultants across ServiceNow, SAP, and Salesforce.

  • Project & Program Management: Project Officers, Project Managers, Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and Change Managers.

  • Software Testing: Functional, Non-Functional, Performance, and Automation Testers.

  • Design & Research: User Researchers, Service Designers, and UI/UX Professionals.


Key responsibilities

Depending on your specialisation, responsibilities will include:

  • Administering, patching, and maintaining enterprise server environments (Windows Server, RHEL, Linux) and virtualisation platforms.

  • Designing, provisioning, and securing complex enterprise network topologies, switches, routers, firewalls, and secure gateways.

  • Monitoring, detecting, and responding to cyber security incidents, conducting vulnerability assessments, and implementing mitigation strategies.

  • Designing, developing, and deploying resilient cloud architectures, automated CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

  • Implementing and hardening systems in strict accordance with Australian Government cyber security requirements (ISM, Essential Eight, PSPF).

  • Leading or supporting the delivery of complex ICT infrastructure rollouts, core capability modernisations, and software delivery sprints.

  • Developing technical artefacts, system documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and architecture design records.

  • Hands-on technical experience with relevant enterprise toolsets, platforms, or hardware ecosystems.

  • Strong diagnostic, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities within complex, secure enterprise networks.

  • Demonstrated understanding of Australian Government security and governance frameworks:

    • Information Security Manual (ISM)

    • Essential Eight Maturity Model

    • Protective Security Policy Framework (PSPF)

    • ACSC Guidelines & Blueprint for Secure Cloud

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the capacity to engage both technical and executive stakeholders.


Desirable Experience

  • Prior experience operating within Federal Government, Defence portfolio agencies, or classified operational environments.

  • Industry certifications relevant to your stream (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CEH, CCNA/CCNP, AZ-104/305, AWS Solutions Architect, RHCE, ITIL).

  • Familiarity with the Digital Service Standard (DSS) for digital service delivery and design roles.


Application Requirements

To be considered for this position, applicants must submit:

  1. A current CV detailing your technical stack, project history, and clearance level.

  2. A brief cover letter or pitch outlining:

    • Your primary technical specialisations and key strengths.

    • Your current security clearance status and sponsoring agency (if applicable).

    • Your availability and preferred engagement model (Contract or Permanent).

title: Sr Software Engineer, AI Agent Platform
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Hyper, a Motorola Solutions Company, a leader in conversational, agentic AI designed to reduce the burden on understaffed public safety answering points (PSAPs) by handling non-emergency calls. It is revolutionizing emergency response systems through cutting-edge AI technologies. Our first product is reducing 911 wait times by alleviating administrative work from highly trained 911 telecommunicators.


Job Description

We’re looking for a Sr Software Engineer to set technical direction for the AI Agent Platform team behind Hyper’s emergency response products (Motorola Solutions announced that it acquired Hyper on April 9, 2026).

You’ll be a senior technical leader responsible for the architecture of our most critical systems. You’ll shape long-term technical strategy, mentor engineers across the team, and own the toughest cross-cutting problems — from real-time AI pipelines and telephony to backend infrastructure and product surfaces. We expect engineers to use AI agents in their own work. But because this is mission-critical software, humans still own quality, judgment, and what ships — and as a Sr Engineer, you set the bar for what “good” looks like.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design and operation of real-time voice AI systems that support human 911 telecommunicators at scale.

  • Identify and solve the hardest problems in our stack: low-latency audio, streaming, telephony, LLM orchestration, and human-in-the-loop AI workflows.

  • Drive engineering excellence across reliability, availability, security, and performance — defining the standards the team operates by.

  • Partner with product, design, and operations leadership to translate ambiguous customer and operational problems into technical strategy.

  • Mentor engineers; raise the floor and the ceiling of the team’s technical work through reviews, design feedback, and pairing.

  • Build and evolve evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks for AI-assisted systems.

  • Lead incident response and post-incident reviews; own runbook quality and on-call health for the systems the team is responsible for.

  • Represent engineering in conversations with public safety customers, partners, and Motorola Solutions stakeholders when deep technical credibility is required.

You Might Be a Fit If

  • You have production software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership.

  • You’ve designed, shipped, and operated large, complex systems in high-stakes domains

  • You are comfortable working across backend, infrastructure, AI pipelines, and product surfaces.

  • You can turn ambiguous product or operational problems into clear technical plans for the team.

  • You use AI tools daily, but you set the standard for how your team uses them responsibly — speed without compromising quality.

  • You raise the engineering bar around tests, observability, code review, security, and clean abstractions.

  • You mentor effectively. Engineers around you get better because of how you work.

  • You have strong product judgment and care deeply about the humans using what you build.

  • You thrive in a small, fast-moving team with high ownership and low ego, and you can scale that culture as we grow.

  • You want to work on AI systems that matter beyond demos.

Relevant Experience

We do not expect every candidate to have all of these. We care more about strong engineering judgment, learning velocity, and ownership than exact keyword matches.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Architecting LLM, agentic, or RAG systems in production, including evals and prompt test harnesses at scale.

  • Deep expertise in Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, Voice Activity Detection, endpointing, interruption handling, noise filtering, diarization, or audio streaming.

  • Telephony and voice infrastructure: PSTN, SIP trunking, PBX, and call routing.

Job Description:

Keep growth on track and your career in motion as a Subcontracts Administrator Growth Lead at GDIT. Your work supporting strategic capture and proposal efforts will power business growth, competitive positioning, and long‑term mission success for our customers.

As a Subcontracts Administrator Growth Lead dedicated to proposal and capture management, the work you’ll do at GDIT will directly shape our ability to win new business. In this role you will lead all subcontract‑related tasks across the capture lifecycle, ensure compliance with federal acquisition regulations, develop competitive sourcing strategies, and surface risks early by driving cross‑functional alignment with capture, pricing, contracts, and technical teams.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

  • Reports directly to the Growth Strategist as an integral member of the team, supporting execution of sourcing strategies and subcontract management activities
  • Lead subcontractor engagement and sourcing strategy during capture and proposal development, including developing requests for proposals (RFPs), evaluating supplier capabilities, and leading competitive analysis. Ensure compliance with FAR/DFARS requirements and GDIT policies
  • Coordinate all subcontract‑related inputs for proposals, including cost/price data, teaming documentation, non-disclosure execution, compliance artifacts, and technical volume contributions when required. Ensure small business and socioeconomic considerations are incorporated
  • Analyze capture requirements and identify subcontracting risks, gaps, and opportunities; recommend mitigation strategies to the Capture Manager and Proposal Manager. Escalate risk concerns leadership when applicable
  • Utilize artificial intelligence to identify potential gaps or risks between subcontractor agreements and customer requirements
  • Prepare and deliver subcontractor status updates, risk assessments, and pricing insights to leadership and capturing stakeholders
  • Support continuous improvement across the proposal subcontracting process by identifying inefficiencies and recommending enhancements to templates, workflows, and subcontractor engagement models
  • Utilize GDIT’s source‑to‑pay and proposal systems to track subcontractor activities, ensure documentation completeness, and provide accurate data for color team reviews and leadership briefings

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your acquisition expertise along with a drive for growth and competitive excellence to GDIT. The Subcontracts Administrator Growth Lead must have:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, contracts, supply chain, government acquisition, or related business field; 4 years of additional experience may be substituted in lieu of degree.
  • Experience: 3+ years supporting federal subcontracting, procurement, or proposal development, with strong familiarity in FAR‑based environments
  • Technical skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
  • Role requirements:
    • Experience developing RFX’s to suppliers, analyzing subcontractor proposals, negotiating agreements or terms, working in source‑to‑pay or contract management systems
    • Strong understanding of subcontracting processes throughout capture and proposal phases, including price analysis, competitive sourcing, and compliance considerations
    • Ability to identify risks, troubleshoot issues, and proactively elevate challenges to capture and procurement leadership
    • Ability to clearly communicate with internal teams, external partners, and executive leadership
  • Location: This is a hybrid position working at our GDIT facility in Falls Church, VA. Must be comfortable working onsite (3) days a week minimum.
  • U.S. Persons required

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, competitive pay and paid time off
  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY

Explore a career in supply chain and logistics at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who thrive on efficiency, accuracy, and accountability.

title: Project Manager-Retail Fit-Outs & Renovations
description:
About the role

The Project Manager provides consulting services to our retail client telecom client account to help achieve the company's strategic business objectives. Projects consist of retail store fit-outs and renovations from preconstruction planning and permitting to closeout.

This job is part of the Project Management function. They are responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion This is a remote opportunity with 20%-30% travel primarily in the Eastern and Central Time Zones.

What you’ll do

Manage all areas of project management for commercial real estate projects. This includes planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.

Interface directly with Architects and General Contractors, define scope, and manage RFP’s and RFIs.

Interface directly with clients to prepare all project elements, including the scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates & budget, work plan schedule & landmarks, quality control, and risk identification.

Define the project delivery resources from pre-qualified lists or through the project qualification process. Conduct a standard request for proposals, complete bid evaluations, and recommend resources to clients.

Implement project documentation governance that is aligned with company and client requirements.

Ensure project data integrity and documentation is accurate, timely, and coordinated.

Build action plans to meet objectives, budget, and schedule. Track the progress of each project and report status and variances.

Demonstrate ability to identify project threats and develop risk mitigation and contingency plans. Implement plans to reduce or eliminate project risks.

Apply in-depth knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish complex assignments and provide innovative solutions.

Mentor others and share knowledge of your job subject area and have broad understanding of several job fields within the function.

Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE (Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence) values. Work to build consensus and convince others to reach an agreement.

Impact a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities within own team and other related teams.

What you’ll need

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred with 5-8 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and/or CCM designation(s) preferred.
  • Experience with retail client accounts managing fit-out and renovation construction is preferred.
  • Ability to read architectural drawings and technical construction documents
  • Knowledge of lease agreements and vendor management is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook), Smartsheet. Experience with Tango or similar project management software required. Corrigo or other facilities management software is desirable.
  • Expert organizational skills with an advanced inquisitive mentality.
